<template>
	<AsamApplicationProvider :config="{ size, colorMode: dark ? 'dark' : 'light', base: { i18n } }"
		><Teleport to="#preview-settings-extra" :disabled="!websitePreviewControls"
			><WebsiteAsamConfigProvider size="default"
				><section class="preview-control-group">
					<nav
						class="account-demo-tools"
						:aria-label="i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleAria')"
					>
						<label
							>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleStyle')
							}}<AsamSelect
								:model-value="family"
								@update:model-value="updateFamily"
								:aria-label="i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleStyle')"
								><AsamOption
									:label="
										String(
											i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleMinimal')
										).trim()
									"
									value="minimal"
									>{{
										i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleMinimal')
									}}</AsamOption
								><AsamOption
									:label="
										String(i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleBrand')).trim()
									"
									value="brand"
									>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleBrand') }}</AsamOption
								><AsamOption
									:label="
										String(i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleTech')).trim()
									"
									value="tech"
									>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleTech') }}</AsamOption
								></AsamSelect
							></label
						><label
							>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.examplePage')
							}}<AsamSelect
								:model-value="page"
								@update:model-value="updatePage"
								:aria-label="i18n.t('app.templates.account.examplePage')"
								><AsamOption
									:label="
										String(i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleLogin')).trim()
									"
									value="login"
									>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleLogin') }}</AsamOption
								><AsamOption
									:label="
										String(
											i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleRegister')
										).trim()
									"
									value="register"
									>{{
										i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleRegister')
									}}</AsamOption
								><AsamOption
									:label="
										String(
											i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleProfile')
										).trim()
									"
									value="profile"
									>{{
										i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleProfile')
									}}</AsamOption
								><AsamOption
									:label="
										String(
											i18n.t('app.templates.account.minimalSettings')
										).trim()
									"
									value="settings"
									>{{
										i18n.t('app.templates.account.minimalSettings')
									}}</AsamOption
								></AsamSelect
							></label
						>
						<div class="preview-choice-field">
							<span>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleService') }}</span
							><WebsiteAsamRadioGroup
								:model-value="fixture.controls.mode"
								@update:model-value="updateFixtureControlsMode"
								:aria-label="i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleService')"
								class="preview-choice-grid"
								><WebsiteAsamRadioItem value="success" border>{{
									String(i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleSuccess')).trim()
								}}</WebsiteAsamRadioItem
								><WebsiteAsamRadioItem value="failure" border>{{
									String(i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleFailure')).trim()
								}}</WebsiteAsamRadioItem
								><WebsiteAsamRadioItem value="field-error" border>{{
									String(i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleFieldError')).trim()
								}}</WebsiteAsamRadioItem
								><WebsiteAsamRadioItem value="unknown" border>{{
									String(i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleUnknown')).trim()
								}}</WebsiteAsamRadioItem
								><WebsiteAsamRadioItem value="empty" border>{{
									String(i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleEmpty')).trim()
								}}</WebsiteAsamRadioItem
								><WebsiteAsamRadioItem value="late" border>{{
									String(i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleLate')).trim()
								}}</WebsiteAsamRadioItem></WebsiteAsamRadioGroup
							>
						</div>
						<label
							>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleSize')
							}}<AsamSelect
								:model-value="size"
								@update:model-value="updateSize"
								:aria-label="i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleSize')"
								><AsamOption value="small" label="small">small</AsamOption
								><AsamOption value="default" label="default">default</AsamOption
								><AsamOption value="big" label="big">big</AsamOption
								><AsamOption value="large" label="large"
									>large</AsamOption
								></AsamSelect
							></label
						><label
							><span
								v-show="!websitePreviewControls"
								data-preview-theme-control
								:data-preview-value="dark"
								v-on="{ 'asam-preview-theme': websitePreviewTheme0 }"
								><AsamCheckboxItem
									:model-value="dark"
									@update:model-value="updateDark"
									border /></span
							>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleDark') }}</label
						><AsamCheckboxItem
							:model-value="disabled"
							@update:model-value="
								(value) => {
									if (typeof value === 'boolean') disabled = value;
								}
							"
							border
							>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleDisabled') }}</AsamCheckboxItem
						><AsamCheckboxItem
							:model-value="readonly"
							@update:model-value="
								(value) => {
									if (typeof value === 'boolean') readonly = value;
								}
							"
							border
							>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleReadonly') }}</AsamCheckboxItem
						><AsamCheckboxItem
							:model-value="fixture.controls.refreshFailure"
							@update:model-value="
								(value) => {
									if (typeof value === 'boolean')
										fixture.controls.refreshFailure = value;
								}
							"
							border
							>{{
								i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleRefreshFailure')
							}}</AsamCheckboxItem

						><AsamButton type="primary" @click="fixture.security.expire()">{{
							i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleExpire')
						}}</AsamButton
						><AsamButton type="primary" @click="fixture.security.logout()">{{
							i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleLogout')
						}}</AsamButton
						><AsamButton type="primary" @click="fixture.identity('0')">{{
							i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleIdentity')
						}}</AsamButton
						><WebsiteAsamCheckboxItem
							border
							:model-value="mounted"
							@update:model-value="mounted = $event === true"
							>{{
								i18n.t('app.templates.account.exampleMount')
							}}</WebsiteAsamCheckboxItem
						>
					</nav>
				</section></WebsiteAsamConfigProvider

		><component
			:is="component"
			v-if="mounted"
			:key="`${family}-${page}`"
			v-bind="
				page === 'login'
					? {
							authenticate: authenticateLogin,
							brandTitle: exampleBrand,
							formatError: loginError
						}
					: { host: fixture.host }
			"
			:brand="exampleBrand"
			:size="size"
			:disabled="disabled"
			:readonly="readonly"
			:return-path="returnPath"
			@page="page = $event"
			@completed="complete"
	/></AsamApplicationProvider>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import {
	AsamRadioGroup as WebsiteAsamRadioGroup,
	AsamRadioItem as WebsiteAsamRadioItem,
	AsamCheckboxItem as WebsiteAsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamConfigProvider as WebsiteAsamConfigProvider
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');
function websitePreviewTheme0(event: CustomEvent<'light' | 'dark'>) {
	updateDark(event.detail === 'dark');
}
function websiteNativeEvent(value: unknown, type: string) {
	const event = new Event(type);
	Object.defineProperty(event, 'target', { value: { value, checked: value } });
	return event;
}

import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamCheckboxItem } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { useAccountI18n } from '../I18n.js';
const i18n = useAccountI18n();
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamFlowSize } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import {
	MinimalLogin,
	MinimalRegister,
	MinimalProfile,
	MinimalSettings,
	BrandLogin,
	BrandRegister,
	BrandProfile,
	BrandSettings,
	TechLogin,
	TechRegister,
	TechProfile,
	TechSettings
} from '../index.js';
import type { AccountFamily, AccountPage } from '../Types.js';
import { createAccountLoginAdapter, AccountLoginError } from '../LoginAdapter.js';
import { createAccountFixture, exampleBrand } from './Fixture.js';
const query = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const family = ref<AccountFamily>(
	(['minimal', 'brand', 'tech'].includes(query.get('family') ?? '')
		? query.get('family')
		: 'minimal') as AccountFamily
);
const page = ref<AccountPage>(
	(['login', 'register', 'profile', 'settings'].includes(query.get('page') ?? '')
		? query.get('page')
		: 'login') as AccountPage
);
const size = ref<AsamFlowSize>('default');
const disabled = ref(false);
const readonly = ref(false);
const mounted = ref(true);
const dark = ref(query.get('theme') === 'dark');
const returnPath = query.get('return') ?? '/account/profile';
const fixture = createAccountFixture(i18n);
const authenticateLogin = createAccountLoginAdapter(
	() => fixture.host,
	() => ({ disabled: disabled.value, readonly: readonly.value, returnPath })
);
function loginError(error: unknown) {
	if (!(error instanceof AccountLoginError)) return i18n.t('app.templates.account.loginFailed');
	return i18n.t(
		error.code === 'return-denied'
			? 'app.templates.account.returnDenied'
			: error.code === 'navigation'
				? 'app.templates.account.navigationFailed'
				: 'app.templates.account.loginRejected'
	);
}
const components = {
	minimal: {
		login: MinimalLogin,
		register: MinimalRegister,
		profile: MinimalProfile,
		settings: MinimalSettings
	},
	brand: {
		login: BrandLogin,
		register: BrandRegister,
		profile: BrandProfile,
		settings: BrandSettings
	},
	tech: { login: TechLogin, register: TechRegister, profile: TechProfile, settings: TechSettings }
};
const component = computed(() => components[family.value][page.value]);
watch(
	() => fixture.controls.mode,
	(mode) => {
		fixture.controls.delay = mode === 'late' ? 900 : 0;
	}
);
function complete(kind: string) {
	if (kind === 'login')
		page.value = fixture.audit.navigations.at(-1)?.endsWith('settings')
			? 'settings'
			: 'profile';
}
if (query.get('authenticated') === '1') void fixture.security.restore();
// Test-only harness is inside this explicit local example, never installed into the UI runtime.
defineExpose({ fixture });
onBeforeUnmount(fixture.dispose);

function updateFamily(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'minimal' || value === 'brand' || value === 'tech') family.value = value;
}

function updatePage(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'login' || value === 'register' || value === 'profile' || value === 'settings')
		page.value = value;
}

function updateFixtureControlsMode(value: unknown) {
	if (
		value === 'success' ||
		value === 'failure' ||
		value === 'field-error' ||
		value === 'unknown' ||
		value === 'empty' ||
		value === 'late'
	)
		fixture.controls.mode = value;
}

function updateSize(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'small' || value === 'default' || value === 'big' || value === 'large')
		size.value = value;
}

function updateDark(value: unknown) {
	if (typeof value === 'boolean') dark.value = value;
}
</script>

}

	display: flex;

	background: #edf1f5;
	color: #273241;
	font:

		sans-serif;
}
.account-demo-tools label {
	display: inline-flex;
	gap: 5px;
	align-items: center;
}
.account-demo-tools button:not([class*='el-']),
.account-demo-tools select:not([class*='el-']) {
	min-height: 28px;
}
</style>

import { accountMessagesZh } from './I18nZh.js';
export const accountMessageDefaults = Object.freeze({
	en: accountMessagesEn,
	'zh-CN': accountMessagesZh
});
export function useAccountI18n() {
	return useAsamProI18n(accountMessageDefaults);
}

import { safeReturnPath } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import type { AccountHost } from './Types.js';

export type AccountLoginFailure = 'rejected' | 'navigation' | 'return-denied';
/** Fixed application error codes, never backend exception or token data. */
export class AccountLoginError extends Error {
	constructor(readonly code: AccountLoginFailure) {
		super(code);
	}
}
/**
 * Bridge the existing AccountHost to LOGIN-20261028-HOST-CONTRACT-R1.
 * One host adapter owns security/session/redirect. Each copied Login.vue needs only authenticate.
 */
export function createAccountLoginAdapter(
	getHost: () => AccountHost,
	options: () => { disabled?: boolean; readonly?: boolean; returnPath?: unknown } = () => ({})
) {
	return async (
		credentials: { username: string; password: string },
		context: { signal: AbortSignal }
	): Promise<void> => {
		const host = getHost();
		const initial = options();
		const controller = new AbortController();
		let starting = false;
		let active = true;
		const abort = () => controller.abort();
		context.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
		if (context.signal.aborted) abort();
		const stop = host.security.onInvalidate(() => {
			if (!(starting && host.security.state.value.status === 'authenticating')) abort();
		});
		const current = () =>
			active &&
			!controller.signal.aborted &&
			!context.signal.aborted &&
			host === getHost() &&
			!options().disabled &&
			!options().readonly &&
			options().returnPath === initial.returnPath;
		const input = { account: credentials.username, password: credentials.password };
		try {
			if (!current()) throw new DOMException('Cancelled', 'AbortError');
			let authentication: Promise<boolean>;
			starting = true;
			try {
				authentication = host.services.login(input, {
					operationId: host.operationId(),
					signal: controller.signal,
					isCurrent: current
				});
			} finally {
				starting = false;
			}
			let accepted: boolean;
			try {
				accepted = await authentication;
			} catch {
				throw new AccountLoginError('rejected');
			}
			if (!current()) throw new DOMException('Cancelled', 'AbortError');
			if (
				!accepted ||
				host.security.state.value.status !== 'authenticated' ||
				!host.security.state.value.subject
			)
				throw new AccountLoginError('rejected');
			const destination = safeReturnPath(initial.returnPath, '/account/profile');
			if (!host.canNavigate(destination)) throw new AccountLoginError('return-denied');
			if (!current()) throw new DOMException('Cancelled', 'AbortError');
			try {
				await host.navigate(destination);
			} catch {
				throw new AccountLoginError('navigation');
			}
			if (!current()) throw new DOMException('Cancelled', 'AbortError');
		} finally {
			input.password = '';
			active = false;
			context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
			stop();
		}
	};
}

import { computed, reactive, ref, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { extendAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';

	AccountHost,

	SettingsField,
	Verification,
	WriteResult
} from './Types.js';

const emptySettings = (): AccountSettings => ({
	displayName: '',
	email: '',
	phone: '',
	language: 'zh-CN',
	notifications: false,
	digest: false
});
const text = (value: unknown) => (typeof value === 'string' ? value : '');
export function safeProfile(value: AccountProfile): AccountProfile {
	return {
		displayName: text(value.displayName),
		email: text(value.email),
		phone: text(value.phone),
		organization: text(value.organization),
		role: text(value.role),
		joined: text(value.joined),
		avatar: safeAccountUrl(value.avatar),
		website: safeAccountUrl(value.website)
	};
}
/** No data/blob/protocol-relative URLs. Host should restrict remote hosts further. */
export function safeAccountUrl(value: unknown): string | undefined {
	// eslint-disable-next-line no-control-regex -- Reject URL control characters, as before.
	if (typeof value !== 'string' || /[\\\u0000-\u0020\u007f]/.test(value)) return;
	if (value.startsWith('/') && !value.startsWith('//') && !/%[0-9a-f]{2}/i.test(value))
		return value;
	try {
		const url = new URL(value);
		return url.protocol === 'https:' && !url.username && !url.password ? url.href : undefined;
	} catch {
		return;
	}
}
function copySettings(value: AccountSettings): AccountSettings {
	return {
		displayName: text(value.displayName),
		email: text(value.email),
		phone: text(value.phone),
		language: text(value.language),
		notifications: value.notifications === true,
		digest: value.digest === true,
		...(typeof value.biography === 'string' ? { biography: value.biography } : {}),
		...(typeof value.officeArea === 'string' ? { officeArea: value.officeArea } : {})
	};
}
type MessageIssue = ReturnType<typeof createAsamMessageIssue>;
function feedback<Field extends string>(owner?: AsamI18n) {
	const scope = owner ? extendAsamI18n(owner, accountMessageDefaults) : undefined;
	const message = ref('');
	const source = shallowRef<MessageIssue>();
	const sources = shallowRef<Partial<Record<Field, MessageIssue>>>({});
	const errors = ref<Partial<Record<Field, string>>>({});
	function setMessage(legacy: string, ...call: AsamI18nCall | []) {
		message.value = legacy;
		source.value = call.length ? createAsamMessageIssue(legacy, ...call) : undefined;
	}
	return {
		message,
		errors,
		sources,
		setMessage,
		displayMessage: computed(() =>
			scope && source.value ? formatFieldIssue(source.value, scope) : message.value
		),
		displayErrors: computed(
			() =>
				Object.fromEntries(
					Object.entries(errors.value).map(([key, value]) => [
						key,
						scope && sources.value[key as Field]
							? formatFieldIssue(sources.value[key as Field]!, scope)
							: value
					])
				) as Partial<Record<Field, string>>
		),
		dispose: () => scope?.dispose()
	};
}
export function registrationIssues(
	host: AccountHost,
	value: Registration & { confirm: string },
	sources: Partial<Record<RegistrationField, MessageIssue>> = {}
) {
	const errors: Partial<Record<RegistrationField, string>> = {};
	function add(field: RegistrationField, legacy: string, ...call: AsamI18nCall) {
		errors[field] = legacy;
		sources[field] = createAsamMessageIssue(legacy, ...call);
	}
	if (!/^[\p{L}\p{N}_.-]{3,40}$/u.test(value.account))
		add(
			'account',
			'用户名需为3至40个字母、数字或 _ . -',
			'app.templates.account.accountInvalid'
		);
	if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value.email))
		add('email', '请填写有效的联系邮箱', 'app.templates.account.emailInvalid');
	if (value.password.length < (host.registration?.minimumPasswordLength ?? 8))
		add(
			'password',
			`密码至少${host.registration?.minimumPasswordLength ?? 8}位`,
			'app.templates.account.passwordShort',
			{ minimum: host.registration?.minimumPasswordLength ?? 8 }
		);
	if (value.password !== value.confirm)
		add('confirm', '两次输入的密码不一致', 'app.templates.account.passwordMismatch');
	if (host.registration?.requireConsent !== false && !value.consent)
		add('consent', '请先同意账户使用条款', 'app.templates.account.consentRequired');
	const hostErrors = host.registration?.validate?.(value);
	for (const key of Object.keys(hostErrors ?? {})) delete sources[key as RegistrationField];
	return { ...errors, ...hostErrors };
}
export function settingsIssues(
	value: AccountSettings,
	host: AccountHost,
	sources: Partial<Record<SettingsField, MessageIssue>> = {}
) {
	const errors: Partial<Record<SettingsField, string>> = {};
	function add(field: SettingsField, legacy: string, ...call: AsamI18nCall) {
		errors[field] = legacy;
		sources[field] = createAsamMessageIssue(legacy, ...call);
	}
	if (!value.displayName.trim() || value.displayName.length > 60)
		add('displayName', '显示名需为1至60个字符', 'app.templates.account.nameInvalid');
	if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value.email))
		add('email', '请填写有效的联系邮箱', 'app.templates.account.emailInvalid');
	if (value.phone && !/^[+\d ()-]{5,30}$/.test(value.phone))
		add('phone', '请填写有效联系电话或留空', 'app.templates.account.phoneInvalid');
	if (
		!(host.languages ?? [{ value: 'zh-CN' }, { value: 'en' }]).some(
			(i) => i.value === value.language
		)
	)
		add('language', '请选择支持的语言', 'app.templates.account.languageInvalid');
	return errors;
}

/** Page-owned requests only. Security/transport state machines remain in 033/035. */
function owner(host: AccountHost, invalidate: () => void) {
	let version = 0;
	let disposed = false;
	const requests = new Set<AbortController>();
	function clear() {
		++version;
		const prior = [...requests];
		requests.clear();
		invalidate();
		for (const request of prior) request.abort();
	}
	const remove = host.security.onInvalidate(clear);
	const stop = watch(
		() => {
			const state = host.security.state.value;
			return JSON.stringify([
				state.epoch,
				state.status,
				state.subject && scopeKey(state.subject)
			]);
		},
		clear,
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	return {
		clear,
		request(operationId: string, protectedRead = false): AccountRequest & { release(): void } {
			const controller = new AbortController();
			requests.add(controller);
			const revision = version;
			const state = host.security.state.value;
			const identity = state.subject && scopeKey(state.subject);
			return {
				operationId,
				signal: controller.signal,
				isCurrent: () =>
					!disposed &&
					!controller.signal.aborted &&
					revision === version &&
					(!protectedRead ||
						(host.security.state.value.status === 'authenticated' &&
							!!host.security.state.value.subject &&
							host.security.state.value.epoch === state.epoch &&
							scopeKey(host.security.state.value.subject) === identity)),
				release: () => requests.delete(controller)
			};
		},
		dispose() {
			disposed = true;
			stop();
			remove();
			clear();
		}
	};
}

/** 可选设置面板复用同一页面请求归属，不另建安全或写入状态机。 */
export { owner as createAccountRequestScope };

export function createRegistration(host: AccountHost, i18n?: AsamI18n) {
	const display = feedback<RegistrationField>(i18n);
	const { errors, message, sources, setMessage } = display;
	const draft = reactive<Registration & { confirm: string }>({
		account: '',
		email: '',
		password: '',
		confirm: '',
		consent: false
	});
	const status = ref<'idle' | 'pending' | 'success' | 'failure' | 'field-error' | 'unknown'>(
		'idle'
	);
	const operationId = ref('');
	const secretClear = () => {
		draft.password = '';
		draft.confirm = '';
	};
	const session = owner(host, () => {
		Object.assign(draft, { account: '', email: '', password: '', confirm: '', consent: false });
		status.value = 'idle';
		errors.value = {};
		sources.value = {};
		setMessage('');
		operationId.value = '';
	});
	function accept(result: WriteResult<RegistrationField>) {
		status.value = result.status;
		errors.value = result.status === 'field-error' ? result.fields : {};
		sources.value = {};
		if (result.status === 'success' || result.status === 'failure') setMessage(result.message);
		else if (result.status === 'unknown')
			setMessage('提交结果待核实，请勿重复注册', 'app.templates.account.registrationUnknown');
		else
			setMessage(
				'请检查标出的字段后重新填写密码',
				'app.templates.account.registrationFields'
			);
	}
	async function submit(blocked = false) {
		if (blocked || ['pending', 'unknown', 'success'].includes(status.value)) return false;
		try {
			sources.value = {};
			errors.value = registrationIssues(host, draft, sources.value);
		} catch {
			setMessage('字段校验未能完成', 'app.templates.account.validationFailed');
			return false;
		}
		if (Object.values(errors.value).some(Boolean)) {
			status.value = 'field-error';
			return false;
		}
		const input: Registration = {
			account: draft.account,
			email: draft.email,
			password: draft.password,
			consent: draft.consent
		};
		operationId.value = host.operationId();
		const request = session.request(operationId.value);
		status.value = 'pending';
		setMessage('');
		secretClear();
		try {
			const result = await host.services.register(input, request);
			if (!request.isCurrent()) return false;
			accept(result);
			return result.status === 'success';
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent()) accept({ status: 'unknown' });
			return false;
		} finally {
			input.password = '';
			request.release();
		}
	}
	async function verify(blocked = false) {
		if (blocked || status.value !== 'unknown' || !host.services.verifyRegistration)
			return false;
		const request = session.request(operationId.value);
		status.value = 'pending';
		try {
			const result = await host.services.verifyRegistration(operationId.value, request);
			if (request.isCurrent()) {
				if (result.status === 'not-written') {
					status.value = 'idle';
					setMessage(
						'已核实未写入，可重新填写密码后提交',
						'app.templates.account.registrationNotWritten'
					);
				} else accept(result);
				return result.status === 'success';
			}
			return false;
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent()) accept({ status: 'unknown' });
			return false;
		} finally {
			request.release();
		}
	}
	return {
		draft,
		status,
		errors,
		message,
		displayMessage: display.displayMessage,
		displayErrors: display.displayErrors,
		operationId,
		submit,
		verify,
		secretClear,
		clear: session.clear,
		dispose() {
			session.dispose();
			display.dispose();
		}
	};
}

type AccountNotificationField = 'notifications' | 'digest';
type LocalNotificationField = 'projectUpdates' | 'systemNotices';
export type NotificationChange = {
	field: AccountNotificationField | LocalNotificationField;
	value: boolean;
};

/** Optional page-local draft companion; never adds keys to AccountSettings or its payload. */
export interface AccountSettingsCompanion {
	dirty(): boolean;
	loaded(operationId: string): void;
	capture(operationId: string, notification?: NotificationChange): void;
	accept(operationId: string): void;
	rollbackNotification?(operationId: string): void;
	revert(): void;
	clear(): void;
}
export function createAccountData(
	host: AccountHost,
	i18n?: AsamI18n,
	companion?: AccountSettingsCompanion
) {
	const display = feedback<SettingsField>(i18n);
	const { errors, message, sources, setMessage } = display;
	const profile = ref<AccountProfile | null>(null);
	const profileStatus = ref<'idle' | 'loading' | 'ready' | 'empty' | 'error'>('idle');
	const draft = reactive(emptySettings());
	function replaceDraft(value: AccountSettings) {
		delete draft.biography;
		delete draft.officeArea;
		Object.assign(draft, value);
	}
	const original = ref(emptySettings());
	const settingsStatus = ref<'idle' | 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error'>('idle');
	const saveStatus = ref<'idle' | 'pending' | 'success' | 'failure' | 'field-error' | 'unknown'>(
		'idle'
	);
	const displayStatus = ref<'idle' | 'pending' | 'success' | 'error'>('idle');
	const operationId = ref('');
	let savedPayload: AccountSettings | undefined;
	let savedNotification: NotificationChange | undefined;
	const session = owner(host, () => {
		profile.value = null;
		profileStatus.value = 'idle';
		replaceDraft(emptySettings());
		original.value = emptySettings();
		settingsStatus.value = 'idle';
		saveStatus.value = 'idle';
		displayStatus.value = 'idle';
		errors.value = {};
		sources.value = {};
		setMessage('');
		operationId.value = '';
		savedPayload = undefined;
		savedNotification = undefined;
		companion?.clear();
	});
	const dirty = computed(
		() => JSON.stringify(draft) !== JSON.stringify(original.value) || !!companion?.dirty()
	);
	const subject = () =>
		host.security.state.value.status === 'authenticated'
			? host.security.state.value.subject
			: null;
	const allowed = (write = false) =>
		host.security.check({ permission: write ? 'account:write' : 'account:read', write }) ===
		'allowed';
	let profileRevision = 0,
		settingsRevision = 0;
	async function loadProfile(blocked = false) {
		const person = subject();
		if (blocked || !person || !allowed()) return;
		const revision = ++profileRevision;
		const request = session.request(host.operationId(), true);
		profile.value = null;
		profileStatus.value = 'loading';
		try {
			const result = await host.services.profile(person, request);
			if (request.isCurrent() && revision === profileRevision && allowed()) {
				profile.value = result && safeProfile(result);
				profileStatus.value = result ? 'ready' : 'empty';
			}
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent() && revision === profileRevision) profileStatus.value = 'error';
		} finally {
			request.release();
		}
	}
	async function loadSettings(blocked = false) {
		const person = subject();
		if (
			blocked ||
			!person ||
			!allowed() ||
			saveStatus.value === 'pending' ||
			saveStatus.value === 'unknown' ||
			dirty.value
		)
			return;
		const revision = ++settingsRevision;
		const request = session.request(host.operationId(), true);
		settingsStatus.value = 'loading';
		try {
			const result = await host.services.settings(person, request);
			if (request.isCurrent() && revision === settingsRevision && allowed()) {
				original.value = copySettings(result);
				replaceDraft(original.value);
				companion?.loaded(request.operationId);
				settingsStatus.value = 'ready';
			}
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent() && revision === settingsRevision)
				settingsStatus.value = 'error';
		} finally {
			request.release();
		}
	}
	function revert(blocked = false) {
		if (blocked || ['pending', 'unknown'].includes(saveStatus.value)) return;
		replaceDraft(original.value);
		companion?.revert();
		errors.value = {};
		sources.value = {};
		setMessage('');
		saveStatus.value = 'idle';
	}
	function accept(result: WriteResult<SettingsField>) {
		saveStatus.value = result.status;
		errors.value = result.status === 'field-error' ? result.fields : {};
		sources.value = {};
		if (result.status === 'success' && savedNotification)
			setMessage('通知偏好已保存', 'app.templates.account.notificationSaved');
		else if (result.status === 'success' || result.status === 'failure')
			setMessage(result.message);
		else if (result.status === 'unknown')
			setMessage('保存结果待核实，请勿再次保存', 'app.templates.account.saveUnknown');
		else setMessage('请检查标出的字段', 'app.templates.account.saveFields');
		if (result.status === 'success' && savedPayload) {
			original.value = copySettings(savedPayload);
			if (!savedNotification) replaceDraft(original.value);
			companion?.accept(operationId.value);
		} else if (result.status !== 'unknown') rollbackNotification();
	}
	function rollbackNotification() {
		const field = savedNotification?.field;
		if (field === 'notifications' || field === 'digest') draft[field] = original.value[field];
		if (field) companion?.rollbackNotification?.(operationId.value);
	}
	async function save(blocked = false, notification?: NotificationChange) {
		const person = subject();
		if (
			blocked ||
			!person ||
			!allowed(true) ||
			settingsStatus.value !== 'ready' ||
			(!notification && !dirty.value) ||
			['pending', 'unknown'].includes(saveStatus.value)
		)
			return false;
		const payload = notification ? copySettings(original.value) : copySettings(draft);
		const field = notification?.field;
		if (notification && (field === 'notifications' || field === 'digest')) {
			if (payload[field] === notification.value) return false;
			payload[field] = notification.value;
		} else if (notification && !companion) return false;
		sources.value = {};
		errors.value = settingsIssues(notification ? payload : draft, host, sources.value);
		if (Object.values(errors.value).some(Boolean)) {
			saveStatus.value = 'field-error';
			if (notification) setMessage('请检查标出的字段', 'app.templates.account.saveFields');
			return false;
		}
		operationId.value = host.operationId();
		savedPayload = payload;
		savedNotification = notification;
		const request = session.request(operationId.value, true);
		saveStatus.value = 'pending';
		setMessage('');
		displayStatus.value = 'idle';
		try {
			if (!request.isCurrent() || !allowed(true)) return false;
			companion?.capture(operationId.value, notification);
			if (notification && (field === 'notifications' || field === 'digest'))
				draft[field] = notification.value;
			const result = await host.services.save(person, savedPayload, request);
			if (!request.isCurrent() || !allowed()) return false;
			accept(result);
			return result.status === 'success';
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent()) accept({ status: 'unknown' });
			return false;
		} finally {
			request.release();
		}
	}
	async function verify(blocked = false) {
		const person = subject();
		if (
			blocked ||
			!person ||
			!allowed() ||
			saveStatus.value !== 'unknown' ||
			!host.services.verifySave
		)
			return false;
		const request = session.request(operationId.value, true);
		saveStatus.value = 'pending';
		try {
			const result: Verification<SettingsField> = await host.services.verifySave(
				person,
				operationId.value,
				request
			);
			if (request.isCurrent() && allowed()) {
				if (result.status === 'not-written') {
					rollbackNotification();
					saveStatus.value = 'idle';
					setMessage('已核实未写入，可重新保存', 'app.templates.account.saveNotWritten');
				} else accept(result);
				return result.status === 'success';
			}
			return false;
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent()) accept({ status: 'unknown' });
			return false;
		} finally {
			request.release();
		}
	}
	async function refreshDisplay(blocked = false) {
		const person = subject();
		if (
			blocked ||
			!person ||
			!allowed() ||
			saveStatus.value !== 'success' ||
			displayStatus.value === 'pending' ||
			!host.services.refreshDisplay
		)
			return;
		const request = session.request(operationId.value, true);
		displayStatus.value = 'pending';
		try {
			await host.services.refreshDisplay(person, request);
			if (request.isCurrent()) displayStatus.value = 'success';
		} catch {
			if (request.isCurrent()) displayStatus.value = 'error';
		} finally {
			request.release();
		}
	}
	return {
		profile,
		profileStatus,
		draft,
		original,
		dirty,
		settingsStatus,
		saveStatus,
		displayStatus,
		errors,
		message,
		displayMessage: display.displayMessage,
		displayErrors: display.displayErrors,
		operationId,
		allowed,
		loadProfile,
		loadSettings,
		revert,
		save,
		verify,
		refreshDisplay,
		clear: session.clear,
		dispose() {
			session.dispose();
			display.dispose();
		}
	};
}

export function loginDestination(host: AccountHost, value: unknown) {
	const path = safeReturnPath(value, '/account/profile');
	return host.canNavigate(path) ? path : undefined;
}
ts
import type { AsamFlowSize } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { createSecurity } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
type SecurityController = ReturnType<typeof createSecurity>;
import type { SecurityRequest, SecuritySubject } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';

export type AccountFamily = 'minimal' | 'brand' | 'tech';
export type AccountPage = 'login' | 'register' | 'profile' | 'settings';
export interface LoginCredentials {
	account: string;
	password: string;
}
export interface Registration extends LoginCredentials {
	email: string;
	consent: boolean;
}
export interface AccountSettings {
	displayName: string;
	email: string;
	phone: string;
	language: string;
	notifications: boolean;
	digest: boolean;
	/** 可选前端资料扩展；未接入的宿主继续只返回原六字段。 */
	biography?: string;
	officeArea?: string;
}
/** Display allowlist. Map backend DTOs at the host boundary. */
export interface AccountProfile {
	displayName: string;
	email: string;
	phone: string;
	organization: string;
	role: string;
	joined: string;
	avatar?: string;
	website?: string;
}
export type RegistrationField = 'account' | 'email' | 'password' | 'confirm' | 'consent';
export type SettingsField = keyof AccountSettings;
/** Messages are display-safe host text, never raw server exceptions/DTOs. */
export type WriteResult<K extends string> =
	| { status: 'success'; message: string }
	| { status: 'field-error'; fields: Partial<Record<K, string>> }
	| { status: 'failure'; message: string }
	| { status: 'unknown' };
export type Verification<K extends string> = WriteResult<K> | { status: 'not-written' };
export interface AccountRequest extends SecurityRequest {
	readonly operationId: string;
}
export interface AccountServices {
	/** Host must gate authentication/storage side effects with BOTH requests' isCurrent. */
	login(credentials: Readonly<LoginCredentials>, request: AccountRequest): Promise<boolean>;
	register(
		input: Readonly<Registration>,
		request: AccountRequest
	): Promise<WriteResult<RegistrationField>>;
	profile(subject: SecuritySubject, request: AccountRequest): Promise<AccountProfile | null>;
	settings(subject: SecuritySubject, request: AccountRequest): Promise<AccountSettings>;
	save(
		subject: SecuritySubject,
		settings: Readonly<AccountSettings>,
		request: AccountRequest
	): Promise<WriteResult<SettingsField>>;
	verifyRegistration?(
		operationId: string,
		request: AccountRequest
	): Promise<Verification<RegistrationField>>;
	verifySave?(
		subject: SecuritySubject,
		operationId: string,
		request: AccountRequest
	): Promise<Verification<SettingsField>>;
	/** Refresh the host's display projection only. Must not save again or mutate page drafts. */
	refreshDisplay?(subject: SecuritySubject, request: AccountRequest): Promise<void>;
}
export interface AccountHost {
	security: Pick<SecurityController, 'state' | 'check' | 'onInvalidate'>;
	services: AccountServices;
	/** Stable id for one mutation. Generate once, preserve through unknown/verification. */
	operationId(): string;
	/** Explicit host allowlist. safeReturnPath is always applied first. */
	canNavigate(path: string): boolean;
	navigate(path: string): void | Promise<void>;
	/** An escalation action, never an implicit retry. Receives no secrets or payload. */
	resolveUnknown(kind: 'register' | 'save', operationId: string): void;
	registration?: {
		accountLabel?: string;
		minimumPasswordLength?: number;
		requireConsent?: boolean;
		validate?(
			input: Readonly<Registration & { confirm: string }>
		): Partial<Record<RegistrationField, string>>;
	};
	languages?: readonly { value: string; label: string }[];
}
export interface AccountPageProps {
	host: AccountHost;
	brand?: string;
	accountLabel?: string;
	size?: AsamFlowSize;
	disabled?: boolean;
	readonly?: boolean;
	returnPath?: unknown;
}
export interface AccountPageEvents {
	page: [page: AccountPage];
	/** Register/save emit once per operation, on direct or verified success in the current page. */
	completed: [kind: 'login' | 'register' | 'save'];
}
export interface AccountPageExpose {
	clear(): void;
}
css
.asam-login-page.account-frame {
	--account-canvas: var(--asam-color-surface-page, #f7f8fa);
	--account-surface: var(--asam-color-surface, #fff);
	--account-ink: var(--asam-color-text-primary, #242933);
	--account-muted: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
	--account-line: var(--asam-color-border, #d5dbe2);
	--account-accent: var(--asam-semantic-primary-foreground);
	--account-radius: var(--asam-radius-card, 12px);
	--account-error: var(--asam-semantic-danger-foreground);
	font-family: var(--asam-typography-font-family);
	background: var(--account-canvas);
	color: var(--account-ink);
	box-sizing: border-box;
	min-height: 100%;
	padding: 40px max(32px, calc((100vw - 1184px) / 2));
	gap: 24px;
	align-content: stretch;
}
.account-frame *,
.account-frame *::before,
.account-frame *::after {
	box-sizing: border-box;
}
.account-frame > header {
	align-self: start;
}
.account-wordmark {
	display: inline-flex;
	gap: 16px;
	align-items: center;
	color: inherit;
	text-decoration: none;
	font-size: 27px;
	font-weight: 750;
	letter-spacing: -0.055em;
}
.account-wordmark span {
	font-size: 10px;
	letter-spacing: 0.18em;
	font-weight: 500;
	border-left: 1px solid var(--account-line);
	padding-left: 16px;
	color: var(--account-muted);
}
.account-frame .asam-login-content {
	width: 100%;
	min-width: 0;
	margin: 0;
}
.account-frame h1 {
	font-size: clamp(28px, 3vw, 38px);
	line-height: 1.2;
	font-weight: 650;
	letter-spacing: -0.035em;
	margin: 0 0 12px;
}
.account-frame h2 {
	margin: 0;
	font-size: 24px;
	font-weight: 600;
	line-height: 1.3;
}
.account-frame p {
	line-height: 1.65;
}
.account-location {
	margin: 0 0 18px;
	color: var(--account-muted);
	font-size: 12px;
}
.account-intro {
	margin: 0 0 28px;
	color: var(--account-muted);
	font-size: 14px;
}
.account-frame .el-form-item {
	margin-bottom: 18px;
}
.account-frame .el-form-item__label {
	color: var(--account-ink);
}
.account-frame .el-form:not(.el-form--inline) .el-form-item {
	display: block;
}
.account-frame .el-form:not(.el-form--inline) .el-form-item__label {
	float: none;
	display: block;
	padding: 0 0 6px;
	line-height: 1.5;
	height: auto;
	text-align: left;
	max-width: 100%;
	white-space: normal;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.account-frame .el-form:not(.el-form--inline) .el-form-item__label-wrap {
	float: none;
	display: block;
	width: 100%;
	max-width: 100%;
	/* This template intentionally uses stacked labels instead of native auto-width columns. */
	margin-left: 0 !important;
}
.account-frame .el-form-item__content {
	margin-left: 0;
}
.account-frame .el-input {
	width: 100%;
}
.account-actions {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: 12px;
	margin: 16px 0;
	align-items: center;
}
.account-frame button:not([class*='el-']) {
	white-space: normal;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.account-frame .account-message-button.el-button {
	min-width: 0;
	max-width: 100%;
	height: auto;
	min-height: var(--asam-control-height, var(--el-component-size));
	padding-block: var(--asam-space-xs, 4px);
}
.account-frame .account-message-button.el-button > span {
	min-width: 0;
	max-width: 100%;
	display: block;
}
.account-frame button:not([class*='el-']):active {
	transform: scale(0.985);
}
.account-frame a {
	color: var(--account-accent);
}
.account-frame a:focus-visible,
.account-frame button:not([class*='el-']):focus-visible,
.account-frame input:not([class*='el-']):focus-visible,
.account-frame select:not([class*='el-']):focus-visible {
	outline: 2px solid var(--account-ink);
	outline-offset: 3px;
}
.account-consent {
	display: inline-flex;
	gap: 10px;
	align-items: center;
	font-size: 13px;
	color: var(--account-ink);
	line-height: 1.5;
}
.account-consent input:not([class*='el-']) {
	width: 16px;
	height: 16px;
	accent-color: var(--account-accent);
}
.account-alternate {
	display: flex;
	gap: 12px;
	align-items: center;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	border-top: 1px solid var(--account-line);
	padding-top: 20px;
	margin-top: 24px;
	color: var(--account-muted);
	font-size: 14px;
}
.account-result {
	min-height: 1px;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.account-result:empty {
	display: none;
}
.account-result p {
	margin: 10px 0;
	font-size: 14px;
}
.account-result[role='alert'] {
	color: var(--account-error);
}
.account-frame .el-form-item__error {
	color: var(--account-error);
}
.account-select {
	width: 100%;
	padding: 4px 12px;
	border: 1px solid var(--account-line);
	background: var(--account-surface);
	color: var(--account-ink);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-control, 4px);
	font: inherit;
}
.account-person {
	display: flex;
	gap: 20px;
	align-items: center;
	margin: 32px 0;
}
.account-person-info {
	flex: 1;
	min-width: 0;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.account-person img,
.account-avatar {
	width: 72px;
	height: 72px;
	border-radius: 20px;
	object-fit: cover;
	flex: 0 0 auto;
}
.account-avatar {
	display: grid;
	place-items: center;
	background: var(--asam-color-surface-soft, #e1ecf4);
	color: var(--account-accent);
	font-size: 30px;
}
.account-person p {
	margin: 6px 0 0;
	color: var(--account-muted);
}
.account-details {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
	gap: 28px 32px;
	margin: 28px 0 40px;
}
.account-details dt {
	font-size: 12px;
	color: var(--account-muted);
	margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.account-details dd {
	margin: 0;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.account-leave {
	border-left: 3px solid var(--account-accent);
	padding: 0 16px;
}
.account-frame > footer {
	display: flex;
	gap: 24px;
	justify-content: space-between;
	align-self: end;
	color: var(--account-muted);
	font-size: 12px;
}
.account-minimal {
	grid-template-columns: 1fr minmax(300px, 440px) 1fr;
	grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto;
	background: var(--account-canvas);
}
.account-minimal > header,
.account-minimal > footer {
	grid-column: 1 / -1;
}
.account-minimal .asam-login-content {
	grid-column: 2;
	align-self: center;
	padding: 30px 0;
}
.account-minimal > aside {
	grid-column: 3;
	align-self: center;
	padding-left: 40px;
}
.account-minimal h1 {
	font-family: 'Palatino Linotype', 'Songti SC', serif;
	font-weight: 500;
	font-size: 38px;
}
.account-note {
	color: var(--account-muted);
	font-size: 13px;
}
.account-note p {
	font-size: 20px;
	color: var(--account-ink);
}
.account-line {
	display: block;
	height: 1px;
	width: 48px;
	background: var(--account-line);
	margin-bottom: 28px;
}
.account-brand {
	grid-template-columns: minmax(360px, 1fr) minmax(320px, 440px);
	grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto;
	column-gap: clamp(48px, 9vw, 144px);
}
.account-brand > header {
	grid-column: 1 / -1;
}
.account-brand > aside {
	grid-column: 1;
	grid-row: 2;
	align-self: center;
}
.account-brand .asam-login-content {
	grid-column: 2;
	grid-row: 2;
	align-self: center;
	padding: 24px 0;
}
.account-brand > footer {
	grid-column: 1 / -1;
}
.account-brand-panel h2 {
	font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 64px);
	line-height: 1.15;
	letter-spacing: -0.05em;
	margin: 44px 0 24px;
}
.account-brand-panel p {
	color: var(--account-muted);
	font-size: 16px;
}
.account-orbit {
	width: 210px;
	height: 160px;
	position: relative;
}
.account-orbit i {
	position: absolute;
	width: 132px;
	height: 132px;
	border: 22px solid var(--account-accent);
	border-radius: 50%;
	opacity: 0.16;
}
.account-orbit i:nth-child(2) {
	left: 64px;
	top: 30px;
	opacity: 0.35;
}
.account-orbit i:nth-child(3) {
	left: 20px;
	top: 15px;
	border-width: 1px;
	opacity: 0.75;
}
.asam-login-page.account-tech {
	grid-template-columns: minmax(260px, 1fr) minmax(340px, 520px);
	grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto;
	column-gap: 80px;
	background-image:
		linear-gradient(
			color-mix(in srgb, var(--account-accent) 4%, transparent) 1px,
			transparent 1px
		),
		linear-gradient(
			90deg,
			color-mix(in srgb, var(--account-accent) 4%, transparent) 1px,
			transparent 1px
		);
	background-size: 48px 48px;
}
.account-tech > header,
.account-tech > footer {
	grid-column: 1 / -1;
}
.account-tech > aside {
	grid-column: 1;
	grid-row: 2;
	align-self: center;
}
.account-tech .asam-login-content {
	grid-column: 2;
	grid-row: 2;
	align-self: center;
	padding: 36px;
	border: 1px solid var(--account-line);
	border-radius: 24px;
	background: var(--account-surface);
	box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--account-ink) 3%, transparent);
}
.account-tech .account-location {
	font-family: Consolas, monospace;
	letter-spacing: 0.12em;
}
.account-tech-panel h2 {
	font-size: clamp(32px, 3.6vw, 48px);
	margin: 30px 0 16px;
}
.account-tech-panel p {
	color: var(--account-muted);
}
.account-geometry {
	width: 230px;
	height: 180px;
	position: relative;
	perspective: 600px;
}
.account-geometry i {
	position: absolute;
	inset: 12px 30px;
	border: 1px solid var(--account-accent);
	transform: rotate(-20deg) skew(12deg);
	border-radius: 24px;
	opacity: 0.65;
}
.account-geometry i:nth-child(2) {
	transform: translate(20px, 12px) rotate(-20deg) skew(12deg);
	opacity: 0.35;
}
.account-geometry i:nth-child(3) {
	transform: translate(40px, 24px) rotate(-20deg) skew(12deg);
	opacity: 0.15;
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
	.account-frame .asam-login-content {
		animation: account-enter 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
	}
	.account-frame button:not([class*='el-']) {
		transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
	}
}
@keyframes account-enter {
	from {
		transform: translateY(8px);
	}
	to {
		transform: translateY(0);
	}
}
@media (max-width: 767px) {
	.asam-login-page.account-frame {
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		min-height: 100%;
		padding: 24px 20px;
		gap: 28px;
	}
	.account-frame .asam-login-content {
		padding: 8px 0;
		flex: 1;
	}
	.account-frame h1,
	.account-minimal h1 {
		font-size: 30px;
	}
	.account-frame > aside {
		padding: 0;
	}
	.account-minimal > aside {
		display: none;
	}
	.account-brand > aside {
		order: 0;
	}
	.account-brand-panel {
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		gap: 20px;
	}
	.account-brand-panel h2 {
		font-size: 24px;
		margin: 0;
	}
	.account-brand-panel p {
		display: none;
	}
	.account-orbit {
		width: 90px;
		height: 84px;
		flex: 0 0 auto;
	}
	.account-orbit i {
		width: 64px;
		height: 64px;
		border-width: 10px;
	}
	.account-orbit i:nth-child(2) {
		left: 25px;
		top: 14px;
	}
	.account-orbit i:nth-child(3) {
		left: 10px;
		top: 5px;
	}
	.account-tech .asam-login-content {
		padding: 24px 18px;
		border-radius: 18px;
	}
	.account-tech > aside {
		display: none;
	}
	.account-details {
		gap: 24px 16px;
	}
	.account-frame > footer {
		width: 100%;
	}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
	.account-frame *,
	.account-frame *::before,
	.account-frame *::after {
		animation: none;
		transition: none;
		scroll-behavior: auto;
	}
}
vue
<template>
	<main class="login-template login-brand">
		<header>
			<div class="login-wordmark">
				{{ brandTitle }}<span>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.wordmark') }}</span>
			</div>
		</header>
		<aside class="login-aside">
			<div class="login-orbit" aria-hidden="true"><i /><i /><i /></div>
			<div>
				<h2>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.brandNote') }}</h2>
				<p>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.brandIntro') }}</p>
			</div>
		</aside>

		<section class="login-content" :data-login-state="state" :aria-label="title">
			<p class="login-location">{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.entry') }}</p>
			<h1>{{ title }}</h1>
			<p class="login-description">{{ description }}</p>
			<AsamBaseForm
				class="login-form"
				novalidate
				:aria-busy="pending"
				@submit.prevent="submitFromForm"
				@keydown.enter="enter"
			>
				<div class="login-field">
					<label :for="id + '-account'">{{ accountLabel }}</label>
					<AsamInput
						ref="accountInput"
						:id="id + '-account'"
						:model-value="draft.username"
						@update:model-value="
							(value) => {
								draft.username = String(value);
							}
						"
						name="username"
						autocomplete="username"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="inputLocked"
						:readonly="readonly"
						v-bind="{
							'aria-invalid': !!(fieldErrors.account || undefined) || undefined,
							'aria-describedby': fieldErrors.account
								? id + '-account-error'
								: undefined
						}"
					/>
					<p
						v-if="fieldErrors.account"
						:id="id + '-account-error'"
						class="login-error"
						role="alert"
					>
						{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.requiredAccount') }}
					</p>
				</div>
				<div class="login-field">
					<label :for="id + '-password'">{{
						i18n.t('app.templates.account.password')
					}}</label>
					<AsamPassword
						ref="passwordInput"
						:id="id + '-password'"
						:model-value="draft.password"
						@update:model-value="
							(value) => {
								draft.password = String(value);
							}
						"
						name="password"
						autocomplete="current-password"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="inputLocked"
						:readonly="readonly"
						v-bind="{
							'aria-invalid': !!(fieldErrors.password || undefined) || undefined,
							'aria-describedby': fieldErrors.password
								? id + '-password-error'
								: undefined
						}"
					/>
					<p
						v-if="fieldErrors.password"
						:id="id + '-password-error'"
						class="login-error"
						role="alert"
					>
						{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.requiredPassword') }}
					</p>
				</div>
				<p v-if="message" class="login-error" role="alert">{{ message }}</p>
				<p v-if="state === 'success'" role="status">
					{{ i18n.t('pro.form.loginSuccess') }}
				</p>
				<AsamButton
					class="login-submit"
					type="primary"
					native-type="submit"
					:size="size"
					:loading="pending"
					:disabled="locked"
					>{{ i18n.t(pending ? 'pro.form.loginPending' : 'pro.form.login') }}</AsamButton
				>
			</AsamBaseForm>
			<div v-if="showRegistration" class="login-alternate">
				<span>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.noAccount') }}</span>
				<AsamButton
					native-type="button"
					:size="size"
					:disabled="disabled || readonly || pending"
					@click="$emit('page', 'register')"
					>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.create') }}</AsamButton
				>
			</div>
		</section>
	</main>
</template>
<script lang="ts">
import { AsamBaseForm } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {} from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';

				'app.templates.account.minimalContinue': '你的工作，从这里继续。',
				'app.templates.account.brandNote': '把想法\n带进日常。',
				'app.templates.account.brandIntro':
					'连接你的工作与团队，让每一次协作都有清晰的起点。',
				'app.templates.account.techNote': '专注连接，从容掌控。',
				'app.templates.account.techIntro': '一个账户，继续你的应用工作区。',
				'app.templates.account.minimalLogin': '欢迎回来',
				'app.templates.account.brandLogin': '回到你的工作空间',
				'app.templates.account.brandDescription': '与团队的下一次协作，从这里开始。',
				'app.templates.account.techLogin': '连接工作空间',
				'app.templates.account.techDescription': '验证账户后，继续你的应用会话。',
				'app.templates.account.requiredAccount': '请填写账户',
				'app.templates.account.requiredPassword': '请填写密码',
				'app.templates.account.loginRejected': '登录未能完成，请检查账户后重试',
				'app.templates.account.loginFailed': '登录未能完成，请重试',
				'app.templates.account.returnDenied': '应用未允许此返回路径',
				'app.templates.account.navigationFailed':
					'登录已完成，页面跳转失败，请使用应用导航',
				'app.templates.account.wordmark': '账户'
			}
		});
		const id = useId();
		const draft = reactive({ username: props.initialUsername, password: '' });
		const accountInput = ref<InstanceType<typeof AsamInput>>();
		const passwordInput = ref<InstanceType<typeof AsamPassword>>();
		const state = ref<'idle' | 'pending' | 'failure' | 'success'>('idle');
		const pending = computed(() => state.value === 'pending');
		const locked = computed(
			() => !!props.disabled || !!props.readonly || pending.value || state.value === 'success'
		);
		const inputLocked = computed(
			() => !!props.disabled || pending.value || state.value === 'success'
		);
		const fieldErrors = reactive({ account: false, password: false });
		const messageKey = ref<'' | 'app.templates.account.loginFailed'>('');
		const safeError = ref('');
		const title = computed(() => props.heading ?? i18n.t('app.templates.account.brandLogin'));
		const description = computed(
			() => props.supportText ?? i18n.t('app.templates.account.brandDescription')
		);
		const accountLabel = computed(() => i18n.t('app.templates.account.account'));
		const message = computed(
			() => safeError.value || (messageKey.value ? i18n.t(messageKey.value) : '')
		);
		let revision = 0;
		let disposed = false;
		let requestAbort: AbortController | undefined;
		function setState(value: typeof state.value) {
			const wasPending = pending.value;
			state.value = value;
			if (wasPending !== pending.value) emit('pending', pending.value);
		}
		/** Only cancels this template; the injected host retains session/logout APIs. */
		function cancel() {
			++revision;
			requestAbort?.abort();
			requestAbort = undefined;
			draft.password = '';
			messageKey.value = '';
			safeError.value = '';
			fieldErrors.account = false;
			fieldErrors.password = false;
			setState('idle');
		}
		function reset() {
			cancel();
			draft.username = props.initialUsername;
		}
		function clear() {
			cancel();
			draft.username = '';
		}
		async function submit() {
			if (locked.value || disposed) return false;
			messageKey.value = '';
			safeError.value = '';
			fieldErrors.account = !draft.username.trim();
			fieldErrors.password = !draft.password;
			if (fieldErrors.account || fieldErrors.password) {
				await nextTick();
				if (!disposed) {
					if (fieldErrors.account) accountInput.value?.focus();
					else if (fieldErrors.password) passwordInput.value?.focus();
				}
				return false;
			}
			const token = ++revision;
			const controller = new AbortController();
			requestAbort = controller;
			const authenticate = props.authenticate;
			const current = () =>
				!disposed &&
				token === revision &&
				!controller.signal.aborted &&
				authenticate === props.authenticate &&
				!props.disabled &&
				!props.readonly;
			const credentials = { username: draft.username.trim(), password: draft.password };
			setState('pending');
			try {
				await authenticate(credentials, { signal: controller.signal });
				if (!current()) return false;
				draft.password = '';
				setState('success');
				emit('success');
				if (current()) emit('completed', 'login');
				return true;
			} catch (error) {
				if (!current()) return false;
				let display = '';
				try {
					display = props.formatError?.(error) ?? '';
				} catch {
					display = '';
				}
				safeError.value = typeof display === 'string' ? display.slice(0, 500) : '';
				messageKey.value = 'app.templates.account.loginFailed';
				setState('failure');
				return false;
			} finally {
				credentials.password = '';
				if (token === revision) {
					draft.password = '';
					requestAbort = undefined;
					if (pending.value) setState('idle');
				}
			}
		}
		function submitFromForm() {
			void submit();
		}
		function enter(event: KeyboardEvent) {
			if (event.isComposing || event.keyCode === 229) event.preventDefault();
		}
		watch(
			() => [props.disabled, props.readonly, props.authenticate, props.initialUsername],
			reset,
			{
				flush: 'sync'
			}
		);
		onBeforeUnmount(() => {
			disposed = true;
			cancel();
		});
		expose({ clear, reset, cancel, submit });

		return {
			clear,
			reset,
			cancel,
			submit,
			i18n,
			id,
			draft,
			accountInput,
			passwordInput,
			state,
			pending,
			locked,
			inputLocked,
			fieldErrors,
			title,
			description,
			accountLabel,
			message,
			submitFromForm,
			enter
		};
	}
});
</script>

ts
import { reactive } from 'vue';
import { createSecurity } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import { createRequestClient, TransportFault } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import { createLatestRequest } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import type {
	AccountHost,
	AccountProfile,
	AccountRequest,
	AccountSettings,
	LoginCredentials,
	RegistrationField,
	SettingsField,
	WriteResult
} from '../Types.js';
import type { SecuritySubject } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';

export const exampleBrand = 'ASAM';
export const exampleAccountLabel = '账户';
export type FixtureMode = 'success' | 'failure' | 'field-error' | 'unknown' | 'empty' | 'late';
/** Synthetic local adapter. No fetch, URL, cookie, token, storage or real account. */
export function createAccountFixture(
	i18n?: AsamI18n,
	profileFields?: Pick<AccountSettings, 'biography' | 'officeArea'>
) {
	const controls = reactive({
		mode: 'success' as FixtureMode,
		delay: 0,
		refreshFailure: false,
		readOnly: false
	});
	const audit = reactive({
		login: 0,
		lastAccount: '',
		register: 0,
		save: 0,
		profile: 0,
		settings: 0,
		verify: 0,
		refresh: 0,
		disposed: false,
		navigations: [] as string[],
		escalations: [] as string[]
	});
	let sequence = 0;
	let currentId: string | number = 0;
	let profileName = '林予安';
	let settings: AccountSettings = {
		displayName: '林予安',
		email: 'lin@example.invalid',
		phone: '+86 010 5555 0186',
		language: 'zh-CN',
		notifications: true,
		digest: false,
		...(typeof profileFields?.biography === 'string'
			? { biography: profileFields.biography }
			: {}),
		...(typeof profileFields?.officeArea === 'string'
			? { officeArea: profileFields.officeArea }
			: {})
	};
	const operations = new Map<string, WriteResult<SettingsField | RegistrationField>>();
	const wait = () => new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, controls.delay));
	const subject = (): SecuritySubject => ({
		id: currentId,
		name: profileName,
		roles: ['member'],
		permissions: ['account:read', 'account:write'],
		scope: { tenant: 0, organization: 0 },
		contexts: [
			{ tenant: 0, organization: 0, label: '演示团队' },
			{ tenant: '0', organization: '0', label: '演示团队 B' }
		],
		expiresAt: Date.now() + 3600000,
		readOnly: controls.readOnly
	});
	const security = createSecurity<LoginCredentials & { caller: AccountRequest }>({
		i18n,
		adapter: {
			async login(credentials, request) {
				audit.login++;
				audit.lastAccount = credentials.account;
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent() || !credentials.caller.isCurrent())
					throw new Error('Cancelled');
				if (controls.mode === 'failure') throw new Error('Synthetic failure');
				return subject();
			},
			async restore(request) {
				await wait();
				return request.isCurrent() ? subject() : null;
			},
			async refresh(_subject, request) {
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent()) throw new Error('Cancelled');
				return subject();
			},
			async switchContext(person, scope, request) {
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent()) throw new Error('Cancelled');
				return { ...person, scope };
			},
			async logout() {
				await wait();
			}
		}
	});
	const client = createRequestClient({
		i18n,
		transport: async (input) => {
			const mode = controls.mode;
			const delay = controls.delay;
			await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delay));
			if (mode === 'failure') throw new TransportFault('network');
			if (input.url === 'fixture:profile') {
				audit.profile++;
				const person = input.data as SecuritySubject;
				return {
					mode: 'data',
					data:
						mode === 'empty'
							? null
							: {
									displayName: person.id === 0 ? profileName : '顾行舟',
									email: settings.email,
									phone: settings.phone,
									organization: `演示组织 ${String(person.scope.organization)}`,
									role: '应用成员',
									joined: '2026-10-01',
									secret: 'must-not-render'
								}
				};
			}
			if (input.url === 'fixture:settings') {
				audit.settings++;
				return { mode: 'data', data: { ...settings } };
			}
			throw new TransportFault('unknown');
		}
	});
	const host: AccountHost = {
		security,
		operationId: () => `synthetic-${++sequence}`,
		canNavigate: (path) => ['/account/profile', '/account/settings'].includes(path),
		navigate: (path) => {
			audit.navigations.push(path);
		},
		resolveUnknown: (kind, id) => {
			audit.escalations.push(`${kind}:${id}`);
		},
		services: {
			login: (credentials, caller) => security.login({ ...credentials, caller }),
			async register(input, request) {
				audit.register++;
				const mode = controls.mode;
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent()) return { status: 'unknown' };
				const result: WriteResult<RegistrationField> =
					mode === 'field-error'
						? { status: 'field-error', fields: { email: '该邮箱已用于合成账户' } }
						: mode === 'failure'
							? { status: 'failure', message: '演示注册失败，可修改后重试' }
							: { status: 'success', message: `账户 ${input.account} 已创建` };
				operations.set(request.operationId, result);
				return mode === 'unknown' ? { status: 'unknown' } : result;
			},
			async profile(person, request) {
				// Each page read owns a Latest wrapper, never a shared mutable global request slot.
				const latest = createLatestRequest<AccountProfile | null>(client, () => undefined);
				try {
					return await latest.load(
						{ url: 'fixture:profile', data: person },
						{
							signal: request.signal,
							decode: (value) => value as AccountProfile | null
						}
					);
				} finally {
					latest.dispose();
				}
			},
			settings: (_person, request) =>
				client.request(
					{ url: 'fixture:settings' },
					{ signal: request.signal, decode: (value) => value as AccountSettings }
				),
			async save(_person, input, request) {
				audit.save++;
				const mode = controls.mode;
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent()) return { status: 'unknown' };
				const result: WriteResult<SettingsField> =
					mode === 'field-error'
						? { status: 'field-error', fields: { email: '此邮箱未通过应用规则' } }
						: mode === 'failure'
							? { status: 'failure', message: '演示保存被拒绝，请修改后重试' }
							: { status: 'success', message: '账户设置已保存' };
				if (result.status === 'success') settings = { ...input };
				operations.set(request.operationId, result);
				return mode === 'unknown' ? { status: 'unknown' } : result;
			},
			async verifyRegistration(id, request) {
				audit.verify++;
				await wait();
				return request.isCurrent()
					? ((operations.get(id) as WriteResult<RegistrationField>) ?? {
							status: 'not-written'
						})
					: { status: 'unknown' };
			},
			async verifySave(_subject, id, request) {
				audit.verify++;
				await wait();
				return request.isCurrent()
					? ((operations.get(id) as WriteResult<SettingsField>) ?? {
							status: 'not-written'
						})
					: { status: 'unknown' };
			},
			async refreshDisplay(_subject, request) {
				audit.refresh++;
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent() || controls.refreshFailure)
					throw new Error('Synthetic display failure');
				profileName = settings.displayName;
			}
		}
	};
	return {
		host,
		controls,
		audit,
		security,
		client,
		async identity(id: string | number) {
			currentId = id;
			await security.restore();
		},
		dispose() {
			audit.disposed = true;
			security.dispose();
			client.dispose();
		}
	};
}
ts
export { default as MinimalLogin } from './minimal/Login.vue';

import { AsamBaseForm } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {} from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
/** Local message declarations travel with this single SFC. */
declare module '@asam-ui/ui/i18n' {
	interface AsamI18nMessageParameters {
		'app.templates.account.account': Record<never, never>;
		'app.templates.account.brandDescription': Record<never, never>;
		'app.templates.account.brandIntro': Record<never, never>;
		'app.templates.account.brandLogin': Record<never, never>;
		'app.templates.account.brandNote': Record<never, never>;
		'app.templates.account.create': Record<never, never>;
		'app.templates.account.entry': Record<never, never>;
		'app.templates.account.loginFailed': Record<never, never>;
		'app.templates.account.loginRejected': Record<never, never>;
		'app.templates.account.minimalContinue': Record<never, never>;
		'app.templates.account.minimalIntro': Record<never, never>;
		'app.templates.account.minimalLogin': Record<never, never>;
		'app.templates.account.minimalNote': Record<never, never>;
		'app.templates.account.navigationFailed': Record<never, never>;
		'app.templates.account.noAccount': Record<never, never>;
		'app.templates.account.password': Record<never, never>;
		'app.templates.account.requiredAccount': Record<never, never>;
		'app.templates.account.requiredPassword': Record<never, never>;
		'app.templates.account.returnDenied': Record<never, never>;
		'app.templates.account.techDescription': Record<never, never>;
		'app.templates.account.techIntro': Record<never, never>;
		'app.templates.account.techLogin': Record<never, never>;
		'app.templates.account.techNote': Record<never, never>;
		'app.templates.account.wordmark': Record<never, never>;
	}

import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, reactive, ref, useId, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamInput, AsamPassword } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAsamProI18n } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { defineComponent } from 'vue';
import type { PropType } from 'vue';
export default defineComponent({
	name: 'MinimalAccountLogin',
	inheritAttrs: false,
	components: { AsamBaseForm, AsamInput, AsamPassword, AsamButton },
	props: {
		authenticate: {
			type: Function as PropType<
				(
					credentials: { username: string; password: string },
					context: { signal: AbortSignal }
				) => Promise<void>
			>,
			required: true
		},
		brandTitle: { type: String, default: 'ASAM基础开发平台' },
		heading: String,
		supportText: String,
		initialUsername: { type: String, default: '' },
		size: { type: String as PropType<AsamControlSize>, default: 'default' },
		disabled: Boolean,
		readonly: Boolean,
		showRegistration: { type: Boolean, default: true },
		formatError: Function as PropType<(error: unknown) => string>
	},
	emits: {
		page: (_page: 'login' | 'register' | 'profile' | 'settings') => true,
		completed: (_kind: 'login' | 'register' | 'save') => true,
		success: () => true,
		pending: (_value: boolean) => true
	},
	setup(props, { emit, expose }) {
		const i18n = useAsamProI18n({
			en: {
				'app.templates.account.minimalIntro':
					'Use your account to continue your work today.',
				'app.templates.account.account': 'Account',
				'app.templates.account.password': 'Password',
				'app.templates.account.create': 'Create account',
				'app.templates.account.noAccount': 'Do not have an account?',
				'app.templates.account.entry': 'Account entry',
				'app.templates.account.minimalNote':
					'Make room to focus on what is in front of you.',
				'app.templates.account.minimalContinue': 'Continue your work here.',
				'app.templates.account.brandNote': 'Bring ideas into everyday life.',
				'app.templates.account.brandIntro':
					'Connect your work and team with a clear starting point for every collaboration.',
				'app.templates.account.techNote': 'Connect with focus. Work with confidence.',
				'app.templates.account.techIntro':
					'One account to continue your application workspace.',
				'app.templates.account.minimalLogin': 'Welcome back',
				'app.templates.account.brandLogin': 'Return to your workspace',
				'app.templates.account.brandDescription':
					'Your next team collaboration starts here.',
				'app.templates.account.techLogin': 'Connect to your workspace',
				'app.templates.account.techDescription':
					'Verify your account to continue your application session.',
				'app.templates.account.requiredAccount': 'Enter your account',
				'app.templates.account.requiredPassword': 'Enter your password',
				'app.templates.account.loginRejected':
					'Login did not complete. Check your account and retry.',
				'app.templates.account.loginFailed': 'Login did not complete. Please retry.',
				'app.templates.account.returnDenied':
					'The application does not allow this return path.',
				'app.templates.account.navigationFailed':
					'Login completed, but navigation failed. Use the application navigation.',
				'app.templates.account.wordmark': 'ACCOUNT'
			},
			'zh-CN': {
				'app.templates.account.minimalIntro': '使用你的账户，继续今天的工作。',
				'app.templates.account.account': '账户',
				'app.templates.account.password': '密码',
				'app.templates.account.create': '创建账户',
				'app.templates.account.noAccount': '还没有账户？',
				'app.templates.account.entry': '账户入口',
				'app.templates.account.minimalNote': '留一点空间，专注眼前的事。',
				'app.templates.account.minimalContinue': '你的工作，从这里继续。',
				'app.templates.account.brandNote': '把想法带进日常。',
				'app.templates.account.brandIntro':
					'连接你的工作与团队，让每一次协作都有清晰的起点。',
				'app.templates.account.techNote': '专注连接，从容掌控。',
				'app.templates.account.techIntro': '一个账户，继续你的应用工作区。',
				'app.templates.account.minimalLogin': '欢迎回来',
				'app.templates.account.brandLogin': '回到你的工作空间',
				'app.templates.account.brandDescription': '与团队的下一次协作，从这里开始。',
				'app.templates.account.techLogin': '连接工作空间',
				'app.templates.account.techDescription': '验证账户后，继续你的应用会话。',
				'app.templates.account.requiredAccount': '请填写账户',
				'app.templates.account.requiredPassword': '请填写密码',
				'app.templates.account.loginRejected': '登录未能完成，请检查账户后重试',
				'app.templates.account.loginFailed': '登录未能完成，请重试',
				'app.templates.account.returnDenied': '应用未允许此返回路径',
				'app.templates.account.navigationFailed':
					'登录已完成，页面跳转失败，请使用应用导航',
				'app.templates.account.wordmark': '账户'
			}
		});
		const id = useId();
		const draft = reactive({ username: props.initialUsername, password: '' });
		const accountInput = ref<InstanceType<typeof AsamInput>>();
		const passwordInput = ref<InstanceType<typeof AsamPassword>>();
		const state = ref<'idle' | 'pending' | 'failure' | 'success'>('idle');
		const pending = computed(() => state.value === 'pending');
		const locked = computed(
			() => !!props.disabled || !!props.readonly || pending.value || state.value === 'success'
		);
		const inputLocked = computed(
			() => !!props.disabled || pending.value || state.value === 'success'
		);
		const fieldErrors = reactive({ account: false, password: false });
		const messageKey = ref<'' | 'app.templates.account.loginFailed'>('');
		const safeError = ref('');
		const title = computed(() => props.heading ?? i18n.t('app.templates.account.minimalLogin'));
		const description = computed(
			() => props.supportText ?? i18n.t('app.templates.account.minimalIntro')
		);
		const accountLabel = computed(() => i18n.t('app.templates.account.account'));
		const message = computed(
			() => safeError.value || (messageKey.value ? i18n.t(messageKey.value) : '')
		);
		let revision = 0;
		let disposed = false;
		let requestAbort: AbortController | undefined;
		function setState(value: typeof state.value) {
			const wasPending = pending.value;
			state.value = value;
			if (wasPending !== pending.value) emit('pending', pending.value);
		}
		/** Only cancels this template; the injected host retains session/logout APIs. */
		function cancel() {
			++revision;
			requestAbort?.abort();
			requestAbort = undefined;
			draft.password = '';
			messageKey.value = '';
			safeError.value = '';
			fieldErrors.account = false;
			fieldErrors.password = false;
			setState('idle');
		}
		function reset() {
			cancel();
			draft.username = props.initialUsername;
		}
		function clear() {
			cancel();
			draft.username = '';
		}
		async function submit() {
			if (locked.value || disposed) return false;
			messageKey.value = '';
			safeError.value = '';
			fieldErrors.account = !draft.username.trim();
			fieldErrors.password = !draft.password;
			if (fieldErrors.account || fieldErrors.password) {
				await nextTick();
				if (!disposed) {
					if (fieldErrors.account) accountInput.value?.focus();
					else if (fieldErrors.password) passwordInput.value?.focus();
				}
				return false;
			}
			const token = ++revision;
			const controller = new AbortController();
			requestAbort = controller;
			const authenticate = props.authenticate;
			const current = () =>
				!disposed &&
				token === revision &&
				!controller.signal.aborted &&
				authenticate === props.authenticate &&
				!props.disabled &&
				!props.readonly;
			const credentials = { username: draft.username.trim(), password: draft.password };
			setState('pending');
			try {
				await authenticate(credentials, { signal: controller.signal });
				if (!current()) return false;
				draft.password = '';
				setState('success');
				emit('success');
				if (current()) emit('completed', 'login');
				return true;
			} catch (error) {
				if (!current()) return false;
				let display = '';
				try {
					display = props.formatError?.(error) ?? '';
				} catch {
					display = '';
				}
				safeError.value = typeof display === 'string' ? display.slice(0, 500) : '';

				setState('failure');
				return false;
			} finally {
				credentials.password = '';

					draft.password = '';
					requestAbort = undefined;
					if (pending.value) setState('idle');
				}

		}
		function enter(event: KeyboardEvent) {
			if (event.isComposing || event.keyCode === 229) event.preventDefault();
		}

			() => [props.disabled, props.readonly, props.authenticate, props.initialUsername],
			reset,

				flush: 'sync'

		);

			disposed = true;
			cancel();
		});

			clear,
			reset,
			cancel,
			submit,
			i18n,
			id,
			draft,
			accountInput,
			passwordInput,
			state,
			pending,
			locked,
			inputLocked,
			fieldErrors,
			title,
			description,
			accountLabel,
			message,
			submitFromForm,
			enter
		};
	}
});

import { onBeforeUnmount, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import type { Ref } from 'vue';

/** Carry the actual host scope's ASAM/EP variables across a public body teleport.
 * No global theme writes and no duplicate token-generation algorithm. */
export function useScopedDialogStyle(origin: Ref<HTMLElement | undefined>, open: () => boolean) {
	const variables = shallowRef<Record<string, string>>({});
	let observer: MutationObserver | undefined;
	function collect() {
		if (!open() || !origin.value) return;
		const style = getComputedStyle(origin.value);
		variables.value = Object.fromEntries(
			Array.from(style)
				.filter((key) => key.startsWith('--asam-') || key.startsWith('--el-'))
				.map((key) => [key, style.getPropertyValue(key)])
		);
	}
	function stop() {
		observer?.disconnect();
		observer = undefined;
		window.removeEventListener('resize', collect);
	}
	watch(
		open,
		(value) => {
			stop();
			if (!value || !origin.value) return;
			collect();
			observer = new MutationObserver(collect);
			for (
				let node: HTMLElement | null = origin.value.parentElement;
				node;
				node = node.parentElement
			)
				observer.observe(node, {
					attributes: true,
					attributeFilter: ['style', 'class', 'data-color-mode']
				});
			window.addEventListener('resize', collect);
		},
		{ flush: 'post' }
	);
	onBeforeUnmount(stop);
	return variables;
}

type CompleteSettingsParameters = { [K in keyof typeof zh]: Record<never, never> };
export type CompleteSettingsLabel =
	keyof typeof zh extends `app.templates.settingsComplete.${infer Label}` ? Label : never;
declare module '@asam-ui/ui/i18n' {
	// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-empty-object-type -- 本页独立语言命名空间。
	interface AsamI18nMessageParameters extends CompleteSettingsParameters {}
}
export function useCompleteSettingsText() {
	const i18n = useAsamProI18n({ 'zh-CN': zh, en });
	return {
		i18n,
		t: (key: CompleteSettingsLabel) =>
			i18n.t(...([`app.templates.settingsComplete.${key}`] as Parameters<AsamI18n['t']>))
	};
}

<template>
	<span ref="origin" hidden aria-hidden="true"></span
	><AsamDialog
		:style="dialogStyle"
		:model-value="open"
		:title="t('leaveTitle')"
		width="min(440px, calc(100vw - 32px))"
		:close-on-click-modal="false"
		append-to-body
		@update:model-value="!$event && emit('cancel')"
		><p>{{ t(unknown ? 'unknownLeave' : 'leaveWarning') }}</p>
		<template #footer
			><AsamButton type="primary" :size="size" @click="emit('cancel')">{{
				t(unknown ? 'resolveFirst' : 'stay')
			}}</AsamButton
			><AsamButton
				v-if="!unknown"
				type="primary"
				:size="size"
				:disabled="disabled"
				@click="emit('leave')"
				>{{ t('discardLeave') }}</AsamButton
			></template
		></AsamDialog
	>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamDialog, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { useScopedDialogStyle } from './DialogStyle.js';
import type { AsamFlowSize } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { useCompleteSettingsText } from './I18n.js';
const props = defineProps<{
	open: boolean;
	unknown: boolean;
	disabled?: boolean;
	size?: AsamFlowSize;
}>();
const origin = ref<HTMLElement>();
const dialogStyle = useScopedDialogStyle(origin, () => props.open);
const emit = defineEmits<{ cancel: []; leave: [] }>();
const { t } = useCompleteSettingsText();
</script>

<template>
	<section class="settings-actions" :aria-label="title">
		<h2>{{ title }}</h2>
		<AsamEmpty v-if="!owned || !items?.length" :description="t('noActions')" />
		<div v-for="item in owned ? items : []" :key="item.id" class="settings-action-row">
			<div>
				<h3>{{ item.title }}</h3>
				<p>{{ item.description }}</p>
				<p class="settings-action-state">{{ owned ? item.status : t('notConnected') }}</p>
			</div>

				type="primary"
				plain
				:size="size"
				:disabled="!canOpen(item) || !!pending"
				:loading="pending === item.id"
				@click="open(item)"
				>{{ item.actionLabel }}</AsamButton
			>
		</div>
		<p role="status" aria-live="polite">{{ feedback ? t(feedback) : '' }}</p>
	</section>
