<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onScopeDispose, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamEmpty } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { scopeKey } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import type { AsamFlowSize } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AccountHost } from '../Types.js';
import type { AccountSettingsAction, AccountSettingsCapabilities } from './Types.js';
import { createAccountRequestScope } from '../Session.js';
import { useSettingsWorkspaceText } from './I18n.js';

const props = defineProps<{
	host: AccountHost;
	owner: AccountSettingsCapabilities['owner'];
	title: string;
	items?: readonly AccountSettingsAction[];
	size?: AsamFlowSize;
	disabled?: boolean;
	readonly?: boolean;
}>();
const { t } = useSettingsWorkspaceText();
const pending = shallowRef('');
const feedback = shallowRef<'opened' | 'actionFailed'>();
const owned = computed(() => {
	const state = props.host.security.state.value;
	return (
		state.status === 'authenticated' &&
		!!state.subject &&
		scopeKey(state.subject) === scopeKey(props.owner)
	);
});
const scope = createAccountRequestScope(props.host, () => {
	pending.value = '';
	feedback.value = undefined;
});
const canOpen = (item: AccountSettingsAction) =>
	owned.value &&
	!props.disabled &&
	!props.readonly &&
	!!item.open &&
	props.host.security.check(item.rule) === 'allowed';
watch(
	() => [scopeKey(props.owner), props.disabled, props.readonly],
	() => scope.clear(),
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
watch(
	() => props.items,
	(items, previous) => {
		if (
			pending.value &&
			items?.find((item) => item.id === pending.value)?.open !==
				previous?.find((item) => item.id === pending.value)?.open
		)
			scope.clear();
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
async function open(item: AccountSettingsAction) {
	if (pending.value || !canOpen(item) || !item.open) return;
	const subject = props.host.security.state.value.subject;
	if (!subject) return;
	const request = scope.request(props.host.operationId(), true);
	pending.value = item.id;
	feedback.value = undefined;
	try {
		await item.open(subject, request);
		if (request.isCurrent() && canOpen(item)) feedback.value = 'opened';
	} catch {
		if (request.isCurrent()) feedback.value = 'actionFailed';
	} finally {
		if (request.isCurrent()) pending.value = '';
		request.release();
	}
}
onScopeDispose(() => scope.dispose());
</script>

				:disabled="blocked || validating"
				@click="save"
				>{{ t('saveAvatar') }}</AsamButton

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onScopeDispose, shallowRef, useTemplateRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamAvatar, AsamButton, AsamUpload } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamNativeUploadExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { UploadFile } from 'element-plus';
import { scopeKey } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import type { AsamFlowSize } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AccountHost } from '../Types.js';
import type { AccountSettingsAvatar, AccountSettingsCapabilities } from './Types.js';
import { createAccountRequestScope, safeAccountUrl } from '../Session.js';
import { useSettingsWorkspaceText } from './I18n.js';
import { useCompleteSettingsText } from '../settings-complete/I18n.js';

const props = defineProps<{
	host: AccountHost;
	owner: AccountSettingsCapabilities['owner'];
	validationKey?: string | number;
	avatar?: AccountSettingsAvatar;
	disabled?: boolean;
	readonly?: boolean;
	size?: AsamFlowSize;
}>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ dirty: [value: boolean] }>();
const { t } = useSettingsWorkspaceText();
const { t: completeText } = useCompleteSettingsText();
const upload = useTemplateRef<AsamNativeUploadExpose>('upload');
const selected = shallowRef<File>();
const preview = shallowRef('');
const pending = shallowRef(false);
const validating = shallowRef(false);
let decoding: { cancel(): void } | undefined;
function stopDecode() {
	const prior = decoding;
	decoding = undefined;
	validating.value = false;
	prior?.cancel();
}
const feedback = shallowRef<'avatarInvalid' | 'avatarSaved' | 'avatarFailed'>();
const owned = computed(() => {
	const state = props.host.security.state.value;
	return (
		state.status === 'authenticated' &&
		!!state.subject &&
		scopeKey(state.subject) === scopeKey(props.owner) &&
		props.host.security.check({ permission: 'account:read' }) === 'allowed'
	);
});
const allowed = computed(
	() =>
		owned.value &&
		props.host.security.check({ permission: 'account:write', write: true }) === 'allowed'
);
const blocked = computed(
	() =>
		props.disabled ||
		props.readonly ||
		pending.value ||
		!allowed.value ||
		(!props.avatar?.save && !props.avatar?.previewOnly)
);
function reset() {
	stopDecode();
	if (preview.value) URL.revokeObjectURL(preview.value);
	preview.value = '';
	selected.value = undefined;
	pending.value = false;
	feedback.value = undefined;
	emit('dirty', false);
}
let scope = createAccountRequestScope(props.host, reset);
watch(
	() => props.host,
	(host) => {
		scope.dispose();
		scope = createAccountRequestScope(host, reset);
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
watch(
	[
		() => scopeKey(props.owner),
		() => props.avatar?.src,
		() => props.avatar?.save,
		() => props.avatar?.previewOnly
	],
	() => scope.clear(),
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
watch(
	() => [props.disabled, props.readonly, allowed.value, props.validationKey],
	() => {
		if (pending.value || validating.value) scope.clear();
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
async function choose(file: UploadFile) {
	if (blocked.value || !file.raw) return;
	upload.value?.clearFiles();
	stopDecode();
	const raw = file.raw;
	if (
		!['image/jpeg', 'image/png'].includes(raw.type) ||
		raw.size === 0 ||
		raw.size > 2 * 1024 * 1024
	) {
		feedback.value = 'avatarInvalid';
		return;
	}
	const host = props.host;
	// Local preview only: this lease never reaches an upload/save service.
	const request = scope.request('avatar-preview', true);
	let image: HTMLImageElement | undefined;
	let candidateUrl = '';
	let released = false;
	const operation = {
		cancel() {
			if (released) return;
			released = true;
			image?.removeAttribute('src');
			if (candidateUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(candidateUrl);
			candidateUrl = '';
			request.release();
		}
	};
	decoding = operation;
	validating.value = true;
	feedback.value = undefined;
	const current = () =>
		decoding === operation &&
		props.host === host &&
		request.isCurrent() &&
		!blocked.value &&
		host.security.check({ permission: 'account:read' }) === 'allowed' &&
		host.security.check({ permission: 'account:write', write: true }) === 'allowed';
	try {
		image = new Image();
		candidateUrl = URL.createObjectURL(raw);
		image.src = candidateUrl;
		await image.decode();
		if (!current()) return;
		const prior = preview.value;
		selected.value = raw;
		preview.value = candidateUrl;
		candidateUrl = '';
		if (prior) URL.revokeObjectURL(prior);
		emit('dirty', true);
	} catch {
		if (current()) feedback.value = 'avatarInvalid';
	} finally {
		if (decoding === operation) {
			decoding = undefined;
			validating.value = false;
		}
		operation.cancel();

async function save() {
	if (
		blocked.value ||
		validating.value ||
		!selected.value ||
		!props.avatar?.save ||
		props.avatar.previewOnly

		return;
	const state = props.host.security.state.value;
	if (!state.subject) return;
	const request = scope.request(props.host.operationId(), true);
	const file = selected.value;
	pending.value = true;
	feedback.value = undefined;
	try {
		await props.avatar.save(file, state.subject, request);
		if (!request.isCurrent() || !allowed.value || props.disabled || props.readonly) return;
		selected.value = undefined;
		feedback.value = 'avatarSaved';
		emit('dirty', false);
	} catch {
		if (request.isCurrent()) feedback.value = 'avatarFailed';
	} finally {
		if (request.isCurrent()) pending.value = false;
		request.release();
	}
}
onScopeDispose(() => scope.dispose());
defineExpose({ clear: () => scope.clear() });
</script>

import type { SecurityRule, SecuritySubject } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import type { AccountRequest } from '../Types.js';
import type { AccountSettingsCompanion } from '../Session.js';

/** Optional full-page presentation/lifecycle composition, with the original save coordinator. */
export interface AccountSettingsComposition {
	readonly companion: AccountSettingsCompanion;
	readonly revision: string | number;
	readonly empty: boolean;
	readonly cancelledRead: boolean;
	cancel(): void;
}

/** 只承载安全投影与进入宿主流程的入口，不在模板中实现凭据或绑定操作。 */
export interface AccountSettingsAction {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly title: string;
	readonly description: string;
	readonly status: string;
	readonly actionLabel: string;
	readonly rule: SecurityRule;
	readonly open?: (subject: SecuritySubject, request: AccountRequest) => Promise<void>;
}

export interface AccountSettingsAvatar {
	/** Local selection/preview only; enables no upload or persistence service. */
	readonly previewOnly?: boolean;
	readonly src?: string;
	readonly initials?: string;
	/** 显式保存头像；宿主负责上传、持久化及副作用提交前的 isCurrent 核验。 */
	readonly save?: (
		file: File,
		subject: SecuritySubject,
		request: AccountRequest
	) => Promise<void>;
}

export interface AccountSettingsCapabilities {
	/** 显示投影的身份与租户/组织，必须与当前安全会话一致。 */
	readonly owner: Pick<SecuritySubject, 'id' | 'scope'>;
	/** 显式接入可选前端资料；宿主在已有 settings/save 边界映射自己的 DTO。 */
	readonly profileFields?: {
		readonly biography?: boolean;
		/** 只接受宿主给出的区域选项；省略时不显示此字段。 */
		readonly officeAreas?: readonly { readonly value: string; readonly label: string }[];
	};
	readonly avatar?: AccountSettingsAvatar;
	readonly security?: readonly AccountSettingsAction[];
	readonly bindings?: readonly AccountSettingsAction[];
}

						@click="registration.clear"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.clearRegistration') }}</AsamButton
					>
				</div></AsamForm
			>
			<div
				ref="result"
				tabindex="-1"
				:role="registration.status.value === 'success' ? 'status' : 'alert'"
				aria-live="polite"
				class="account-result"
			>
				<p v-for="(error, field) in registration.displayErrors.value" :key="field">
					{{ error }}
				</p>
				<p>{{ registration.displayMessage.value }}</p>
				<p v-if="registration.status.value === 'success'">
					{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.registered') }}
				</p>
				<template v-if="registration.status.value === 'unknown'"
					><AsamButton
						type="primary"
						v-if="host.services.verifyRegistration"
						class="account-message-button"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="disabled"
						@click="completeRegistration('verify')"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.verifyRegistration') }}</AsamButton
					><AsamButton
						type="primary"
						v-if="host.resolveUnknown"
						class="account-message-button"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="disabled"
						@click="host.resolveUnknown('register', registration.operationId.value)"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.resolve') }}</AsamButton
					></template
				>
			</div></template
		>
		<p v-if="displayNavigationError" role="alert">{{ displayNavigationError }}</p>
		<div class="account-alternate">
			<span>{{
				kind === 'login'
					? i18n.t('app.templates.account.noAccount')
					: i18n.t('app.templates.account.hasAccount')
			}}</span
			><AsamButton
				type="primary"
				class="account-message-button"
				:size="size"
				:disabled="disabled"
				@click="emit('page', kind === 'login' ? 'register' : 'login')"
				>{{
					kind === 'login'
						? i18n.t('app.templates.account.create')
						: i18n.t('app.templates.account.backLogin')
				}}</AsamButton
			>
		</div>
	</div>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamCheckboxItem } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { useAccountI18n } from '../I18n.js';
const i18n = useAccountI18n();
import {
	createAsamMessageIssue,
	createAsamMessageError,
	formatFieldError
} from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, ref, useId, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamForm, AsamFormItem, AsamInput, AsamPassword } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamLoginForm, createAsamPasswordField, defineAsamFields } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamFieldModel, AsamFlowContext, AsamLoginResult } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AccountPageEvents, AccountPageProps, LoginCredentials } from '../Types.js';
import { createRegistration, loginDestination } from '../Session.js';
const props = withDefaults(
	defineProps<
		AccountPageProps & {
			kind: 'login' | 'register';
			title: string;
			description: string;
			accountLabel?: string;
		}
	>(),
	{ size: 'default', brand: 'ASAM', accountLabel: undefined }
);
const emit = defineEmits<AccountPageEvents>();
const id = useId();
const root = ref<HTMLElement>();
const result = ref<HTMLElement>();
const registration = createRegistration(props.host, i18n);
const registrationLocked = computed(
	() => props.disabled || ['pending', 'success', 'unknown'].includes(registration.status.value)
);
const loginInitial: AsamFieldModel = { account: '', password: '' };
const loginForm = ref<InstanceType<typeof AsamLoginForm>>();
const loginFields = computed(() =>
	defineAsamFields([
		{
			key: 'account',
			label: props.accountLabel ?? '账户',
			kind: 'text',
			modes: { edit: { componentProps: { autocomplete: 'username', name: 'username' } } }
		},
		createAsamPasswordField({
			key: 'password',
			label: '密码',
			inputProps: { autocomplete: 'current-password', name: 'password' }
		})
	])
);
const fieldLabels = computed(() => ({
	account: props.accountLabel ?? i18n.t('app.templates.account.account'),
	password: i18n.t('app.templates.account.password')
}));
const loginState = ref('idle');
const navigationError = ref<Error>();
const displayNavigationError = computed(() =>
	navigationError.value ? formatFieldError(navigationError.value, i18n) : ''
);
let disposed = false;
let completedOperation = '';
let attempt = 0;
let abort: AbortController | undefined;
let startingAuthentication = false;
async function validateLogin(model: Readonly<AsamFieldModel>) {
	return ['account', 'password']
		.filter((key) => typeof model[key] !== 'string' || !String(model[key]).trim())
		.map((key) =>
			Object.assign(
				createAsamMessageIssue(
					key === 'account' ? '请填写账户' : '请填写密码',
					key === 'account'
						? 'app.templates.account.requiredAccount'
						: 'app.templates.account.requiredPassword'
				),
				{ key }
			)
		);
}
async function authenticate(
	model: Readonly<AsamFieldModel>,
	context: AsamFlowContext
): Promise<AsamLoginResult> {
	const revision = ++attempt;
	const controller = new AbortController();
	abort = controller;
	const cancel = () => controller.abort();
	context.signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true });
	if (context.signal.aborted) cancel();
	const request = {
		operationId: props.host.operationId(),
		signal: controller.signal,
		isCurrent: () =>
			!disposed &&
			revision === attempt &&
			!controller.signal.aborted &&
			!props.disabled &&
			!props.readonly
	};
	const credentials: LoginCredentials = {
		account: String(model.account),
		password: String(model.password)
	};
	loginState.value = 'pending';
	navigationError.value = undefined;
	try {
		let authentication: Promise<boolean>;
		startingAuthentication = true;
		try {
			authentication = props.host.services.login(credentials, request);
		} finally {
			startingAuthentication = false;
		}
		const accepted = await authentication;
		if (!request.isCurrent()) return { success: false };
		const confirmed =
			accepted &&
			props.host.security.state.value.status === 'authenticated' &&
			!!props.host.security.state.value.subject;
		loginState.value = confirmed ? 'success' : 'failure';
		return Object.assign(
			createAsamMessageIssue(
				'登录未能完成，请检查账户后重试',
				'app.templates.account.loginRejected'
			),
			{ success: confirmed }
		);
	} catch {
		if (request.isCurrent()) loginState.value = 'failure';
		return Object.assign(
			createAsamMessageIssue('登录未能完成，请重试', 'app.templates.account.loginFailed'),
			{ success: false }
		);
	} finally {
		credentials.password = '';
		context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);
	}
}
async function onLoginSuccess() {
	if (disposed || props.disabled) return;
	let destination: string | undefined;
	try {
		destination = loginDestination(props.host, props.returnPath);
	} catch {
		navigationError.value = createAsamMessageError(
			'应用未允许此返回路径',
			'app.templates.account.returnDenied'
		);
		return;
	}
	if (!destination) {
		navigationError.value = createAsamMessageError(
			'应用未允许此返回路径',
			'app.templates.account.returnDenied'
		);
		return;
	}
	try {
		await props.host.navigate(destination);
		if (!disposed) emit('completed', 'login');
	} catch {
		if (!disposed)
			navigationError.value = createAsamMessageError(
				'登录已完成，页面跳转失败，请使用应用导航',
				'app.templates.account.navigationFailed'
			);
	}
}
function cancelLogin(cancel: () => void) {
	++attempt;
	abort?.abort();
	cancel();
	loginState.value = 'idle';
	navigationError.value = undefined;
}
function onRegistrationSubmit(event: Event) {
	event.preventDefault();
	void submitRegistration();
}
async function submitRegistration() {
	await completeRegistration('submit');
}
async function completeRegistration(action: 'submit' | 'verify') {
	const pending = registration[action](props.disabled || (action === 'submit' && props.readonly));
	const operation = registration.operationId.value;
	const accepted = await pending;
	await nextTick();
	if (!disposed && operation === registration.operationId.value) {
		if (
			accepted &&
			operation &&
			operation !== completedOperation &&
			registration.status.value === 'success'
		) {
			completedOperation = operation;
			emit('completed', 'register');
		}
		if (registration.status.value !== 'idle') result.value?.focus();
	}
}
const stopSecurity = props.host.security.onInvalidate(() => {
	// The host's own authentication start must not cancel the initiating login flow.
	if (props.host.security.state.value.status !== 'authenticating' || !startingAuthentication)
		clear();
});
function clear() {
	++attempt;
	abort?.abort();
	loginForm.value?.cancel();
	loginForm.value?.reset();
	registration.clear();
	navigationError.value = undefined;
	loginState.value = 'idle';
}
watch(
	() => [props.disabled, props.readonly],
	() => {
		++attempt;
		abort?.abort();
		loginForm.value?.cancel();
		loginState.value = 'idle';
		registration.secretClear();
	}
);
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	disposed = true;
	++attempt;
	abort?.abort();
	stopSecurity();
	registration.dispose();
});
defineExpose({ clear });
</script>

								{{
									data.profile.value[field.key] ||

								}}
							</dd>
						</div>
					</dl>
					<a

						rel="noopener noreferrer"

						:aria-disabled="disabled"
						@click="disabled && $event.preventDefault()"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.website') }}</a

				>
				<div class="account-actions">
					<AsamButton
						type="primary"
						class="account-message-button"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="disabled || data.profileStatus.value === 'loading'"
						@click="data.loadProfile(disabled)"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.reload') }}</AsamButton
					><AsamButton
						type="primary"
						class="account-message-button"

			><AsamButton

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAccountI18n } from '../I18n.js';
const i18n = useAccountI18n();
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AccountPageEvents, AccountPageProps } from '../Types.js';
import { createAccountData } from '../Session.js';
const props = withDefaults(
	defineProps<AccountPageProps & { title: string; refreshKey?: string | number }>(),
	{
		size: 'default',
		refreshKey: undefined
	}
);
const emit = defineEmits<AccountPageEvents>();
const data = createAccountData(props.host, i18n);
const avatarFailed = ref(false);
const avatar = computed(() => data.profile.value?.avatar);
const fields = [
	{
		key: 'displayName',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.displayName');
		}
	},
	{
		key: 'email',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.email');
		}
	},
	{
		key: 'phone',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.phone');
		}
	},
	{
		key: 'organization',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.organization');
		}
	},
	{
		key: 'role',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.role');
		}
	},
	{
		key: 'joined',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.joined');
		}
	}
] as const;
watch(
	() => [props.host.security.state.value, props.disabled, props.refreshKey],
	() => {
		avatarFailed.value = false;
		// Optional composed views invalidate the same existing request scope before rereading.
		if (props.refreshKey !== undefined) data.clear();
		void data.loadProfile(props.disabled);
	},
	{ immediate: true, flush: 'post' }
);
onBeforeUnmount(data.dispose);
defineExpose({ clear: data.clear });
</script>

				><AsamFormItem

					><!-- prettier-ignore --><label class="account-consent"><AsamCheckboxItem
						:model-value="data.draft.digest"
						:disabled="locked || !writable"
						@update:model-value="data.draft.digest = $event === true"
					 />{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.receiveDigest') }}</label></AsamFormItem
				>
				<p role="status">
					{{
						data.dirty.value
							? i18n.t('app.templates.account.dirty')
							: i18n.t('app.templates.account.clean')
					}}
				</p>
				<div class="account-actions">
					<AsamButton
						class="account-message-button"
						type="primary"
						native-type="submit"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="locked || !writable || !data.dirty.value"
						>{{
							data.saveStatus.value === 'pending'
								? i18n.t('app.templates.account.saving')
								: composition
									? completeText('saveLocal')
									: i18n.t('app.templates.account.save')
						}}</AsamButton
					><AsamButton
						type="primary"
						class="account-message-button"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="locked || !writable || !data.dirty.value"
						@click="data.revert(!writable || disabled)"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.revert') }}</AsamButton
					>
				</div></AsamForm
			>
			<div
				ref="result"
				tabindex="-1"
				class="account-result"
				aria-live="polite"
				:role="
					['failure', 'unknown', 'field-error'].includes(data.saveStatus.value)
						? 'alert'
						: 'status'
				"
			>
				<p v-for="(error, field) in data.displayErrors.value" :key="field">{{ error }}</p>
				<p>{{ data.displayMessage.value }}</p>
				<template v-if="data.saveStatus.value === 'unknown'"
					><AsamButton
						type="primary"
						v-if="host.services.verifySave"
						class="account-message-button"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="disabled"
						@click="completeSave('verify')"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.verifySave') }}</AsamButton
					><AsamButton
						type="primary"
						v-if="host.resolveUnknown"
						class="account-message-button"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="disabled"
						@click="host.resolveUnknown('save', data.operationId.value)"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.resolve') }}</AsamButton
					></template
				><template
					v-if="data.saveStatus.value === 'success' && host.services.refreshDisplay"
					><p v-if="data.displayStatus.value === 'error'" role="alert">
						{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.displayFailed') }}
					</p>
					<p v-if="data.displayStatus.value === 'success'">
						{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.displayUpdated') }}
					</p>
					<AsamButton
						type="primary"
						class="account-message-button"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="disabled || data.displayStatus.value === 'pending'"
						@click="data.refreshDisplay(disabled)"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.refreshDisplay') }}</AsamButton
					></template
				>
			</div>
			<AsamButton
				type="primary"
				v-if="data.settingsStatus.value === 'error' || data.settingsStatus.value === 'idle'"
				class="account-message-button"
				:size="size"
				:disabled="disabled"
				@click="data.loadSettings(disabled)"
				>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.reloadSettings') }}</AsamButton
			>
		</div>
		<div class="account-actions">
			<AsamButton
				type="primary"
				class="account-message-button"
				:size="size"
				:disabled="
					disabled ||
					data.saveStatus.value === 'pending' ||
					(!!composition && !data.allowed())
				"
				@click="leave"
				>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.backProfile') }}</AsamButton
			>
		</div>
		<LeaveDialog
			v-if="composition"
			:open="confirmLeave"
			:unknown="data.saveStatus.value === 'unknown'"
			:disabled="disabled"
			:size="size"
			@cancel="confirmLeave = false"
			@leave="discardAndLeave"
		/>
		<div v-if="confirmLeave && !composition" class="account-leave" role="alert">
			<p>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.leaveWarning') }}</p>
			<AsamButton
				type="primary"
				class="account-message-button"
				:size="size"
				:disabled="disabled"
				@click="confirmLeave = false"
				>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.continueEditing') }}</AsamButton
			><AsamButton
				type="primary"
				class="account-message-button"
				:size="size"
				:disabled="disabled"
				@click="emit('page', 'profile')"
				>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.leave') }}</AsamButton
			>
		</div>
	</section>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamCheckboxItem, AsamTabs, AsamEmpty } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import SettingsAvatar from '../settings/SettingsAvatar.vue';
import SettingsActions from '../settings/SettingsActions.vue';
import LeaveDialog from '../settings-complete/LeaveDialog.vue';
import { useCompleteSettingsText } from '../settings-complete/I18n.js';
import type { AccountSettingsCapabilities, AccountSettingsComposition } from '../settings/Types.js';
import { useSettingsWorkspaceText } from '../settings/I18n.js';
import { scopeKey } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';

import { useAccountI18n } from '../I18n.js';
const i18n = useAccountI18n();
import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamForm, AsamFormItem, AsamInput, AsamTextarea } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { createAccountData } from '../Session.js';
import type { NotificationChange } from '../Session.js';
import type { AccountPageEvents, AccountPageProps } from '../Types.js';
const props = withDefaults(
	defineProps<
		AccountPageProps & {
			title: string;
			workspace?: AccountSettingsCapabilities;
			composition?: AccountSettingsComposition;
		}
	>(),
	{
		size: 'default',
		workspace: undefined,
		composition: undefined
	}
);
const emit = defineEmits<AccountPageEvents>();
const { t } = useSettingsWorkspaceText();
const { t: completeText } = useCompleteSettingsText();
const tab = ref<'basic' | 'security' | 'bindings' | 'notifications'>('basic');
const tabs = computed(() =>
	['basic', 'security', 'bindings', 'notifications'].map((value) => ({
		value,
		label: t(value as 'basic' | 'security' | 'bindings' | 'notifications')
	}))
);
function setTab(value: unknown) {
	if (
		value === 'basic' ||
		value === 'security' ||
		value === 'bindings' ||
		value === 'notifications'
	)
		tab.value = value;
}
const avatarPanel = ref<{ clear(): void }>();
const panel = ref<HTMLElement>();
const desktopTabs = ref(false);
let panelObserver: ResizeObserver | undefined;
const avatarDirty = ref(false);
const data = createAccountData(props.host, i18n, props.composition?.companion);
const profileFields = computed(() => {
	const subject = props.host.security.state.value.subject;
	return subject && props.workspace && scopeKey(subject) === scopeKey(props.workspace.owner)
		? props.workspace.profileFields
		: undefined;
});
function setOfficeArea(value: unknown) {
	if (props.composition && (locked.value || !writable.value)) return;
	if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') data.draft.officeArea = '';
	else if (
		typeof value === 'string' &&
		profileFields.value?.officeAreas?.some((item) => item.value === value)
	)
		data.draft.officeArea = value;
}
const result = ref<HTMLElement>();
const confirmLeave = ref(false);
let disposed = false;
let completedOperation = '';
const writable = computed(() => !props.readonly && data.allowed(true));
const locked = computed(
	() => props.disabled || ['pending', 'unknown'].includes(data.saveStatus.value)
);
const languages = computed(
	() =>
		props.host.languages ?? [
			{ value: 'zh-CN', label: '简体中文' },
			{ value: 'en', label: 'English' }
		]
);
const heights = { small: '28px', default: '32px', big: '36px', large: '40px' };
function setLanguage(value: unknown) {
	if (props.composition && (locked.value || !writable.value)) return;
	if (typeof value === 'string' && languages.value.some((item) => item.value === value))
		data.draft.language = value;
}
const textFields = [
	{
		key: 'displayName',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.displayName');
		},
		autocomplete: 'nickname'
	},
	{
		key: 'email',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.email');
		},
		autocomplete: 'email'
	},
	{
		key: 'phone',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.phone');
		},
		autocomplete: 'tel'
	}
] as const;
function updateField(field: string, value: unknown) {
	if (locked.value || !writable.value) return;
	if (field === 'notifications' || field === 'digest') data.draft[field] = value === true;
	else if (field === 'displayName' || field === 'email' || field === 'biography')
		data.draft[field] = String(value);
}
function discardAndLeave() {
	if (props.disabled || ['pending', 'unknown'].includes(data.saveStatus.value)) return;
	data.revert();
	avatarPanel.value?.clear();
	confirmLeave.value = false;
	emit('page', 'profile');
}
function beforeUnload(event: BeforeUnloadEvent) {
	if (
		props.composition &&
		(data.dirty.value ||
			avatarDirty.value ||
			['pending', 'unknown'].includes(data.saveStatus.value))
	) {
		event.preventDefault();
		event.returnValue = '';
	}
}
onMounted(() => {
	if (!props.composition) return;
	window.addEventListener('beforeunload', beforeUnload);
	if (panel.value) {
		panelObserver = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => {
			desktopTabs.value = !!entry && entry.contentRect.width >= 900;
		});
		panelObserver.observe(panel.value);
	}
});
async function save() {
	await completeSave('save');
}
async function completeSave(action: 'save' | 'verify') {
	await finishSave(data[action](props.disabled || (action === 'save' && !writable.value)));
}
async function saveNotification(field: NotificationChange['field'], value: boolean) {
	if (locked.value || !writable.value) return;
	await finishSave(data.save(false, { field, value }), false);
}
async function finishSave(pending: Promise<boolean>, focus = true) {
	const operation = data.operationId.value;
	const accepted = await pending;
	await nextTick();
	if (!disposed && operation === data.operationId.value) {
		if (focus) result.value?.focus();
		if (
			accepted &&
			operation &&
			operation !== completedOperation &&
			data.saveStatus.value === 'success'
		) {
			completedOperation = operation;
			emit('completed', 'save');
		}
	}
}
function leave() {
	if (data.dirty.value || avatarDirty.value || data.saveStatus.value === 'unknown')
		confirmLeave.value = true;
	else emit('page', 'profile');
}
watch(
	() => [props.host.security.state.value, props.disabled, props.composition?.revision],
	() => {
		confirmLeave.value = false;
		if (props.composition && !data.allowed()) {
			data.clear();
			avatarPanel.value?.clear();
		}
		void data.loadSettings(props.disabled);
	},
	{ immediate: true, flush: 'post' }
);
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	disposed = true;
	panelObserver?.disconnect();
	window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', beforeUnload);
	data.dispose();
});
defineExpose({
	clear: () => {
		data.clear();
		avatarPanel.value?.clear();
	}
});
</script>

<template>

<script lang="ts">
import { AsamBaseForm } from '@asam-ui/ui';

declare module '@asam-ui/ui/i18n' {

	}
}

import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, reactive, ref, useId, watch } from 'vue';

			},
			'zh-CN': {
				'app.templates.account.minimalIntro': '使用你的账户，继续今天的工作。',
				'app.templates.account.account': '账户',
				'app.templates.account.password': '密码',
				'app.templates.account.create': '创建账户',
				'app.templates.account.noAccount': '还没有账户？',
				'app.templates.account.entry': '账户入口',
				'app.templates.account.minimalNote': '留一点空间，专注眼前的事。',
				'app.templates.account.minimalContinue': '你的工作，从这里继续。',
				'app.templates.account.brandNote': '把想法带进日常。',
				'app.templates.account.brandIntro':
					'连接你的工作与团队，让每一次协作都有清晰的起点。',
				'app.templates.account.techNote': '专注连接，从容掌控。',
				'app.templates.account.techIntro': '一个账户，继续你的应用工作区。',
				'app.templates.account.minimalLogin': '欢迎回来',
				'app.templates.account.brandLogin': '回到你的工作空间',
				'app.templates.account.brandDescription': '与团队的下一次协作，从这里开始。',
				'app.templates.account.techLogin': '连接工作空间',
				'app.templates.account.techDescription': '验证账户后，继续你的应用会话。',
				'app.templates.account.requiredAccount': '请填写账户',
				'app.templates.account.requiredPassword': '请填写密码',
				'app.templates.account.loginRejected': '登录未能完成，请检查账户后重试',
				'app.templates.account.loginFailed': '登录未能完成，请重试',
				'app.templates.account.returnDenied': '应用未允许此返回路径',
				'app.templates.account.navigationFailed':
					'登录已完成，页面跳转失败，请使用应用导航',
				'app.templates.account.wordmark': '账户'
			}
		});
		const id = useId();
		const draft = reactive({ username: props.initialUsername, password: '' });
		const accountInput = ref<InstanceType<typeof AsamInput>>();
		const passwordInput = ref<InstanceType<typeof AsamPassword>>();
		const state = ref<'idle' | 'pending' | 'failure' | 'success'>('idle');
		const pending = computed(() => state.value === 'pending');
		const locked = computed(
			() => !!props.disabled || !!props.readonly || pending.value || state.value === 'success'
		);
		const inputLocked = computed(
			() => !!props.disabled || pending.value || state.value === 'success'
		);
		const fieldErrors = reactive({ account: false, password: false });
		const messageKey = ref<'' | 'app.templates.account.loginFailed'>('');
		const safeError = ref('');
		const title = computed(() => props.heading ?? i18n.t('app.templates.account.techLogin'));
		const description = computed(
			() => props.supportText ?? i18n.t('app.templates.account.techDescription')
		);
		const accountLabel = computed(() => i18n.t('app.templates.account.account'));
		const message = computed(
			() => safeError.value || (messageKey.value ? i18n.t(messageKey.value) : '')
		);
		let revision = 0;
		let disposed = false;
		let requestAbort: AbortController | undefined;
		function setState(value: typeof state.value) {
			const wasPending = pending.value;
			state.value = value;
			if (wasPending !== pending.value) emit('pending', pending.value);
		}
		/** Only cancels this template; the injected host retains session/logout APIs. */
		function cancel() {
			++revision;
			requestAbort?.abort();
			requestAbort = undefined;
			draft.password = '';
			messageKey.value = '';
			safeError.value = '';
			fieldErrors.account = false;
			fieldErrors.password = false;
			setState('idle');
		}
		function reset() {
			cancel();
			draft.username = props.initialUsername;
		}
		function clear() {
			cancel();
			draft.username = '';
		}
		async function submit() {
			if (locked.value || disposed) return false;
			messageKey.value = '';
			safeError.value = '';
			fieldErrors.account = !draft.username.trim();
			fieldErrors.password = !draft.password;
			if (fieldErrors.account || fieldErrors.password) {
				await nextTick();
				if (!disposed) {
					if (fieldErrors.account) accountInput.value?.focus();
					else if (fieldErrors.password) passwordInput.value?.focus();
				}
				return false;
			}
			const token = ++revision;
			const controller = new AbortController();
			requestAbort = controller;
			const authenticate = props.authenticate;
			const current = () =>
				!disposed &&
				token === revision &&
				!controller.signal.aborted &&
				authenticate === props.authenticate &&
				!props.disabled &&
				!props.readonly;
			const credentials = { username: draft.username.trim(), password: draft.password };
			setState('pending');
			try {
				await authenticate(credentials, { signal: controller.signal });
				if (!current()) return false;
				draft.password = '';
				setState('success');
				emit('success');
				if (current()) emit('completed', 'login');
				return true;
			} catch (error) {
				if (!current()) return false;
				let display = '';
				try {
					display = props.formatError?.(error) ?? '';
				} catch {
					display = '';
				}
				safeError.value = typeof display === 'string' ? display.slice(0, 500) : '';
				messageKey.value = 'app.templates.account.loginFailed';
				setState('failure');
				return false;
			} finally {
				credentials.password = '';
				if (token === revision) {
					draft.password = '';
					requestAbort = undefined;
					if (pending.value) setState('idle');
				}
			}
		}
		function submitFromForm() {
			void submit();
		}
		function enter(event: KeyboardEvent) {
			if (event.isComposing || event.keyCode === 229) event.preventDefault();
		}
		watch(
			() => [props.disabled, props.readonly, props.authenticate, props.initialUsername],
			reset,
			{
				flush: 'sync'
			}
		);
		onBeforeUnmount(() => {
			disposed = true;
			cancel();
		});
		expose({ clear, reset, cancel, submit });

		return {
			clear,
			reset,
			cancel,
			submit,
			i18n,
			id,
			draft,
			accountInput,
			passwordInput,
			state,
			pending,
			locked,
			inputLocked,
			fieldErrors,
			title,
			description,
			accountLabel,
			message,
			submitFromForm,
			enter
		};
	}
});
</script>

<script setup>
import {

	AsamRadioItem as WebsiteAsamRadioItem,
	AsamCheckboxItem as WebsiteAsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamConfigProvider as WebsiteAsamConfigProvider
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');
function websitePreviewTheme0(event) {

}
function websiteNativeEvent(value, type) {

}
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamCheckboxItem } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAccountI18n } from '../I18n.js';
const i18n = useAccountI18n();

import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import {
	MinimalLogin,
	MinimalRegister,
	MinimalProfile,
	MinimalSettings,
	BrandLogin,

import { safeReturnPath } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
/** Fixed application error codes, never backend exception or token data. */
export class AccountLoginError extends Error {
	code;
	constructor(code) {
		super(code);
		this.code = code;
	}
}
/**
 * Bridge the existing AccountHost to LOGIN-20261028-HOST-CONTRACT-R1.
 * One host adapter owns security/session/redirect. Each copied Login.vue needs only authenticate.
 */
export function createAccountLoginAdapter(getHost, options = () => ({})) {
	return async (credentials, context) => {
		const host = getHost();
		const initial = options();
		const controller = new AbortController();
		let starting = false;
		let active = true;
		const abort = () => controller.abort();
		context.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
		if (context.signal.aborted) abort();
		const stop = host.security.onInvalidate(() => {
			if (!(starting && host.security.state.value.status === 'authenticating')) abort();
		});
		const current = () =>
			active &&
			!controller.signal.aborted &&
			!context.signal.aborted &&
			host === getHost() &&
			!options().disabled &&
			!options().readonly &&
			options().returnPath === initial.returnPath;
		const input = { account: credentials.username, password: credentials.password };
		try {
			if (!current()) throw new DOMException('Cancelled', 'AbortError');
			let authentication;
			starting = true;
			try {
				authentication = host.services.login(input, {
					operationId: host.operationId(),
					signal: controller.signal,
					isCurrent: current
				});
			} finally {
				starting = false;
			}
			let accepted;
			try {
				accepted = await authentication;
			} catch {
				throw new AccountLoginError('rejected');
			}
			if (!current()) throw new DOMException('Cancelled', 'AbortError');
			if (
				!accepted ||
				host.security.state.value.status !== 'authenticated' ||
				!host.security.state.value.subject
			)

.asam-login-page.account-frame {
	--account-canvas: var(--asam-color-surface-page, #f7f8fa);
	--account-surface: var(--asam-color-surface, #fff);
	--account-ink: var(--asam-color-text-primary, #242933);
	--account-muted: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
	--account-line: var(--asam-color-border, #d5dbe2);
	--account-accent: var(--asam-semantic-primary-foreground);
	--account-radius: var(--asam-radius-card, 12px);
	--account-error: var(--asam-semantic-danger-foreground);
	font-family: var(--asam-typography-font-family);
	background: var(--account-canvas);
	color: var(--account-ink);
	box-sizing: border-box;
	min-height: 100%;
	padding: 40px max(32px, calc((100vw - 1184px) / 2));
	gap: 24px;
	align-content: stretch;
}
.account-frame *,
.account-frame *::before,
.account-frame *::after {
	box-sizing: border-box;
}
.account-frame > header {
	align-self: start;
}
.account-wordmark {
	display: inline-flex;
	gap: 16px;
	align-items: center;
	color: inherit;
	text-decoration: none;
	font-size: 27px;
	font-weight: 750;
	letter-spacing: -0.055em;
}
.account-wordmark span {
	font-size: 10px;
	letter-spacing: 0.18em;
	font-weight: 500;
	border-left: 1px solid var(--account-line);
	padding-left: 16px;
	color: var(--account-muted);
}
.account-frame .asam-login-content {
	width: 100%;
	min-width: 0;
	margin: 0;
}
.account-frame h1 {
	font-size: clamp(28px, 3vw, 38px);
	line-height: 1.2;
	font-weight: 650;
	letter-spacing: -0.035em;
	margin: 0 0 12px;
}
.account-frame h2 {
	margin: 0;
	font-size: 24px;
	font-weight: 600;
	line-height: 1.3;
}
.account-frame p {
	line-height: 1.65;
}
.account-location {
	margin: 0 0 18px;
	color: var(--account-muted);
	font-size: 12px;
}
.account-intro {
	margin: 0 0 28px;
	color: var(--account-muted);
	font-size: 14px;
}
.account-frame .el-form-item {
	margin-bottom: 18px;
}
.account-frame .el-form-item__label {
	color: var(--account-ink);
}
.account-frame .el-form:not(.el-form--inline) .el-form-item {
	display: block;
}
.account-frame .el-form:not(.el-form--inline) .el-form-item__label {
	float: none;
	display: block;
	padding: 0 0 6px;
	line-height: 1.5;
	height: auto;
	text-align: left;
	max-width: 100%;
	white-space: normal;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.account-frame .el-form:not(.el-form--inline) .el-form-item__label-wrap {
	float: none;
	display: block;
	width: 100%;
	max-width: 100%;
	/* This template intentionally uses stacked labels instead of native auto-width columns. */
	margin-left: 0 !important;
}
.account-frame .el-form-item__content {
	margin-left: 0;
}
.account-frame .el-input {
	width: 100%;
}
.account-actions {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: 12px;
	margin: 16px 0;
	align-items: center;
}
.account-frame button:not([class*='el-']) {
	white-space: normal;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.account-frame .account-message-button.el-button {
	min-width: 0;
	max-width: 100%;
	height: auto;
	min-height: var(--asam-control-height, var(--el-component-size));
	padding-block: var(--asam-space-xs, 4px);
}
.account-frame .account-message-button.el-button > span {
	min-width: 0;
	max-width: 100%;
	display: block;
}
.account-frame button:not([class*='el-']):active {
	transform: scale(0.985);
}
.account-frame a {
	color: var(--account-accent);
}
.account-frame a:focus-visible,
.account-frame button:not([class*='el-']):focus-visible,
.account-frame input:not([class*='el-']):focus-visible,
.account-frame select:not([class*='el-']):focus-visible {
	outline: 2px solid var(--account-ink);
	outline-offset: 3px;
}
.account-consent {
	display: inline-flex;
	gap: 10px;
	align-items: center;
	font-size: 13px;
	color: var(--account-ink);
	line-height: 1.5;
}
.account-consent input:not([class*='el-']) {
	width: 16px;
	height: 16px;
	accent-color: var(--account-accent);
}
.account-alternate {
	display: flex;
	gap: 12px;
	align-items: center;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	border-top: 1px solid var(--account-line);
	padding-top: 20px;
	margin-top: 24px;
	color: var(--account-muted);
	font-size: 14px;
}
.account-result {
	min-height: 1px;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.account-result:empty {
	display: none;
}
.account-result p {
	margin: 10px 0;
	font-size: 14px;
}
.account-result[role='alert'] {
	color: var(--account-error);
}
.account-frame .el-form-item__error {
	color: var(--account-error);
}
.account-select {
	width: 100%;
	padding: 4px 12px;
	border: 1px solid var(--account-line);
	background: var(--account-surface);
	color: var(--account-ink);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-control, 4px);
	font: inherit;
}
.account-person {
	display: flex;
	gap: 20px;
	align-items: center;
	margin: 32px 0;
}
.account-person-info {
	flex: 1;
	min-width: 0;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.account-person img,
.account-avatar {
	width: 72px;
	height: 72px;
	border-radius: 20px;
	object-fit: cover;
	flex: 0 0 auto;
}
.account-avatar {
	display: grid;
	place-items: center;
	background: var(--asam-color-surface-soft, #e1ecf4);
	color: var(--account-accent);
	font-size: 30px;
}
.account-person p {
	margin: 6px 0 0;
	color: var(--account-muted);
}
.account-details {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
	gap: 28px 32px;
	margin: 28px 0 40px;
}
.account-details dt {
	font-size: 12px;
	color: var(--account-muted);
	margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.account-details dd {
	margin: 0;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.account-leave {
	border-left: 3px solid var(--account-accent);
	padding: 0 16px;
}
.account-frame > footer {
	display: flex;
	gap: 24px;
	justify-content: space-between;
	align-self: end;
	color: var(--account-muted);
	font-size: 12px;
}
.account-minimal {
	grid-template-columns: 1fr minmax(300px, 440px) 1fr;
	grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto;
	background: var(--account-canvas);
}
.account-minimal > header,
.account-minimal > footer {
	grid-column: 1 / -1;
}
.account-minimal .asam-login-content {
	grid-column: 2;
	align-self: center;
	padding: 30px 0;
}
.account-minimal > aside {
	grid-column: 3;
	align-self: center;
	padding-left: 40px;
}
.account-minimal h1 {
	font-family: 'Palatino Linotype', 'Songti SC', serif;
	font-weight: 500;
	font-size: 38px;
}
.account-note {
	color: var(--account-muted);
	font-size: 13px;
}
.account-note p {
	font-size: 20px;
	color: var(--account-ink);
}
.account-line {
	display: block;
	height: 1px;
	width: 48px;
	background: var(--account-line);
	margin-bottom: 28px;
}
.account-brand {
	grid-template-columns: minmax(360px, 1fr) minmax(320px, 440px);
	grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto;
	column-gap: clamp(48px, 9vw, 144px);
}
.account-brand > header {
	grid-column: 1 / -1;
}
.account-brand > aside {
	grid-column: 1;
	grid-row: 2;
	align-self: center;
}
.account-brand .asam-login-content {
	grid-column: 2;
	grid-row: 2;
	align-self: center;
	padding: 24px 0;
}
.account-brand > footer {
	grid-column: 1 / -1;
}
.account-brand-panel h2 {
	font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 64px);
	line-height: 1.15;
	letter-spacing: -0.05em;
	margin: 44px 0 24px;
}
.account-brand-panel p {
	color: var(--account-muted);
	font-size: 16px;
}
.account-orbit {
	width: 210px;
	height: 160px;
	position: relative;
}
.account-orbit i {
	position: absolute;
	width: 132px;
	height: 132px;
	border: 22px solid var(--account-accent);
	border-radius: 50%;
	opacity: 0.16;
}
.account-orbit i:nth-child(2) {
	left: 64px;
	top: 30px;
	opacity: 0.35;
}
.account-orbit i:nth-child(3) {
	left: 20px;
	top: 15px;
	border-width: 1px;
	opacity: 0.75;
}
.asam-login-page.account-tech {
	grid-template-columns: minmax(260px, 1fr) minmax(340px, 520px);
	grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto;
	column-gap: 80px;
	background-image:
		linear-gradient(
			color-mix(in srgb, var(--account-accent) 4%, transparent) 1px,
			transparent 1px
		),
		linear-gradient(
			90deg,
			color-mix(in srgb, var(--account-accent) 4%, transparent) 1px,
			transparent 1px
		);
	background-size: 48px 48px;
}
.account-tech > header,
.account-tech > footer {
	grid-column: 1 / -1;
}
.account-tech > aside {
	grid-column: 1;
	grid-row: 2;
	align-self: center;
}
.account-tech .asam-login-content {
	grid-column: 2;
	grid-row: 2;
	align-self: center;
	padding: 36px;
	border: 1px solid var(--account-line);
	border-radius: 24px;
	background: var(--account-surface);
	box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--account-ink) 3%, transparent);
}
.account-tech .account-location {
	font-family: Consolas, monospace;
	letter-spacing: 0.12em;
}
.account-tech-panel h2 {
	font-size: clamp(32px, 3.6vw, 48px);
	margin: 30px 0 16px;
}
.account-tech-panel p {
	color: var(--account-muted);
}
.account-geometry {
	width: 230px;
	height: 180px;
	position: relative;
	perspective: 600px;
}
.account-geometry i {
	position: absolute;
	inset: 12px 30px;
	border: 1px solid var(--account-accent);
	transform: rotate(-20deg) skew(12deg);
	border-radius: 24px;
	opacity: 0.65;
}
.account-geometry i:nth-child(2) {
	transform: translate(20px, 12px) rotate(-20deg) skew(12deg);
	opacity: 0.35;
}
.account-geometry i:nth-child(3) {
	transform: translate(40px, 24px) rotate(-20deg) skew(12deg);
	opacity: 0.15;
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
	.account-frame .asam-login-content {
		animation: account-enter 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
	}
	.account-frame button:not([class*='el-']) {
		transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
	}
}
@keyframes account-enter {
	from {
		transform: translateY(8px);
	}
	to {
		transform: translateY(0);
	}
}
@media (max-width: 767px) {
	.asam-login-page.account-frame {
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		min-height: 100%;
		padding: 24px 20px;
		gap: 28px;
	}
	.account-frame .asam-login-content {
		padding: 8px 0;
		flex: 1;
	}
	.account-frame h1,
	.account-minimal h1 {
		font-size: 30px;
	}
	.account-frame > aside {
		padding: 0;
	}
	.account-minimal > aside {
		display: none;
	}
	.account-brand > aside {
		order: 0;
	}
	.account-brand-panel {
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		gap: 20px;
	}
	.account-brand-panel h2 {
		font-size: 24px;
		margin: 0;
	}
	.account-brand-panel p {
		display: none;
	}
	.account-orbit {
		width: 90px;
		height: 84px;
		flex: 0 0 auto;
	}
	.account-orbit i {
		width: 64px;
		height: 64px;
		border-width: 10px;
	}
	.account-orbit i:nth-child(2) {
		left: 25px;
		top: 14px;
	}
	.account-orbit i:nth-child(3) {
		left: 10px;
		top: 5px;
	}
	.account-tech .asam-login-content {
		padding: 24px 18px;
		border-radius: 18px;
	}
	.account-tech > aside {
		display: none;
	}
	.account-details {
		gap: 24px 16px;
	}
	.account-frame > footer {
		width: 100%;
	}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
	.account-frame *,
	.account-frame *::before,
	.account-frame *::after {
		animation: none;
		transition: none;
		scroll-behavior: auto;
	}
}
vue
<template>
	<main class="login-template login-brand">
		<header>
			<div class="login-wordmark">
				{{ brandTitle }}<span>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.wordmark') }}</span>
			</div>
		</header>
		<aside class="login-aside">
			<div class="login-orbit" aria-hidden="true"><i /><i /><i /></div>
			<div>
				<h2>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.brandNote') }}</h2>
				<p>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.brandIntro') }}</p>
			</div>
		</aside>

		<section class="login-content" :data-login-state="state" :aria-label="title">
			<p class="login-location">{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.entry') }}</p>
			<h1>{{ title }}</h1>
			<p class="login-description">{{ description }}</p>
			<AsamBaseForm
				class="login-form"
				novalidate
				:aria-busy="pending"
				@submit.prevent="submitFromForm"
				@keydown.enter="enter"
			>
				<div class="login-field">
					<label :for="id + '-account'">{{ accountLabel }}</label>
					<AsamInput
						ref="accountInput"
						:id="id + '-account'"
						:model-value="draft.username"
						@update:model-value="
							(value) => {
								draft.username = String(value);
							}
						"
						name="username"
						autocomplete="username"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="inputLocked"
						:readonly="readonly"
						v-bind="{
							'aria-invalid': !!(fieldErrors.account || undefined) || undefined,
							'aria-describedby': fieldErrors.account
								? id + '-account-error'
								: undefined
						}"
					/>
					<p
						v-if="fieldErrors.account"
						:id="id + '-account-error'"
						class="login-error"
						role="alert"
					>
						{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.requiredAccount') }}
					</p>
				</div>
				<div class="login-field">
					<label :for="id + '-password'">{{
						i18n.t('app.templates.account.password')
					}}</label>
					<AsamPassword
						ref="passwordInput"
						:id="id + '-password'"
						:model-value="draft.password"
						@update:model-value="
							(value) => {
								draft.password = String(value);
							}
						"
						name="password"
						autocomplete="current-password"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="inputLocked"
						:readonly="readonly"
						v-bind="{
							'aria-invalid': !!(fieldErrors.password || undefined) || undefined,
							'aria-describedby': fieldErrors.password
								? id + '-password-error'
								: undefined
						}"
					/>
					<p
						v-if="fieldErrors.password"
						:id="id + '-password-error'"
						class="login-error"
						role="alert"
					>
						{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.requiredPassword') }}
					</p>
				</div>
				<p v-if="message" class="login-error" role="alert">{{ message }}</p>
				<p v-if="state === 'success'" role="status">
					{{ i18n.t('pro.form.loginSuccess') }}
				</p>
				<AsamButton
					class="login-submit"
					type="primary"
					native-type="submit"
					:size="size"
					:loading="pending"
					:disabled="locked"
					>{{ i18n.t(pending ? 'pro.form.loginPending' : 'pro.form.login') }}</AsamButton
				>
			</AsamBaseForm>
			<div v-if="showRegistration" class="login-alternate">
				<span>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.noAccount') }}</span>
				<AsamButton
					native-type="button"
					:size="size"
					:disabled="disabled || readonly || pending"
					@click="$emit('page', 'register')"
					>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.create') }}</AsamButton
				>
			</div>
		</section>
	</main>
</template>
<script>
import { AsamBaseForm } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, reactive, ref, useId, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamInput, AsamPassword } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAsamProI18n } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { defineComponent } from 'vue';
export default defineComponent({
	name: 'BrandAccountLogin',
	inheritAttrs: false,
	components: { AsamBaseForm, AsamInput, AsamPassword, AsamButton },
	props: {
		authenticate: {
			type: Function,
			required: true
		},
		brandTitle: { type: String, default: 'ASAM基础开发平台' },
		heading: String,
		supportText: String,
		initialUsername: { type: String, default: '' },
		size: { type: String, default: 'default' },
		disabled: Boolean,
		readonly: Boolean,
		showRegistration: { type: Boolean, default: true },
		formatError: Function
	},
	emits: {
		page: (_page) => true,
		completed: (_kind) => true,
		success: () => true,
		pending: (_value) => true
	},
	setup(props, { emit, expose }) {
		const i18n = useAsamProI18n({
			en: {
				'app.templates.account.minimalIntro':
					'Use your account to continue your work today.',
				'app.templates.account.account': 'Account',
				'app.templates.account.password': 'Password',
				'app.templates.account.create': 'Create account',
				'app.templates.account.noAccount': 'Do not have an account?',
				'app.templates.account.entry': 'Account entry',
				'app.templates.account.minimalNote':
					'Make room to focus on what is in front of you.',
				'app.templates.account.minimalContinue': 'Continue your work here.',
				'app.templates.account.brandNote': 'Bring ideas\ninto everyday life.',
				'app.templates.account.brandIntro':
					'Connect your work and team with a clear starting point for every collaboration.',
				'app.templates.account.techNote': 'Connect with focus. Work with confidence.',
				'app.templates.account.techIntro':
					'One account to continue your application workspace.',
				'app.templates.account.minimalLogin': 'Welcome back',
				'app.templates.account.brandLogin': 'Return to your workspace',
				'app.templates.account.brandDescription':
					'Your next team collaboration starts here.',
				'app.templates.account.techLogin': 'Connect to your workspace',
				'app.templates.account.techDescription':
					'Verify your account to continue your application session.',
				'app.templates.account.requiredAccount': 'Enter your account',
				'app.templates.account.requiredPassword': 'Enter your password',
				'app.templates.account.loginRejected':
					'Login did not complete. Check your account and retry.',
				'app.templates.account.loginFailed': 'Login did not complete. Please retry.',
				'app.templates.account.returnDenied':
					'The application does not allow this return path.',
				'app.templates.account.navigationFailed':
					'Login completed, but navigation failed. Use the application navigation.',
				'app.templates.account.wordmark': 'ACCOUNT'
			},
			'zh-CN': {
				'app.templates.account.minimalIntro': '使用你的账户，继续今天的工作。',
				'app.templates.account.account': '账户',
				'app.templates.account.password': '密码',
				'app.templates.account.create': '创建账户',
				'app.templates.account.noAccount': '还没有账户？',
				'app.templates.account.entry': '账户入口',
				'app.templates.account.minimalNote': '留一点空间，专注眼前的事。',
				'app.templates.account.minimalContinue': '你的工作，从这里继续。',
				'app.templates.account.brandNote': '把想法\n带进日常。',
				'app.templates.account.brandIntro':
					'连接你的工作与团队，让每一次协作都有清晰的起点。',
				'app.templates.account.techNote': '专注连接，从容掌控。',
				'app.templates.account.techIntro': '一个账户，继续你的应用工作区。',
				'app.templates.account.minimalLogin': '欢迎回来',
				'app.templates.account.brandLogin': '回到你的工作空间',
				'app.templates.account.brandDescription': '与团队的下一次协作，从这里开始。',
				'app.templates.account.techLogin': '连接工作空间',
				'app.templates.account.techDescription': '验证账户后，继续你的应用会话。',
				'app.templates.account.requiredAccount': '请填写账户',
				'app.templates.account.requiredPassword': '请填写密码',
				'app.templates.account.loginRejected': '登录未能完成，请检查账户后重试',
				'app.templates.account.loginFailed': '登录未能完成，请重试',
				'app.templates.account.returnDenied': '应用未允许此返回路径',
				'app.templates.account.navigationFailed':
					'登录已完成，页面跳转失败，请使用应用导航',
				'app.templates.account.wordmark': '账户'
			}
		});
		const id = useId();
		const draft = reactive({ username: props.initialUsername, password: '' });
		const accountInput = ref();
		const passwordInput = ref();
		const state = ref('idle');
		const pending = computed(() => state.value === 'pending');
		const locked = computed(
			() => !!props.disabled || !!props.readonly || pending.value || state.value === 'success'
		);
		const inputLocked = computed(
			() => !!props.disabled || pending.value || state.value === 'success'
		);
		const fieldErrors = reactive({ account: false, password: false });
		const messageKey = ref('');
		const safeError = ref('');
		const title = computed(() => props.heading ?? i18n.t('app.templates.account.brandLogin'));
		const description = computed(
			() => props.supportText ?? i18n.t('app.templates.account.brandDescription')
		);
		const accountLabel = computed(() => i18n.t('app.templates.account.account'));
		const message = computed(
			() => safeError.value || (messageKey.value ? i18n.t(messageKey.value) : '')
		);
		let revision = 0;
		let disposed = false;
		let requestAbort;
		function setState(value) {
			const wasPending = pending.value;
			state.value = value;
			if (wasPending !== pending.value) emit('pending', pending.value);
		}
		/** Only cancels this template; the injected host retains session/logout APIs. */
		function cancel() {
			++revision;
			requestAbort?.abort();
			requestAbort = undefined;
			draft.password = '';
			messageKey.value = '';
			safeError.value = '';
			fieldErrors.account = false;
			fieldErrors.password = false;
			setState('idle');
		}
		function reset() {
			cancel();
			draft.username = props.initialUsername;
		}
		function clear() {
			cancel();
			draft.username = '';
		}
		async function submit() {
			if (locked.value || disposed) return false;
			messageKey.value = '';
			safeError.value = '';
			fieldErrors.account = !draft.username.trim();
			fieldErrors.password = !draft.password;
			if (fieldErrors.account || fieldErrors.password) {
				await nextTick();
				if (!disposed) {
					if (fieldErrors.account) accountInput.value?.focus();
					else if (fieldErrors.password) passwordInput.value?.focus();
				}
				return false;
			}
			const token = ++revision;
			const controller = new AbortController();
			requestAbort = controller;
			const authenticate = props.authenticate;
			const current = () =>
				!disposed &&
				token === revision &&
				!controller.signal.aborted &&
				authenticate === props.authenticate &&
				!props.disabled &&
				!props.readonly;
			const credentials = { username: draft.username.trim(), password: draft.password };
			setState('pending');
			try {
				await authenticate(credentials, { signal: controller.signal });
				if (!current()) return false;
				draft.password = '';
				setState('success');
				emit('success');
				if (current()) emit('completed', 'login');
				return true;
			} catch (error) {
				if (!current()) return false;
				let display = '';
				try {
					display = props.formatError?.(error) ?? '';
				} catch {
					display = '';
				}
				safeError.value = typeof display === 'string' ? display.slice(0, 500) : '';
				messageKey.value = 'app.templates.account.loginFailed';
				setState('failure');
				return false;
			} finally {
				credentials.password = '';
				if (token === revision) {
					draft.password = '';
					requestAbort = undefined;
					if (pending.value) setState('idle');
				}
			}
		}
		function submitFromForm() {
			void submit();
		}
		function enter(event) {
			if (event.isComposing || event.keyCode === 229) event.preventDefault();
		}
		watch(
			() => [props.disabled, props.readonly, props.authenticate, props.initialUsername],
			reset,
			{
				flush: 'sync'
			}
		);
		onBeforeUnmount(() => {
			disposed = true;
			cancel();
		});
		expose({ clear, reset, cancel, submit });
		return {
			clear,
			reset,
			cancel,
			submit,
			i18n,
			id,
			draft,
			accountInput,
			passwordInput,
			state,
			pending,
			locked,
			inputLocked,
			fieldErrors,
			title,
			description,
			accountLabel,
			message,
			submitFromForm,
			enter
		};
	}
});
</script>
<style scoped>
.login-template {
	--login-canvas: var(--asam-color-surface-page, #fff);
	--login-surface: var(--asam-color-surface, #fff);
	--login-ink: var(--asam-color-text-primary, #242933);
	--login-muted: color-mix(in srgb, var(--login-ink) 80%, var(--login-canvas));
	--login-error: var(--asam-semantic-danger-foreground);
	--login-line: var(--asam-color-border, #d5dbe2);
	--login-accent: var(--asam-semantic-primary-foreground);
	box-sizing: border-box;
	min-height: 100dvh;
	padding: 40px max(32px, calc((100% - 1184px) / 2));
	display: grid;
	grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
	gap: 32px;
	background: var(--login-canvas);
	color: var(--login-ink);
	font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif;
}
.login-template *,
.login-template *::before,
.login-template *::after {
	box-sizing: border-box;
}
.login-wordmark {
	display: inline-flex;
	max-width: 100%;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
	gap: 16px;
	align-items: center;
	font-size: 27px;
	font-weight: 750;
	letter-spacing: -0.055em;
	color: var(--login-accent);
}
.login-wordmark span {
	border-left: 1px solid var(--login-line);
	padding-left: 16px;
	color: var(--login-muted);
	font-size: 10px;
	font-weight: 500;
	letter-spacing: 0.18em;
}
.login-content {
	width: 100%;
	min-width: 0;
	align-self: center;
}
.login-location {
	margin: 0 0 18px;
	color: var(--login-muted);
	font-size: 12px;
}
h1 {
	margin: 0 0 12px;
	font-size: clamp(28px, 3vw, 38px);
	line-height: 1.2;
	font-weight: 650;
	letter-spacing: -0.035em;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
p {
	line-height: 1.65;
}
.login-description {
	margin: 0 0 28px;
	font-size: 14px;
	color: var(--login-muted);
}
.login-form {
	display: grid;
	gap: 22px;
	width: 100%;
	min-width: 0;
}
.login-field {
	display: grid;
	gap: 8px;
	min-width: 0;
}
.login-field label {
	font-size: 14px;
	line-height: 1.5;
}
.login-field :deep(.el-input) {
	width: 100%;
}
.login-submit {
	width: 100%;
	min-width: 0;
	margin: 6px 0 0;
}
.login-form p {
	margin: 0;
}
.login-error {
	color: var(--login-error);
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
	font-size: 14px;
}
.login-alternate {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: 12px;
	align-items: center;
	border-top: 1px solid var(--login-line);
	padding-top: 20px;
	margin-top: 24px;
	font-size: 14px;
	color: var(--login-muted);
}
.login-alternate :deep(.el-button) {
	margin: 0;
}
.login-submit:focus-visible,
.login-alternate :deep(button:focus-visible) {
	outline: 2px solid var(--login-accent);
	outline-offset: 3px;
}
@media (max-width: 767px) {
	.login-template {
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		padding: 24px 20px;
		gap: 28px;
	}
	.login-content {
		flex: 1;
		width: 100%;
		padding-block: 20px;
	}
	h1 {
		font-size: 30px;
	}
}

.login-brand {
	grid-template-columns: minmax(320px, 1fr) minmax(320px, 440px);
	column-gap: clamp(48px, 9vw, 144px);
}
header {
	grid-column: 1 / -1;
}
.login-content {
	grid-column: 2;
	grid-row: 2;
	padding-block: 24px;
}
.login-aside {
	grid-column: 1;
	grid-row: 2;
	align-self: center;
}
.login-aside h2 {
	font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 64px);
	line-height: 1.15;
	letter-spacing: -0.05em;
	margin: 44px 0 24px;
	white-space: pre-line;
}
.login-aside p {
	color: var(--login-muted);
	font-size: 16px;
	white-space: pre-line;
}
.login-orbit {
	width: 210px;
	height: 160px;
	position: relative;
}
.login-orbit i {
	position: absolute;
	width: 132px;
	height: 132px;
	border: 22px solid var(--login-accent);
	border-radius: 50%;
	opacity: 0.16;
}
.login-orbit i:nth-child(2) {
	left: 64px;
	top: 30px;
	opacity: 0.35;
}
.login-orbit i:nth-child(3) {
	left: 20px;
	top: 15px;
	border-width: 1px;
	opacity: 0.75;
}
@media (max-width: 767px) {
	.login-aside {
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		gap: 20px;
	}
	.login-aside h2 {
		font-size: 24px;
		margin: 0;
	}
	.login-aside p {
		display: none;
	}
	.login-orbit {
		width: 90px;
		height: 84px;
		flex: 0 0 auto;
	}
	.login-orbit i {
		width: 64px;
		height: 64px;
		border-width: 10px;
	}
	.login-orbit i:nth-child(2) {
		left: 25px;
		top: 14px;
	}
	.login-orbit i:nth-child(3) {
		left: 10px;
		top: 5px;
	}
}
</style>

import { reactive } from 'vue';
import { createSecurity } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import { createRequestClient, TransportFault } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import { createLatestRequest } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
export const exampleBrand = 'ASAM';
export const exampleAccountLabel = '账户';
/** Synthetic local adapter. No fetch, URL, cookie, token, storage or real account. */
export function createAccountFixture(i18n, profileFields) {
	const controls = reactive({
		mode: 'success',
		delay: 0,
		refreshFailure: false,
		readOnly: false
	});
	const audit = reactive({
		login: 0,
		lastAccount: '',
		register: 0,
		save: 0,
		profile: 0,
		settings: 0,
		verify: 0,
		refresh: 0,
		disposed: false,
		navigations: [],
		escalations: []
	});
	let sequence = 0;
	let currentId = 0;
	let profileName = '林予安';
	let settings = {
		displayName: '林予安',
		email: 'lin@example.invalid',
		phone: '+86 010 5555 0186',
		language: 'zh-CN',
		notifications: true,
		digest: false,
		...(typeof profileFields?.biography === 'string'
			? { biography: profileFields.biography }
			: {}),
		...(typeof profileFields?.officeArea === 'string'
			? { officeArea: profileFields.officeArea }
			: {})
	};
	const operations = new Map();
	const wait = () => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, controls.delay));
	const subject = () => ({
		id: currentId,
		name: profileName,
		roles: ['member'],
		permissions: ['account:read', 'account:write'],
		scope: { tenant: 0, organization: 0 },
		contexts: [
			{ tenant: 0, organization: 0, label: '演示团队' },
			{ tenant: '0', organization: '0', label: '演示团队 B' }
		],
		expiresAt: Date.now() + 3600000,
		readOnly: controls.readOnly
	});
	const security = createSecurity({
		i18n,
		adapter: {
			async login(credentials, request) {
				audit.login++;
				audit.lastAccount = credentials.account;
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent() || !credentials.caller.isCurrent())
					throw new Error('Cancelled');
				if (controls.mode === 'failure') throw new Error('Synthetic failure');
				return subject();
			},
			async restore(request) {
				await wait();
				return request.isCurrent() ? subject() : null;
			},
			async refresh(_subject, request) {
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent()) throw new Error('Cancelled');
				return subject();
			},
			async switchContext(person, scope, request) {
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent()) throw new Error('Cancelled');
				return { ...person, scope };
			},
			async logout() {
				await wait();
			}
		}
	});
	const client = createRequestClient({
		i18n,
		transport: async (input) => {
			const mode = controls.mode;
			const delay = controls.delay;
			await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delay));
			if (mode === 'failure') throw new TransportFault('network');
			if (input.url === 'fixture:profile') {
				audit.profile++;
				const person = input.data;
				return {
					mode: 'data',
					data:
						mode === 'empty'
							? null
							: {
									displayName: person.id === 0 ? profileName : '顾行舟',
									email: settings.email,
									phone: settings.phone,
									organization: `演示组织 ${String(person.scope.organization)}`,
									role: '应用成员',
									joined: '2026-10-01',
									secret: 'must-not-render'
								}
				};
			}
			if (input.url === 'fixture:settings') {
				audit.settings++;
				return { mode: 'data', data: { ...settings } };
			}
			throw new TransportFault('unknown');
		}
	});
	const host = {
		security,
		operationId: () => `synthetic-${++sequence}`,
		canNavigate: (path) => ['/account/profile', '/account/settings'].includes(path),
		navigate: (path) => {
			audit.navigations.push(path);
		},
		resolveUnknown: (kind, id) => {
			audit.escalations.push(`${kind}:${id}`);
		},
		services: {
			login: (credentials, caller) => security.login({ ...credentials, caller }),
			async register(input, request) {
				audit.register++;
				const mode = controls.mode;
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent()) return { status: 'unknown' };
				const result =
					mode === 'field-error'
						? { status: 'field-error', fields: { email: '该邮箱已用于合成账户' } }
						: mode === 'failure'
							? { status: 'failure', message: '演示注册失败，可修改后重试' }
							: { status: 'success', message: `账户 ${input.account} 已创建` };
				operations.set(request.operationId, result);
				return mode === 'unknown' ? { status: 'unknown' } : result;
			},
			async profile(person, request) {
				// Each page read owns a Latest wrapper, never a shared mutable global request slot.
				const latest = createLatestRequest(client, () => undefined);
				try {
					return await latest.load(
						{ url: 'fixture:profile', data: person },
						{
							signal: request.signal,
							decode: (value) => value
						}
					);
				} finally {
					latest.dispose();
				}
			},
			settings: (_person, request) =>
				client.request(
					{ url: 'fixture:settings' },
					{ signal: request.signal, decode: (value) => value }
				),
			async save(_person, input, request) {
				audit.save++;
				const mode = controls.mode;
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent()) return { status: 'unknown' };
				const result =
					mode === 'field-error'
						? { status: 'field-error', fields: { email: '此邮箱未通过应用规则' } }
						: mode === 'failure'
							? { status: 'failure', message: '演示保存被拒绝，请修改后重试' }
							: { status: 'success', message: '账户设置已保存' };
				if (result.status === 'success') settings = { ...input };
				operations.set(request.operationId, result);
				return mode === 'unknown' ? { status: 'unknown' } : result;
			},
			async verifyRegistration(id, request) {
				audit.verify++;
				await wait();
				return request.isCurrent()
					? (operations.get(id) ?? {
							status: 'not-written'
						})
					: { status: 'unknown' };
			},
			async verifySave(_subject, id, request) {
				audit.verify++;
				await wait();
				return request.isCurrent()
					? (operations.get(id) ?? {
							status: 'not-written'
						})
					: { status: 'unknown' };
			},
			async refreshDisplay(_subject, request) {
				audit.refresh++;
				await wait();
				if (!request.isCurrent() || controls.refreshFailure)
					throw new Error('Synthetic display failure');
				profileName = settings.displayName;
			}
		}
	};
	return {
		host,
		controls,
		audit,
		security,
		client,
		async identity(id) {
			currentId = id;
			await security.restore();
		},
		dispose() {
			audit.disposed = true;
			security.dispose();
			client.dispose();
		}
	};
}

<template>
	<main class="login-template login-minimal">
		<header>
			<div class="login-wordmark">
				{{ brandTitle }}<span>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.wordmark') }}</span>
			</div>
		</header>
		<aside class="login-aside">
			<p>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.minimalNote') }}</p>
			<span>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.minimalContinue') }}</span>
		</aside>

		<section class="login-content" :data-login-state="state" :aria-label="title">
			<p class="login-location">{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.entry') }}</p>
			<h1>{{ title }}</h1>
			<p class="login-description">{{ description }}</p>
			<AsamBaseForm
				class="login-form"
				novalidate
				:aria-busy="pending"
				@submit.prevent="submitFromForm"
				@keydown.enter="enter"
			>
				<div class="login-field">
					<label :for="id + '-account'">{{ accountLabel }}</label>
					<AsamInput
						ref="accountInput"
						:id="id + '-account'"
						:model-value="draft.username"
						@update:model-value="
							(value) => {
								draft.username = String(value);
							}
						"
						name="username"
						autocomplete="username"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="inputLocked"
						:readonly="readonly"
						v-bind="{
							'aria-invalid': !!(fieldErrors.account || undefined) || undefined,
							'aria-describedby': fieldErrors.account
								? id + '-account-error'
								: undefined
						}"
					/>
					<p
						v-if="fieldErrors.account"
						:id="id + '-account-error'"
						class="login-error"
						role="alert"
					>
						{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.requiredAccount') }}
					</p>
				</div>
				<div class="login-field">
					<label :for="id + '-password'">{{
						i18n.t('app.templates.account.password')
					}}</label>
					<AsamPassword
						ref="passwordInput"
						:id="id + '-password'"
						:model-value="draft.password"
						@update:model-value="
							(value) => {
								draft.password = String(value);
							}
						"
						name="password"
						autocomplete="current-password"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="inputLocked"
						:readonly="readonly"
						v-bind="{
							'aria-invalid': !!(fieldErrors.password || undefined) || undefined,
							'aria-describedby': fieldErrors.password
								? id + '-password-error'
								: undefined
						}"
					/>
					<p
						v-if="fieldErrors.password"
						:id="id + '-password-error'"
						class="login-error"
						role="alert"
					>
						{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.requiredPassword') }}
					</p>
				</div>
				<p v-if="message" class="login-error" role="alert">{{ message }}</p>
				<p v-if="state === 'success'" role="status">
					{{ i18n.t('pro.form.loginSuccess') }}
				</p>
				<AsamButton
					class="login-submit"
					type="primary"
					native-type="submit"
					:size="size"
					:loading="pending"
					:disabled="locked"
					>{{ i18n.t(pending ? 'pro.form.loginPending' : 'pro.form.login') }}</AsamButton
				>
			</AsamBaseForm>
			<div v-if="showRegistration" class="login-alternate">
				<span>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.noAccount') }}</span>
				<AsamButton
					native-type="button"
					:size="size"
					:disabled="disabled || readonly || pending"
					@click="$emit('page', 'register')"
					>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.create') }}</AsamButton
				>
			</div>
		</section>
	</main>
</template>
<script>
import { AsamBaseForm } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, reactive, ref, useId, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamInput, AsamPassword } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAsamProI18n } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { defineComponent } from 'vue';
export default defineComponent({
	name: 'MinimalAccountLogin',
	inheritAttrs: false,
	components: { AsamBaseForm, AsamInput, AsamPassword, AsamButton },
	props: {
		authenticate: {
			type: Function,
			required: true
		},
		brandTitle: { type: String, default: 'ASAM基础开发平台' },
		heading: String,
		supportText: String,
		initialUsername: { type: String, default: '' },
		size: { type: String, default: 'default' },
		disabled: Boolean,
		readonly: Boolean,
		showRegistration: { type: Boolean, default: true },
		formatError: Function
	},
	emits: {
		page: (_page) => true,
		completed: (_kind) => true,
		success: () => true,
		pending: (_value) => true
	},
	setup(props, { emit, expose }) {
		const i18n = useAsamProI18n({
			en: {
				'app.templates.account.minimalIntro':
					'Use your account to continue your work today.',
				'app.templates.account.account': 'Account',
				'app.templates.account.password': 'Password',
				'app.templates.account.create': 'Create account',
				'app.templates.account.noAccount': 'Do not have an account?',
				'app.templates.account.entry': 'Account entry',
				'app.templates.account.minimalNote':
					'Make room to focus on what is in front of you.',
				'app.templates.account.minimalContinue': 'Continue your work here.',
				'app.templates.account.brandNote': 'Bring ideas into everyday life.',
				'app.templates.account.brandIntro':
					'Connect your work and team with a clear starting point for every collaboration.',
				'app.templates.account.techNote': 'Connect with focus. Work with confidence.',
				'app.templates.account.techIntro':

				'app.templates.account.account': '账户',

				'app.templates.account.create': '创建账户',
				'app.templates.account.noAccount': '还没有账户？',
				'app.templates.account.entry': '账户入口',
				'app.templates.account.minimalNote': '留一点空间，专注眼前的事。',
				'app.templates.account.minimalContinue': '你的工作，从这里继续。',
				'app.templates.account.brandNote': '把想法带进日常。',
				'app.templates.account.brandIntro':
