				'app.templates.account.techNote': '专注连接，从容掌控。',
				'app.templates.account.techIntro': '一个账户，继续你的应用工作区。',
				'app.templates.account.minimalLogin': '欢迎回来',
				'app.templates.account.brandLogin': '回到你的工作空间',
				'app.templates.account.brandDescription': '与团队的下一次协作，从这里开始。',
				'app.templates.account.techLogin': '连接工作空间',
				'app.templates.account.techDescription': '验证账户后，继续你的应用会话。',
				'app.templates.account.requiredAccount': '请填写账户',
				'app.templates.account.requiredPassword': '请填写密码',
				'app.templates.account.loginRejected': '登录未能完成，请检查账户后重试',
				'app.templates.account.loginFailed': '登录未能完成，请重试',
				'app.templates.account.returnDenied': '应用未允许此返回路径',
				'app.templates.account.navigationFailed':
					'登录已完成，页面跳转失败，请使用应用导航',
				'app.templates.account.wordmark': '账户'
			}
		});
		const id = useId();
		const draft = reactive({ username: props.initialUsername, password: '' });
		const accountInput = ref();
		const passwordInput = ref();
		const state = ref('idle');
		const pending = computed(() => state.value === 'pending');
		const locked = computed(
			() => !!props.disabled || !!props.readonly || pending.value || state.value === 'success'
		);
		const inputLocked = computed(
			() => !!props.disabled || pending.value || state.value === 'success'
		);
		const fieldErrors = reactive({ account: false, password: false });
		const messageKey = ref('');
		const safeError = ref('');
		const title = computed(() => props.heading ?? i18n.t('app.templates.account.minimalLogin'));
		const description = computed(
			() => props.supportText ?? i18n.t('app.templates.account.minimalIntro')
		);
		const accountLabel = computed(() => i18n.t('app.templates.account.account'));
		const message = computed(
			() => safeError.value || (messageKey.value ? i18n.t(messageKey.value) : '')
		);
		let revision = 0;
		let disposed = false;
		let requestAbort;
		function setState(value) {
			const wasPending = pending.value;
			state.value = value;
			if (wasPending !== pending.value) emit('pending', pending.value);
		}
		/** Only cancels this template; the injected host retains session/logout APIs. */
		function cancel() {
			++revision;
			requestAbort?.abort();
			requestAbort = undefined;
			draft.password = '';
			messageKey.value = '';
			safeError.value = '';
			fieldErrors.account = false;
			fieldErrors.password = false;
			setState('idle');
		}
		function reset() {
			cancel();
			draft.username = props.initialUsername;
		}
		function clear() {
			cancel();
			draft.username = '';
		}
		async function submit() {
			if (locked.value || disposed) return false;
			messageKey.value = '';
			safeError.value = '';
			fieldErrors.account = !draft.username.trim();
			fieldErrors.password = !draft.password;
			if (fieldErrors.account || fieldErrors.password) {
				await nextTick();
				if (!disposed) {
					if (fieldErrors.account) accountInput.value?.focus();
					else if (fieldErrors.password) passwordInput.value?.focus();
				}
				return false;
			}
			const token = ++revision;
			const controller = new AbortController();
			requestAbort = controller;
			const authenticate = props.authenticate;
			const current = () =>
				!disposed &&
				token === revision &&
				!controller.signal.aborted &&
				authenticate === props.authenticate &&
				!props.disabled &&
				!props.readonly;
			const credentials = { username: draft.username.trim(), password: draft.password };
			setState('pending');
			try {
				await authenticate(credentials, { signal: controller.signal });
				if (!current()) return false;
				draft.password = '';
				setState('success');
				emit('success');
				if (current()) emit('completed', 'login');
				return true;
			} catch (error) {
				if (!current()) return false;
				let display = '';
				try {
					display = props.formatError?.(error) ?? '';
				} catch {
					display = '';
				}
				safeError.value = typeof display === 'string' ? display.slice(0, 500) : '';
				messageKey.value = 'app.templates.account.loginFailed';
				setState('failure');
				return false;
			} finally {
				credentials.password = '';
				if (token === revision) {
					draft.password = '';
					requestAbort = undefined;
					if (pending.value) setState('idle');
				}
			}
		}
		function submitFromForm() {
			void submit();
		}
		function enter(event) {
			if (event.isComposing || event.keyCode === 229) event.preventDefault();
		}
		watch(
			() => [props.disabled, props.readonly, props.authenticate, props.initialUsername],
			reset,
			{
				flush: 'sync'
			}
		);
		onBeforeUnmount(() => {
			disposed = true;
			cancel();
		});
		expose({ clear, reset, cancel, submit });
		return {
			clear,
			reset,
			cancel,
			submit,
			i18n,
			id,
			draft,
			accountInput,
			passwordInput,
			state,
			pending,
			locked,
			inputLocked,
			fieldErrors,
			title,
			description,
			accountLabel,
			message,
			submitFromForm,
			enter
		};
	}
});
</script>

import { onBeforeUnmount, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
/** Carry the actual host scope's ASAM/EP variables across a public body teleport.
 * No global theme writes and no duplicate token-generation algorithm. */
export function useScopedDialogStyle(origin, open) {
	const variables = shallowRef({});
	let observer;
	function collect() {
		if (!open() || !origin.value) return;
		const style = getComputedStyle(origin.value);
		variables.value = Object.fromEntries(
			Array.from(style)
				.filter((key) => key.startsWith('--asam-') || key.startsWith('--el-'))
				.map((key) => [key, style.getPropertyValue(key)])
		);
	}
	function stop() {
		observer?.disconnect();
		observer = undefined;
		window.removeEventListener('resize', collect);
	}
	watch(
		open,
		(value) => {
			stop();
			if (!value || !origin.value) return;
			collect();
			observer = new MutationObserver(collect);
			for (let node = origin.value.parentElement; node; node = node.parentElement)
				observer.observe(node, {
					attributes: true,
					attributeFilter: ['style', 'class', 'data-color-mode']
				});
			window.addEventListener('resize', collect);
		},
		{ flush: 'post' }
	);
	onBeforeUnmount(stop);
	return variables;
}

<template>
	<section class="settings-actions" :aria-label="title">
		<h2>{{ title }}</h2>
		<AsamEmpty v-if="!owned || !items?.length" :description="t('noActions')" />
		<div v-for="item in owned ? items : []" :key="item.id" class="settings-action-row">
			<div>
				<h3>{{ item.title }}</h3>
				<p>{{ item.description }}</p>
				<p class="settings-action-state">{{ owned ? item.status : t('notConnected') }}</p>
			</div>
			<AsamButton
				type="primary"
				plain
				:size="size"
				:disabled="!canOpen(item) || !!pending"
				:loading="pending === item.id"
				@click="open(item)"
				>{{ item.actionLabel }}</AsamButton
			>
		</div>
		<p role="status" aria-live="polite">{{ feedback ? t(feedback) : '' }}</p>
	</section>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed, onScopeDispose, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamEmpty } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { scopeKey } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import { createAccountRequestScope } from '../Session.js';
import { useSettingsWorkspaceText } from './I18n.js';
const props = defineProps({
	host: { type: Object, required: true },
	owner: { type: Object, required: true },
	title: { type: String, required: true },
	items: { type: Array, required: false },
	size: { type: String, required: false },
	disabled: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	readonly: { type: Boolean, required: false }
});
const { t } = useSettingsWorkspaceText();
const pending = shallowRef('');
const feedback = shallowRef();
const owned = computed(() => {
	const state = props.host.security.state.value;
	return (
		state.status === 'authenticated' &&
		!!state.subject &&
		scopeKey(state.subject) === scopeKey(props.owner)
	);
});
const scope = createAccountRequestScope(props.host, () => {
	pending.value = '';
	feedback.value = undefined;
});
const canOpen = (item) =>
	owned.value &&
	!props.disabled &&
	!props.readonly &&
	!!item.open &&
	props.host.security.check(item.rule) === 'allowed';
watch(
	() => [scopeKey(props.owner), props.disabled, props.readonly],
	() => scope.clear(),
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
watch(
	() => props.items,
	(items, previous) => {
		if (
			pending.value &&
			items?.find((item) => item.id === pending.value)?.open !==
				previous?.find((item) => item.id === pending.value)?.open
		)
			scope.clear();
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
async function open(item) {
	if (pending.value || !canOpen(item) || !item.open) return;
	const subject = props.host.security.state.value.subject;
	if (!subject) return;
	const request = scope.request(props.host.operationId(), true);
	pending.value = item.id;
	feedback.value = undefined;
	try {
		await item.open(subject, request);
		if (request.isCurrent() && canOpen(item)) feedback.value = 'opened';
	} catch {
		if (request.isCurrent()) feedback.value = 'actionFailed';
	} finally {
		if (request.isCurrent()) pending.value = '';
		request.release();
	}
}
onScopeDispose(() => scope.dispose());
</script>

<script setup>
import { computed, onScopeDispose, shallowRef, useTemplateRef, watch } from 'vue';

import { scopeKey } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import { createAccountRequestScope, safeAccountUrl } from '../Session.js';
import { useSettingsWorkspaceText } from './I18n.js';
import { useCompleteSettingsText } from '../settings-complete/I18n.js';
const props = defineProps({
	host: { type: Object, required: true },
	owner: { type: Object, required: true },
	validationKey: { type: [String, Number], required: false },
	avatar: { type: Object, required: false },
	disabled: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	readonly: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	size: { type: String, required: false }
});
const emit = defineEmits(['dirty']);
const { t } = useSettingsWorkspaceText();
const { t: completeText } = useCompleteSettingsText();
const upload = useTemplateRef('upload');
const selected = shallowRef();
const preview = shallowRef('');
const pending = shallowRef(false);
const validating = shallowRef(false);
let decoding;
function stopDecode() {
	const prior = decoding;
	decoding = undefined;
	validating.value = false;
	prior?.cancel();
}

	const state = props.host.security.state.value;
	return (
		state.status === 'authenticated' &&
		!!state.subject &&
		scopeKey(state.subject) === scopeKey(props.owner) &&
		props.host.security.check({ permission: 'account:read' }) === 'allowed'
	);
});
const allowed = computed(
	() =>
		owned.value &&
		props.host.security.check({ permission: 'account:write', write: true }) === 'allowed'
);
const blocked = computed(
	() =>
		props.disabled ||

		pending.value ||

function reset() {

	selected.value = undefined;
	pending.value = false;
	feedback.value = undefined;
	emit('dirty', false);

let scope = createAccountRequestScope(props.host, reset);

	() => props.host,
	(host) => {
		scope.dispose();
		scope = createAccountRequestScope(host, reset);
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
watch(
	[
		() => scopeKey(props.owner),
		() => props.avatar?.src,
		() => props.avatar?.save,
		() => props.avatar?.previewOnly
	],
	() => scope.clear(),
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
watch(
	() => [props.disabled, props.readonly, allowed.value, props.validationKey],
	() => {
		if (pending.value || validating.value) scope.clear();
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
async function choose(file) {
	if (blocked.value || !file.raw) return;
	upload.value?.clearFiles();
	stopDecode();
	const raw = file.raw;
	if (
		!['image/jpeg', 'image/png'].includes(raw.type) ||
		raw.size === 0 ||
		raw.size > 2 * 1024 * 1024
	) {
		feedback.value = 'avatarInvalid';
		return;
	}
	const host = props.host;
	// Local preview only: this lease never reaches an upload/save service.
	const request = scope.request('avatar-preview', true);
	let image;
	let candidateUrl = '';
	let released = false;
	const operation = {
		cancel() {
			if (released) return;
			released = true;
			image?.removeAttribute('src');
			if (candidateUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(candidateUrl);
			candidateUrl = '';
			request.release();
		}
	};
	decoding = operation;
	validating.value = true;
	feedback.value = undefined;
	const current = () =>
		decoding === operation &&
		props.host === host &&
		request.isCurrent() &&
		!blocked.value &&
		host.security.check({ permission: 'account:read' }) === 'allowed' &&
		host.security.check({ permission: 'account:write', write: true }) === 'allowed';

		image = new Image();
		candidateUrl = URL.createObjectURL(raw);
		image.src = candidateUrl;
		await image.decode();
		if (!current()) return;
		const prior = preview.value;
		selected.value = raw;
		preview.value = candidateUrl;
		candidateUrl = '';
		if (prior) URL.revokeObjectURL(prior);
		emit('dirty', true);
	} catch {
		if (current()) feedback.value = 'avatarInvalid';
	} finally {
		if (decoding === operation) {
			decoding = undefined;
			validating.value = false;
		}
		operation.cancel();
	}
}
async function save() {
	if (
		blocked.value ||
		validating.value ||
		!selected.value ||
		!props.avatar?.save ||
		props.avatar.previewOnly
	)
		return;
	const state = props.host.security.state.value;
	if (!state.subject) return;
	const request = scope.request(props.host.operationId(), true);
	const file = selected.value;
	pending.value = true;
	feedback.value = undefined;
	try {
		await props.avatar.save(file, state.subject, request);

		feedback.value = 'avatarSaved';
		emit('dirty', false);
	} catch {
		if (request.isCurrent()) feedback.value = 'avatarFailed';
	} finally {
		if (request.isCurrent()) pending.value = false;
		request.release();
	}
}
onScopeDispose(() => scope.dispose());
defineExpose({ clear: () => scope.clear() });
</script>

<script setup>
import { AsamCheckboxItem } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAccountI18n } from '../I18n.js';
const i18n = useAccountI18n();
import {
	createAsamMessageIssue,
	createAsamMessageError,
	formatFieldError
} from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, ref, useId, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamForm, AsamFormItem, AsamInput, AsamPassword } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamLoginForm, createAsamPasswordField, defineAsamFields } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { createRegistration, loginDestination } from '../Session.js';
const props = defineProps({
	host: { type: Object, required: true },
	brand: { type: String, required: false, default: 'ASAM' },
	accountLabel: { type: String, required: false, default: undefined },
	size: { type: String, required: false, default: 'default' },
	disabled: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	readonly: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	returnPath: { type: null, required: false },
	kind: { type: String, required: true },
	title: { type: String, required: true },
	description: { type: String, required: true }
});
const emit = defineEmits(['page', 'completed']);
const id = useId();
const root = ref();
const result = ref();
const registration = createRegistration(props.host, i18n);
const registrationLocked = computed(
	() => props.disabled || ['pending', 'success', 'unknown'].includes(registration.status.value)
);
const loginInitial = { account: '', password: '' };
const loginForm = ref();
const loginFields = computed(() =>
	defineAsamFields([
		{
			key: 'account',
			label: props.accountLabel ?? '账户',
			kind: 'text',
			modes: { edit: { componentProps: { autocomplete: 'username', name: 'username' } } }
		},
		createAsamPasswordField({
			key: 'password',
			label: '密码',
			inputProps: { autocomplete: 'current-password', name: 'password' }
		})
	])
);
const fieldLabels = computed(() => ({
	account: props.accountLabel ?? i18n.t('app.templates.account.account'),
	password: i18n.t('app.templates.account.password')
}));
const loginState = ref('idle');
const navigationError = ref();
const displayNavigationError = computed(() =>
	navigationError.value ? formatFieldError(navigationError.value, i18n) : ''
);
let disposed = false;
let completedOperation = '';
let attempt = 0;
let abort;
let startingAuthentication = false;
async function validateLogin(model) {
	return ['account', 'password']
		.filter((key) => typeof model[key] !== 'string' || !String(model[key]).trim())
		.map((key) =>
			Object.assign(
				createAsamMessageIssue(
					key === 'account' ? '请填写账户' : '请填写密码',
					key === 'account'
						? 'app.templates.account.requiredAccount'
						: 'app.templates.account.requiredPassword'
				),
				{ key }
			)
		);
}
async function authenticate(model, context) {
	const revision = ++attempt;
	const controller = new AbortController();
	abort = controller;
	const cancel = () => controller.abort();
	context.signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true });
	if (context.signal.aborted) cancel();
	const request = {
		operationId: props.host.operationId(),
		signal: controller.signal,
		isCurrent: () =>
			!disposed &&
			revision === attempt &&
			!controller.signal.aborted &&
			!props.disabled &&
			!props.readonly
	};
	const credentials = {
		account: String(model.account),
		password: String(model.password)
	};
	loginState.value = 'pending';
	navigationError.value = undefined;
	try {
		let authentication;
		startingAuthentication = true;
		try {
			authentication = props.host.services.login(credentials, request);
		} finally {
			startingAuthentication = false;
		}
		const accepted = await authentication;
		if (!request.isCurrent()) return { success: false };
		const confirmed =
			accepted &&
			props.host.security.state.value.status === 'authenticated' &&
			!!props.host.security.state.value.subject;
		loginState.value = confirmed ? 'success' : 'failure';
		return Object.assign(
			createAsamMessageIssue(
				'登录未能完成，请检查账户后重试',
				'app.templates.account.loginRejected'
			),
			{ success: confirmed }
		);
	} catch {
		if (request.isCurrent()) loginState.value = 'failure';
		return Object.assign(
			createAsamMessageIssue('登录未能完成，请重试', 'app.templates.account.loginFailed'),
			{ success: false }
		);
	} finally {
		credentials.password = '';
		context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);
	}
}
async function onLoginSuccess() {
	if (disposed || props.disabled) return;
	let destination;
	try {
		destination = loginDestination(props.host, props.returnPath);
	} catch {
		navigationError.value = createAsamMessageError(
			'应用未允许此返回路径',
			'app.templates.account.returnDenied'
		);
		return;
	}
	if (!destination) {
		navigationError.value = createAsamMessageError(
			'应用未允许此返回路径',
			'app.templates.account.returnDenied'
		);
		return;
	}
	try {
		await props.host.navigate(destination);
		if (!disposed) emit('completed', 'login');
	} catch {
		if (!disposed)
			navigationError.value = createAsamMessageError(
				'登录已完成，页面跳转失败，请使用应用导航',
				'app.templates.account.navigationFailed'
			);
	}
}
function cancelLogin(cancel) {
	++attempt;
	abort?.abort();
	cancel();
	loginState.value = 'idle';
	navigationError.value = undefined;
}
function onRegistrationSubmit(event) {
	event.preventDefault();
	void submitRegistration();
}
async function submitRegistration() {
	await completeRegistration('submit');
}
async function completeRegistration(action) {
	const pending = registration[action](props.disabled || (action === 'submit' && props.readonly));
	const operation = registration.operationId.value;
	const accepted = await pending;
	await nextTick();
	if (!disposed && operation === registration.operationId.value) {
		if (
			accepted &&
			operation &&
			operation !== completedOperation &&
			registration.status.value === 'success'
		) {
			completedOperation = operation;
			emit('completed', 'register');
		}
		if (registration.status.value !== 'idle') result.value?.focus();
	}
}
const stopSecurity = props.host.security.onInvalidate(() => {
	// The host's own authentication start must not cancel the initiating login flow.
	if (props.host.security.state.value.status !== 'authenticating' || !startingAuthentication)
		clear();
});
function clear() {
	++attempt;
	abort?.abort();
	loginForm.value?.cancel();
	loginForm.value?.reset();
	registration.clear();
	navigationError.value = undefined;
	loginState.value = 'idle';
}
watch(
	() => [props.disabled, props.readonly],
	() => {
		++attempt;
		abort?.abort();
		loginForm.value?.cancel();
		loginState.value = 'idle';
		registration.secretClear();
	}
);
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	disposed = true;
	++attempt;
	abort?.abort();
	stopSecurity();
	registration.dispose();
});
defineExpose({ clear });
</script>

<template>
	<section class="account-profile" :data-account-state="data.profileStatus.value">
		<slot
			:profile="data.profile.value"
			:status="data.profileStatus.value"
			:allowed="data.allowed()"
			:refresh="() => data.loadProfile(disabled)"

							:alt="i18n.t('app.templates.account.avatar')"

							@error="avatarFailed = true"

<script setup>
import { useAccountI18n } from '../I18n.js';
const i18n = useAccountI18n();
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { createAccountData } from '../Session.js';
const props = defineProps({
	host: { type: Object, required: true },
	brand: { type: String, required: false },
	accountLabel: { type: String, required: false },
	size: { type: String, required: false, default: 'default' },
	disabled: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	readonly: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	returnPath: { type: null, required: false },
	title: { type: String, required: true },
	refreshKey: { type: [String, Number], required: false, default: undefined }
});
const emit = defineEmits(['page', 'completed']);
const data = createAccountData(props.host, i18n);
const avatarFailed = ref(false);
const avatar = computed(() => data.profile.value?.avatar);
const fields = [
	{
		key: 'displayName',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.displayName');
		}
	},
	{
		key: 'email',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.email');
		}
	},
	{
		key: 'phone',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.phone');
		}
	},
	{
		key: 'organization',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.organization');
		}
	},
	{
		key: 'role',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.role');
		}
	},
	{
		key: 'joined',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.joined');
		}
	}
];
watch(
	() => [props.host.security.state.value, props.disabled, props.refreshKey],
	() => {
		avatarFailed.value = false;
		// Optional composed views invalidate the same existing request scope before rereading.
		if (props.refreshKey !== undefined) data.clear();
		void data.loadProfile(props.disabled);
	},
	{ immediate: true, flush: 'post' }
);
onBeforeUnmount(data.dispose);
defineExpose({ clear: data.clear });
</script>

						@click="data.refreshDisplay(disabled)"

				class="account-message-button"
				:size="size"

<script setup>
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamCheckboxItem, AsamTabs, AsamEmpty } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import SettingsAvatar from '../settings/SettingsAvatar.vue';
import SettingsActions from '../settings/SettingsActions.vue';
import LeaveDialog from '../settings-complete/LeaveDialog.vue';
import { useCompleteSettingsText } from '../settings-complete/I18n.js';
import { useSettingsWorkspaceText } from '../settings/I18n.js';
import { scopeKey } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import { useAccountI18n } from '../I18n.js';
const i18n = useAccountI18n();
import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamForm, AsamFormItem, AsamInput, AsamTextarea } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { createAccountData } from '../Session.js';
const props = defineProps({
	host: { type: Object, required: true },
	brand: { type: String, required: false },
	accountLabel: { type: String, required: false },
	size: { type: String, required: false, default: 'default' },
	disabled: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	readonly: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	returnPath: { type: null, required: false },
	title: { type: String, required: true },
	workspace: { type: Object, required: false, default: undefined },
	composition: { type: Object, required: false, default: undefined }
});
const emit = defineEmits(['page', 'completed']);
const { t } = useSettingsWorkspaceText();
const { t: completeText } = useCompleteSettingsText();
const tab = ref('basic');
const tabs = computed(() =>
	['basic', 'security', 'bindings', 'notifications'].map((value) => ({
		value,
		label: t(value)
	}))
);
function setTab(value) {
	if (
		value === 'basic' ||
		value === 'security' ||
		value === 'bindings' ||
		value === 'notifications'
	)
		tab.value = value;
}
const avatarPanel = ref();
const panel = ref();
const desktopTabs = ref(false);
let panelObserver;
const avatarDirty = ref(false);
const data = createAccountData(props.host, i18n, props.composition?.companion);
const profileFields = computed(() => {
	const subject = props.host.security.state.value.subject;
	return subject && props.workspace && scopeKey(subject) === scopeKey(props.workspace.owner)
		? props.workspace.profileFields
		: undefined;
});
function setOfficeArea(value) {
	if (props.composition && (locked.value || !writable.value)) return;
	if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') data.draft.officeArea = '';
	else if (
		typeof value === 'string' &&
		profileFields.value?.officeAreas?.some((item) => item.value === value)
	)
		data.draft.officeArea = value;
}
const result = ref();
const confirmLeave = ref(false);
let disposed = false;
let completedOperation = '';
const writable = computed(() => !props.readonly && data.allowed(true));
const locked = computed(
	() => props.disabled || ['pending', 'unknown'].includes(data.saveStatus.value)
);
const languages = computed(
	() =>
		props.host.languages ?? [
			{ value: 'zh-CN', label: '简体中文' },
			{ value: 'en', label: 'English' }
		]
);
const heights = { small: '28px', default: '32px', big: '36px', large: '40px' };
function setLanguage(value) {
	if (props.composition && (locked.value || !writable.value)) return;
	if (typeof value === 'string' && languages.value.some((item) => item.value === value))
		data.draft.language = value;
}
const textFields = [
	{
		key: 'displayName',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.displayName');
		},
		autocomplete: 'nickname'
	},
	{
		key: 'email',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.email');
		},
		autocomplete: 'email'
	},
	{
		key: 'phone',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.account.phone');
		},
		autocomplete: 'tel'
	}
];
function updateField(field, value) {
	if (locked.value || !writable.value) return;
	if (field === 'notifications' || field === 'digest') data.draft[field] = value === true;
	else if (field === 'displayName' || field === 'email' || field === 'biography')
		data.draft[field] = String(value);
}
function discardAndLeave() {
	if (props.disabled || ['pending', 'unknown'].includes(data.saveStatus.value)) return;
	data.revert();
	avatarPanel.value?.clear();
	confirmLeave.value = false;
	emit('page', 'profile');
}
function beforeUnload(event) {
	if (
		props.composition &&
		(data.dirty.value ||
			avatarDirty.value ||
			['pending', 'unknown'].includes(data.saveStatus.value))
	) {
		event.preventDefault();
		event.returnValue = '';
	}
}
onMounted(() => {
	if (!props.composition) return;
	window.addEventListener('beforeunload', beforeUnload);
	if (panel.value) {
		panelObserver = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => {
			desktopTabs.value = !!entry && entry.contentRect.width >= 900;
		});
		panelObserver.observe(panel.value);
	}
});
async function save() {
	await completeSave('save');
}
async function completeSave(action) {
	await finishSave(data[action](props.disabled || (action === 'save' && !writable.value)));
}
async function saveNotification(field, value) {
	if (locked.value || !writable.value) return;
	await finishSave(data.save(false, { field, value }), false);
}
async function finishSave(pending, focus = true) {
	const operation = data.operationId.value;
	const accepted = await pending;
	await nextTick();
	if (!disposed && operation === data.operationId.value) {
		if (focus) result.value?.focus();
		if (
			accepted &&
			operation &&
			operation !== completedOperation &&
			data.saveStatus.value === 'success'
		) {
			completedOperation = operation;
			emit('completed', 'save');
		}
	}
}
function leave() {
	if (data.dirty.value || avatarDirty.value || data.saveStatus.value === 'unknown')
		confirmLeave.value = true;
	else emit('page', 'profile');
}
watch(
	() => [props.host.security.state.value, props.disabled, props.composition?.revision],
	() => {
		confirmLeave.value = false;
		if (props.composition && !data.allowed()) {
			data.clear();
			avatarPanel.value?.clear();
		}
		void data.loadSettings(props.disabled);
	},
	{ immediate: true, flush: 'post' }
);
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	disposed = true;
	panelObserver?.disconnect();
	window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', beforeUnload);
	data.dispose();
});
defineExpose({
	clear: () => {
		data.clear();
		avatarPanel.value?.clear();
	}
});
</script>
<style scoped>
.account-settings-workspace {
	container-type: inline-size;
	line-height: 1.75;
}

.settings-workspace-columns {
	position: relative;
	min-block-size: 180px;
	padding-inline-start: calc(180px + var(--asam-space-xl));
}

.settings-workspace-columns > .settings-workspace-tabs {
	position: absolute;
	inset-block-start: 0;
	inset-inline-start: 0;
	inline-size: 180px;
}

.settings-workspace-content {
	min-width: 0;
	container-type: inline-size;
}

.account-settings-workspace h1 {
	margin: 0;
	font-size: 28px;
	line-height: 2;
}

.account-settings-workspace .account-intro {
	margin: 4px 0 24px;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
}

.settings-workspace-profile {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.6fr) minmax(240px, 1fr);
	grid-template-areas: 'fields avatar';
	gap: clamp(32px, 4vw, 64px);
	padding-block: 24px;
}

.settings-workspace-profile > .settings-workspace-fields {
	grid-area: fields;
	min-width: 0;
}

.settings-workspace-avatar {
	grid-area: avatar;
	min-width: 0;
	padding-inline: var(--asam-space-lg);
	border-inline-start: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
}

/* stylelint-disable-next-line selector-class-pattern -- Element Plus 公开结构类。 */
.account-settings-workspace :deep(.el-form-item__label) {
	line-height: 1.75;
}

.account-settings-workspace .account-actions {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: 12px;
	margin-block: 20px;
}

.account-settings-workspace .account-actions :deep(.el-button) {
	margin-left: 0;
}

.account-settings-workspace .account-leave {
	padding: 20px;
	border: 1px solid var(--asam-color-warning);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-container, 8px);
}

@container (width < 740px) {
	.settings-workspace-profile {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
		grid-template-areas:
			'avatar'
			'fields';
		gap: 32px;
	}

	.settings-workspace-avatar {
		padding-inline: 0;
		padding-block-end: var(--asam-space-lg);
		border-inline-start: 0;
		border-block-end: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	}
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
	.account-settings-workspace :deep(*) {
		animation-duration: 0s;
		transition-duration: 0s;
	}
}

<template>
	<main class="login-template login-tech" data-theme="dark">
		<header>
			<div class="login-wordmark">
				{{ brandTitle }}<span>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.wordmark') }}</span>
			</div>
		</header>
		<aside class="login-aside">
			<div class="login-geometry" aria-hidden="true"><i /><i /><i /></div>
			<div>
				<h2>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.techNote') }}</h2>
				<p>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.techIntro') }}</p>
			</div>
		</aside>

		<section class="login-content" :data-login-state="state" :aria-label="title">
			<p class="login-location">{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.entry') }}</p>
			<h1>{{ title }}</h1>
			<p class="login-description">{{ description }}</p>
			<AsamBaseForm
				class="login-form"
				novalidate
				:aria-busy="pending"
				@submit.prevent="submitFromForm"
				@keydown.enter="enter"
			>
				<div class="login-field">
					<label :for="id + '-account'">{{ accountLabel }}</label>
					<AsamInput
						ref="accountInput"
						:id="id + '-account'"
						:model-value="draft.username"
						@update:model-value="
							(value) => {
								draft.username = String(value);
							}
						"
						name="username"
						autocomplete="username"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="inputLocked"
						:readonly="readonly"
						v-bind="{
							'aria-invalid': !!(fieldErrors.account || undefined) || undefined,
							'aria-describedby': fieldErrors.account
								? id + '-account-error'
								: undefined
						}"
					/>
					<p
						v-if="fieldErrors.account"
						:id="id + '-account-error'"
						class="login-error"
						role="alert"
					>
						{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.requiredAccount') }}
					</p>
				</div>
				<div class="login-field">
					<label :for="id + '-password'">{{
						i18n.t('app.templates.account.password')
					}}</label>
					<AsamPassword
						ref="passwordInput"
						:id="id + '-password'"
						:model-value="draft.password"
						@update:model-value="
							(value) => {
								draft.password = String(value);
							}
						"
						name="password"
						autocomplete="current-password"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="inputLocked"
						:readonly="readonly"
						v-bind="{
							'aria-invalid': !!(fieldErrors.password || undefined) || undefined,
							'aria-describedby': fieldErrors.password
								? id + '-password-error'
								: undefined
						}"
					/>
					<p
						v-if="fieldErrors.password"
						:id="id + '-password-error'"
						class="login-error"
						role="alert"
					>
						{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.requiredPassword') }}
					</p>
				</div>
				<p v-if="message" class="login-error" role="alert">{{ message }}</p>
				<p v-if="state === 'success'" role="status">
					{{ i18n.t('pro.form.loginSuccess') }}
				</p>
				<AsamButton
					class="login-submit"
					type="primary"
					native-type="submit"
					:size="size"
					:loading="pending"
					:disabled="locked"
					>{{ i18n.t(pending ? 'pro.form.loginPending' : 'pro.form.login') }}</AsamButton
				>
			</AsamBaseForm>
			<div v-if="showRegistration" class="login-alternate">
				<span>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.noAccount') }}</span>
				<AsamButton
					native-type="button"
					:size="size"
					:disabled="disabled || readonly || pending"
					@click="$emit('page', 'register')"
					>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.account.create') }}</AsamButton
				>
			</div>
		</section>
	</main>
</template>
<script>
import { AsamBaseForm } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, reactive, ref, useId, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamInput, AsamPassword } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAsamProI18n } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { defineComponent } from 'vue';
export default defineComponent({
	name: 'TechAccountLogin',
	inheritAttrs: false,
	components: { AsamBaseForm, AsamInput, AsamPassword, AsamButton },
	props: {
		authenticate: {
			type: Function,
			required: true
		},
		brandTitle: { type: String, default: 'ASAM基础开发平台' },
		heading: String,
		supportText: String,
		initialUsername: { type: String, default: '' },
		size: { type: String, default: 'default' },
		disabled: Boolean,
		readonly: Boolean,
		showRegistration: { type: Boolean, default: true },
		formatError: Function
	},
	emits: {
		page: (_page) => true,
		completed: (_kind) => true,
		success: () => true,
		pending: (_value) => true
	},
	setup(props, { emit, expose }) {
		const i18n = useAsamProI18n({
			en: {
				'app.templates.account.minimalIntro':
					'Use your account to continue your work today.',
				'app.templates.account.account': 'Account',
				'app.templates.account.password': 'Password',
				'app.templates.account.create': 'Create account',
				'app.templates.account.noAccount': 'Do not have an account?',
				'app.templates.account.entry': 'Account entry',
				'app.templates.account.minimalNote':
					'Make room to focus on what is in front of you.',
				'app.templates.account.minimalContinue': 'Continue your work here.',
				'app.templates.account.brandNote': 'Bring ideas into everyday life.',
				'app.templates.account.brandIntro':
					'Connect your work and team with a clear starting point for every collaboration.',
				'app.templates.account.techNote': 'Connect with focus. Work with confidence.',
				'app.templates.account.techIntro':
					'One account to continue your application workspace.',
				'app.templates.account.minimalLogin': 'Welcome back',
				'app.templates.account.brandLogin': 'Return to your workspace',
				'app.templates.account.brandDescription':
					'Your next team collaboration starts here.',
				'app.templates.account.techLogin': 'Connect to your workspace',
				'app.templates.account.techDescription':
					'Verify your account to continue your application session.',
				'app.templates.account.requiredAccount': 'Enter your account',
				'app.templates.account.requiredPassword': 'Enter your password',
				'app.templates.account.loginRejected':
					'Login did not complete. Check your account and retry.',
				'app.templates.account.loginFailed': 'Login did not complete. Please retry.',
				'app.templates.account.returnDenied':
					'The application does not allow this return path.',
				'app.templates.account.navigationFailed':
					'Login completed, but navigation failed. Use the application navigation.',
				'app.templates.account.wordmark': 'ACCOUNT'
			},
			'zh-CN': {
				'app.templates.account.minimalIntro': '使用你的账户，继续今天的工作。',
				'app.templates.account.account': '账户',
				'app.templates.account.password': '密码',
				'app.templates.account.create': '创建账户',
				'app.templates.account.noAccount': '还没有账户？',
				'app.templates.account.entry': '账户入口',
				'app.templates.account.minimalNote': '留一点空间，专注眼前的事。',
				'app.templates.account.minimalContinue': '你的工作，从这里继续。',
				'app.templates.account.brandNote': '把想法带进日常。',
				'app.templates.account.brandIntro':
					'连接你的工作与团队，让每一次协作都有清晰的起点。',
				'app.templates.account.techNote': '专注连接，从容掌控。',
				'app.templates.account.techIntro': '一个账户，继续你的应用工作区。',
				'app.templates.account.minimalLogin': '欢迎回来',
				'app.templates.account.brandLogin': '回到你的工作空间',
				'app.templates.account.brandDescription': '与团队的下一次协作，从这里开始。',
				'app.templates.account.techLogin': '连接工作空间',
				'app.templates.account.techDescription': '验证账户后，继续你的应用会话。',
				'app.templates.account.requiredAccount': '请填写账户',
				'app.templates.account.requiredPassword': '请填写密码',
				'app.templates.account.loginRejected': '登录未能完成，请检查账户后重试',
				'app.templates.account.loginFailed': '登录未能完成，请重试',
				'app.templates.account.returnDenied': '应用未允许此返回路径',
				'app.templates.account.navigationFailed':
					'登录已完成，页面跳转失败，请使用应用导航',
				'app.templates.account.wordmark': '账户'
			}
		});
		const id = useId();
		const draft = reactive({ username: props.initialUsername, password: '' });
		const accountInput = ref();
		const passwordInput = ref();
		const state = ref('idle');
		const pending = computed(() => state.value === 'pending');
		const locked = computed(
			() => !!props.disabled || !!props.readonly || pending.value || state.value === 'success'
		);
		const inputLocked = computed(
			() => !!props.disabled || pending.value || state.value === 'success'
		);
		const fieldErrors = reactive({ account: false, password: false });
		const messageKey = ref('');
		const safeError = ref('');
		const title = computed(() => props.heading ?? i18n.t('app.templates.account.techLogin'));
		const description = computed(
			() => props.supportText ?? i18n.t('app.templates.account.techDescription')
		);
		const accountLabel = computed(() => i18n.t('app.templates.account.account'));
		const message = computed(
			() => safeError.value || (messageKey.value ? i18n.t(messageKey.value) : '')
		);
		let revision = 0;
		let disposed = false;
		let requestAbort;
		function setState(value) {
			const wasPending = pending.value;
			state.value = value;
			if (wasPending !== pending.value) emit('pending', pending.value);
		}
		/** Only cancels this template; the injected host retains session/logout APIs. */
		function cancel() {
			++revision;
			requestAbort?.abort();
			requestAbort = undefined;
			draft.password = '';
			messageKey.value = '';
			safeError.value = '';
			fieldErrors.account = false;
			fieldErrors.password = false;
			setState('idle');
		}
		function reset() {
			cancel();
			draft.username = props.initialUsername;
		}
		function clear() {
			cancel();
			draft.username = '';
		}
		async function submit() {
			if (locked.value || disposed) return false;
			messageKey.value = '';
			safeError.value = '';
			fieldErrors.account = !draft.username.trim();
			fieldErrors.password = !draft.password;
			if (fieldErrors.account || fieldErrors.password) {
				await nextTick();
				if (!disposed) {
					if (fieldErrors.account) accountInput.value?.focus();
					else if (fieldErrors.password) passwordInput.value?.focus();
				}
				return false;
			}
			const token = ++revision;
			const controller = new AbortController();
			requestAbort = controller;
			const authenticate = props.authenticate;
			const current = () =>
				!disposed &&
				token === revision &&
				!controller.signal.aborted &&
				authenticate === props.authenticate &&
				!props.disabled &&
				!props.readonly;
			const credentials = { username: draft.username.trim(), password: draft.password };
			setState('pending');
			try {
				await authenticate(credentials, { signal: controller.signal });
				if (!current()) return false;
				draft.password = '';
				setState('success');
				emit('success');
				if (current()) emit('completed', 'login');
				return true;
			} catch (error) {
				if (!current()) return false;
				let display = '';
				try {
					display = props.formatError?.(error) ?? '';
				} catch {
					display = '';
				}
				safeError.value = typeof display === 'string' ? display.slice(0, 500) : '';
				messageKey.value = 'app.templates.account.loginFailed';
				setState('failure');
				return false;
			} finally {
				credentials.password = '';
				if (token === revision) {
					draft.password = '';
					requestAbort = undefined;
					if (pending.value) setState('idle');
				}
			}
		}
		function submitFromForm() {
			void submit();
		}
		function enter(event) {
			if (event.isComposing || event.keyCode === 229) event.preventDefault();
		}
		watch(
			() => [props.disabled, props.readonly, props.authenticate, props.initialUsername],
			reset,
			{
				flush: 'sync'
			}
		);
		onBeforeUnmount(() => {
			disposed = true;
			cancel();
		});
		expose({ clear, reset, cancel, submit });
		return {
			clear,
			reset,
			cancel,
			submit,
			i18n,
			id,
			draft,
			accountInput,
			passwordInput,
			state,
			pending,
			locked,
			inputLocked,
			fieldErrors,
			title,
			description,
			accountLabel,
			message,
			submitFromForm,
			enter
		};
	}
});
</script>

<script setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'TechAccountProfile' });
import { useAccountI18n } from '../I18n.js';
const i18n = useAccountI18n();
import { ref } from 'vue';
import AccountFrame from '../shared/AccountFrame.vue';
import ProfilePanel from '../shared/ProfilePanel.vue';
const props = defineProps({
	host: { type: Object, required: true },
	brand: { type: String, required: false, default: 'ASAM Console' },
	accountLabel: { type: String, required: false },
	size: { type: String, required: false, default: 'default' },
	disabled: { type: Boolean, required: false },

});

<template>
	<AccountFrame
		family="tech"
		page="settings"
		:brand="brand"
		:disabled="disabled"
		@page="emit('page', $event)"
		><SettingsPanel
			ref="panel"
			v-bind="props"
			:title="i18n.t('app.templates.account.techSettings')"
			@page="emit('page', $event)"
			@completed="emit('completed', $event)"
	/></AccountFrame>
</template>
<script setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'TechAccountSettings' });
import { useAccountI18n } from '../I18n.js';
const i18n = useAccountI18n();
import { ref } from 'vue';
import AccountFrame from '../shared/AccountFrame.vue';
import SettingsPanel from '../shared/SettingsPanel.vue';
const props = defineProps({
	host: { type: Object, required: true },
	brand: { type: String, required: false, default: 'ASAM Console' },
	accountLabel: { type: String, required: false },
	size: { type: String, required: false, default: 'default' },
	disabled: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	readonly: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	returnPath: { type: null, required: false }
});
const emit = defineEmits(['page', 'completed']);
const panel = ref();
defineExpose({ clear: () => panel.value?.clear() });
</script>

三族登录、注册、资料与设置页面。登录组件可独立复制，完整账户工程保留同一份 App、页面和本地合成宿主。

完整工程解压后执行 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile、pnpm run typecheck、pnpm run dev、pnpm run build。保留 vendor、锁文件及补丁。?locale=en 可体验英文。

独立登录接入

三种独立登录 SFC ​

tech/Login.vue、brand/Login.vue、minimal/Login.vue 分别为深色网格、品牌分栏、留白简约。各文件包含自己的布局、表单、必要交互与 scoped 样式，可只复制一个文件，不依赖其他模板、AccountFrame、AuthPanel、私有图片或项目别名。

三种模板均不显示“清空登录”动作，登录主按钮与账号、密码输入左右对齐，占满表单内容宽度。注册入口默认保留；仅做登录的宿主可传 :show-registration="false"。程序化 clear/reset/cancel/submit 仍可通过组件 ref 使用，不删除公共流程组件或宿主的 session/logout 能力。

唯一认证契约 ​

采用 LOGIN-20261028-HOST-CONTRACT-R1：

ts
async function authenticate(
	credentials: { username: string; password: string },
	context: { signal: AbortSignal }
): Promise<void> {
	await applicationLogin(credentials, context);
}

宿主注入一个函数，三份模板使用同一个适配契约。用户名 trim，密码原样传入；没有初始密码、密码持久化、凭据日志、凭据事件或 URL 参数。函数仅在宿主确认登录成功后 resolve，失败或取消必须 reject。模板不接收 token、store、router、租户管理或验证码实现。

宿主独占实际 API、验证码、租户、token 校验/存储、安全 redirect。即使请求能 abort，宿主也必须在 token、会话和跳转副作用前再次检查 signal 与自身生命周期；模板的取消不证明底层网络实际取消。模板切换器属于宿主，使用独立 key/实例，切换不触发认证。

默认仅显示固定本地化错误，不显示原异常消息或后端载荷。formatError(error) 可将宿主允许的错误映射成显示安全文本；其返回值作为纯文本，限制500字符。请勿直接返回任意后端异常。

最小接入 ​

vue
<template>
	<Login :authenticate="authenticate" :show-registration="false" />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Login from './Login.vue';
import { applicationLogin } from './application-login';

const authenticate = applicationLogin;
</script>

application-login 是宿主自己的唯一认证适配，不是另一份模板依赖。模板只依赖 Vue、@asam-ui/ui 的公开控件和 @asam-ui/pro/i18n。宿主引入 element-plus/dist/index.css、适用暗色变量、@asam-ui/ui/style.css 与 @asam-ui/pro/style.css；使用公开 Provider 传入主题/locale，四档尺寸为 small/default/big/large。模板本身没有动画或外部资源下载。

本次固定正常对为 Pro9160 / UI2c7，准确 tar、bytes、SHA/SRI 见本卡交付封套。沿用已有正常包原字节，不为纯模板改动重建库。旧 Pro1235/UI24d 没有所需公开 i18n 子出口，不能因 alpha 版本相同而混用，亦未声称旧对可直接编译本文件。

公共呈现与事件 ​

入口 语义
authenticate 必填，R1认证函数
brandTitle 默认“ASAM基础开发平台”
heading / supportText 可选标题与说明；省略时跟随公开i18n作用域
initialUsername 仅初始用户名，默认空；改变后取消旧请求并重置
size 四档ASAM尺寸
disabled / readonly 阻止新提交；变化时取消本实例请求并清密码；readonly输入保留原生只读语义
showRegistration 默认true，隐藏时不留占位
formatError 可选、安全错误映射
success / completed('login') 当前实例的认证函数成功完成后通知；不携带凭据/token
pending(boolean) 本实例提交状态变化
page('register') 原注册导航意图，宿主决定如何处理
ref submit() 同步获取防重入门禁，返回 Promise<boolean>
ref cancel() abort本实例请求、清密码，保留用户名
ref reset() cancel后恢复initialUsername
ref clear() cancel后用户名也置空

提交中字段和主按钮锁定。成功、失败、取消、卸载均清密码；晚到回调不改变已取消或卸载的界面。原生form支持Enter，组合输入期间的Enter不提交。登录成功状态阻止重复提交，宿主可切换页面或显式reset开启新会话。

原 AccountHost 的适配 ​

原公开模板导出名 MinimalLogin / BrandLogin / TechLogin 和三条文件路径保留。它们从 host prop 转向必填的 R1 authenticate prop，属于明确的模板接入调整；register/profile/settings 与公共 AsamLoginForm 不变。

LoginAdapter.ts 是原 AccountHost 到R1的一次桥接：将username映射为原account，透传signal/isCurrent，确认原security主体后校验允许路径并导航。不会复制业务认证或删除旧session/logout。共享 examples/App.vue 的精确适配差额由原官网owner受控合并，本卡不并发覆盖其在途源码；送测消费使用固定原作者源的携带副本加该具名差额，明确与真实官网集入区分。

平台任务3仍须等待维护主控在任务1独立QA→ACC、精确集入及适用回归后签发 READY_FOR_INTEGRATION。开发自测或最小消费不代表平台真实账号登录通过。

运行与展示源码

下面的代码、复制内容和预览读取同一份投影；三个 Login.vue 的单文件下载与作者原件一致。完整运行文件清单保留原目录。TS 源码 ZIP 保留完整原件，JS 源码 ZIP 提供同源 JavaScript 投影；TS 工程提供 main.ts，JS 工程提供 main.js，两者均包含正常依赖、入口和上下文，不能将单个 App.vue 当完整工程。

下载 minimal Login.vue下载 brand Login.vue下载 tech Login.vue
账户模板接口与宿主约定

公开API ​

completed 保持公开事件：注册/保存直接成功或使用原 operationId 核实成功后，当前有效页面每个写操作仅通知一次。核实只查询，不重发注册/保存；重复点击及非成功结果不通知，失效/clear/卸载后的回包不通知，refreshDisplay 不重复通知。submit、save 和 verify 返回 Promise，仅当前有效操作确认 success 时为 true；事件由页面统一交付。

事实来源 Types.ts、Session.ts 与各SFC。相对源码依赖033 Security.ts/Types.ts；不在UI包中反向导出。

入口 Props Events Slots Expose
三族 Login/Register/Profile/Settings host必填；brand、accountLabel、size、disabled、readonly、returnPath可选 page(AccountPage)、completed('login'/'register'/'save') 无；编辑完整SFC组合 clear():void
shared/AccountFrame family、page必填；brand、disabled page default 无
shared/AuthPanel AccountPageProps及kind、title、description；accountLabel 同页面 无；复用017默认fields clear
shared/ProfilePanel、SettingsPanel AccountPageProps及title 同页面 无 clear

默认size=default；brand各族SFC可编辑，演示宿主显式传ASAM；disabled/readonly=false。tech始终深色，其余继承当前应用provider。clear清理页面自有状态，并不是宿主登出。page不直接改浏览器URL，宿主负责安全路由和dirty导航守卫。

AccountHost：security只借state/check/onInvalidate；services必填login/register/profile/settings/save，verifyRegistration/verifySave/refreshDisplay可选。operationId同步生成稳定非秘密标识；canNavigate明确返回boolean；navigate宿主实现；resolveUnknown必填，交待核操作给宿主处理，即使没有verify也有处理入口；registration可配置用户名label、密码最小长度、是否必需同意、附加同步validator；languages有限value/label列表。

AccountRequest包含signal、isCurrent与operationId。取消隔离本页，宿主在后端/存储副作用前另核request及security请求有效。所有service错误信息先由宿主变成显示安全文案，不返回原异常。AccountProfile只允许6展示字段及可选avatar/website，AccountSettings只允许6编辑字段，公开类型无password/token。

WriteResult是判别联合：success{message}、field-error{fields}、failure{message}、unknown。verify另外可返回not-written；后者明确允许用户重新提交新操作，不能由超时推断。失败恢复保留非秘密草稿，注册需重新填写密码。未知结果不自动重发，不伪装成未写入。

createRegistration(host)：draft/status/errors/message/operationId、submit(blocked?)、verify(blocked?)、secretClear/clear/dispose。createAccountData(host)：profile/profileStatus、draft/original/dirty、settingsStatus/saveStatus/displayStatus、errors/message/operationId、allowed(write?)、loadProfile/loadSettings/revert/save/verify/refreshDisplay、clear/dispose。它们只能在Vue effect scope/setup中创建，并按owner销毁。组件优先作为复制入口，业务组合供定制使用。公开方法不包含任意认证或权限引擎。

安全结果顺序：身份代次失效先清旧数据，晚到结果无论是否遵守AbortSignal都不能提交；发送保存前check写权限；profile/settings加载只接受对应最新本页读取。数值0/字符串0不转换。host实例自身的生命周期由宿主结束，单页离开不能dispose它。

login服务在第一次await前同步调用033的security.login，异步准备放进033 adapter.login；模板只豁免该同步发起事件，其余外部认证/恢复/登出均清页。adapter提交前同时检查033与页面request.isCurrent，返回true还必须对应033 authenticated subject。不能直接写入一个独立的页面认证状态。

三族账户页面 · V2-042 ​

本目录为可复制的应用模板，不是 UI 运行时新增组件。入口 index.ts 提供 Minimal / Brand / Tech 各 Login、Register、Profile、Settings 十二个完整 Vue SFC。每个页面显式接收同一个类型化 AccountHost，用 page 事件交宿主路由，completed 表示已确认成功。登录使用017公开 AsamLoginForm/AsamLoginPage，其他页面组合已验 ASAM 控件；安全状态来自033，示例读取与安全错误使用035，均消费同版本正常包公开入口。

选择与复制 ​

个人资料顶部的姓名与组织保留宿主返回的完整文本。头像旁文字区允许 flex 收缩与长词换行；定制布局时保留 account-person-info 的 min-width: 0 和 overflow-wrap: anywhere，不以截断姓名或限制合法资料长度代替窄屏适配。

completed('register'/'save') 在当前页面的一次 operationId 首次确认成功时发送一次，直接成功与 unknown 后核实成功遵守相同契约；核实不再写入。重复点击、失败、仍未知或明确未写入不发送成功事件，会话/作用域失效、clear 或卸载后的晚到结果也不发送。readonly 允许核实既有操作，disabled 阻止新核实；显示刷新独立，不重发 completed。

族 构图 适用场景 默认明暗
minimal 留白单栏、文档字体、侧边短注 安静的日常工作区 继承 AsamApplicationProvider
brand 品牌图形与大字分栏、独立表单列 面向团队的品牌入口 继承 AsamApplicationProvider
tech 网格底纹、线框结构、深色控制面板 技术应用入口 固定深色，父级明暗均可用

复制整个 templates/account，安全和请求直接消费 @asam-ui/pro/application/security 与 @asam-ui/pro/application/transport。宿主安装正常 @asam-ui/ui、@asam-ui/pro、Vue3.5.34、Element Plus2.14.7，显式导入EP基础CSS、UI与Pro的style.css，提供应用主题和数据provider。实例创建一个宿主，SSR每请求隔离，禁止模块级认证单例。目录不可只复制一个SFC而遗漏shared、Types、Session、CSS。

完整可运行宿主为 examples/App.vue 与 examples/Fixture.ts，正常Vite工程在 tests/v2/account/。准备脚本使用已验b9普通双包，不把ebcf源码冒称为包producer。隔离consumer不依赖原角色工作区：保全源码树、package、锁、双包和dist后可在另一目录复放。tests/v2/account/env.ps1 是当前机器运行入口；迁移时将canonical脚本路径替换为当前宿主入口，pnpm根/缓存规则不能照搬到其他机器。

四页与应用边界 ​

登录2字段、注册4字段与必要同意、个人6展示字段、设置6编辑字段均完整。size=large/big/default/small分别40/36/32/28。readonly可阅读但不写入，disabled阻断新页面动作；设置保存前重新检查033的 account:write 与身份。个人/设置读取需 account:read。菜单和入口可见性不构成鉴权，实际后端仍须拒绝越权。

宿主实现 AccountServices。登录服务必须把页面request与033 SecurityRequest一起用于 isCurrent，认证、cookie/token和其他副作用由宿主提交；模板只判服务明确返回true后，经过033 safeReturnPath和canNavigate双重检查再请求导航。可配置returnPath，默认 /account/profile。外站、协议相对、编码路径绕过走安全默认路径；不在allowlist的应用路径不跳转。恢复、过期、登出、重新登录、身份/租户/组织变化使旧读取和草稿失效，数值0与字符串0按033 scopeKey精确区分。

注册结果为success/field-error/failure/unknown。成功只表示注册服务确认，不代表已发送邮件、已验证、已认证；示例无邮件/MFA/OAuth/密码重置，故不展示这些可用入口。添加重置需另行类型化注入输入/请求/明确结果，不能复用注册成功来冒发送成功。密码仅存在当前输入及本次请求所需短周期，注册发送前清空UI、结束时清空本地请求对象，离开/取消清理。禁止放URL、storage、日志、遥测、结果文案或截图，禁止保存密码以自动重试。

个人服务只映射AccountProfile白名单，原始DTO不展示。头像只接受相对路径或无凭据HTTPS，失败回退显示名首字；个人链接使用安全URL与noopener/noreferrer。宿主进一步限制外部host；所有文字用Vue文本插值。设置只有显示名、邮箱、电话、语言和两通知偏好，语言不创建全局存储。

注册/保存每次实际写入只创建一个operationId，unknown锁住重发。可选verify使用原id，只查询结果；无verify时显示待核并可交host.resolveUnknown。宿主负责记录未决操作，页面离开不能撤销已发生的后端副作用。设置保存成功更新本页基线，refreshDisplay是独立显示刷新，失败仅重试刷新，不重发保存。readonly/disabled、会话变化和卸载不能撤销已发生远端写入，宿主最终负责核实。

页面只dispose自己创建的请求、watch和订阅；不会dispose借入security/client。宿主更换必须重建页面实例；禁止在已挂载实例中替换host对象。宿主路由如能绕过page事件直接离开，应调用自己的dirty/unknown导航确认，模板设置页返回按钮已经提供明确的继续编辑/离开选择。

迁移 ​

旧静态登录/注册页：替换为同族完整SFC，删除页内token/storage、硬编码生产URL与隐式自动登录；映射现有后端DTO为AccountHost。旧个人DTO直出：改为AccountProfile白名单。旧设置保存后重发保存刷新：分为save与refreshDisplay，并保留unknown操作身份。模板没有修改017/033/035接口，无需重新验全部上游。当前消费绑定、失败与未测以 DELIVERY.md 为准，本文不是独立QA/ACC通过声明。

统一语言、模板本地资源、纯工厂 owner 与迁移边界见 I18nGuide.md。

统一语言接入 ​

复制整个账户目录，保留 I18n*.ts、shared/、三族页面和样式。安全、请求能力由匹配正常包的 @asam-ui/pro/application/security、@asam-ui/pro/application/transport 提供，不再复制 templates/app 兼容转发器。

vue
<template>
	<AsamConfigProvider :i18n="i18n"><MinimalLogin :host="host" /></AsamConfigProvider>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { createAsamProI18n } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { MinimalLogin } from './account/index.js';
// locale 来自宿主现有偏好。host 为既有 AccountHost，不在模板中创建认证单例。
const i18n = createAsamProI18n(() => ({ locale: preferences.locale.value }));
// 应用结束释放 i18n；preferences/host 由各自 owner 释放。
</script>

AccountFrame 将局部模板资源 scope 传入子树。页面、UI 和 Pro 沿同一语言来源，资源优先级低于宿主的注册/覆盖。未提供统一语言时保留旧默认。默认资源只在本目录，命名空间为 app.templates.account.*，没有进入 Pro 核心字典。I18nParameters.ts 对 UI 公共消息接口做模块扩展，passwordShort.minimum 为数字，brandWorkspace.brand 为字符串。

纯工厂兼容原签名，并可显式传 owner：createRegistration(host, i18n?)、createAccountData(host, i18n?)。工厂只释放派生 scope。原 errors/message、服务诊断保持原值；displayErrors/displayMessage 在展示时解析明确标记的模板消息。宿主字段校验、成功/失败文案即使与默认中文相同，也保持宿主原文。空显示覆盖不影响原始字段校验。

登录 schema 不随语言重建；fieldLabels 单独控制显示，不进入 fields/model 重置观察。切语言保留密码草稿和焦点。设置中的 AccountSettings.language 是提交给宿主的资料字段，不是第二个 UI 当前语言，切 UI 语言不改它。密码不写 storage、URL、日志、遥测或截图。

示例外围操作和 ARIA 同样接入此 scope；createAccountFixture(i18n?) 显式把 owner 传给合成安全/请求实例。合成人名、组织、服务反馈仍为示例宿主数据。第三语言及原生 Element Plus locale、异步加载和持久化由应用负责；资源就绪后才更新既有偏好。失败和晚到请求不切语言。可运行正常包夹具见 tests/i18n-pro-display/consumer/templates/。

完整类型

ts
import type { AsamFlowSize } from '@asam-ui/pro';
import type { createSecurity } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
type SecurityController = ReturnType<typeof createSecurity>;
import type { SecurityRequest, SecuritySubject } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';

export type AccountFamily = 'minimal' | 'brand' | 'tech';
export type AccountPage = 'login' | 'register' | 'profile' | 'settings';
export interface LoginCredentials {
	account: string;
	password: string;
}
export interface Registration extends LoginCredentials {
	email: string;
	consent: boolean;
}
export interface AccountSettings {
	displayName: string;
	email: string;
	phone: string;
	language: string;
	notifications: boolean;
	digest: boolean;
	/** 可选前端资料扩展；未接入的宿主继续只返回原六字段。 */
	biography?: string;
	officeArea?: string;
}
/** Display allowlist. Map backend DTOs at the host boundary. */
export interface AccountProfile {
	displayName: string;
	email: string;
	phone: string;
	organization: string;
	role: string;
	joined: string;
	avatar?: string;
	website?: string;
}
export type RegistrationField = 'account' | 'email' | 'password' | 'confirm' | 'consent';
export type SettingsField = keyof AccountSettings;
/** Messages are display-safe host text, never raw server exceptions/DTOs. */
export type WriteResult<K extends string> =
	| { status: 'success'; message: string }
	| { status: 'field-error'; fields: Partial<Record<K, string>> }
	| { status: 'failure'; message: string }
	| { status: 'unknown' };
export type Verification<K extends string> = WriteResult<K> | { status: 'not-written' };
export interface AccountRequest extends SecurityRequest {
	readonly operationId: string;
}
export interface AccountServices {
	/** Host must gate authentication/storage side effects with BOTH requests' isCurrent. */
	login(credentials: Readonly<LoginCredentials>, request: AccountRequest): Promise<boolean>;
	register(
		input: Readonly<Registration>,
		request: AccountRequest
	): Promise<WriteResult<RegistrationField>>;
	profile(subject: SecuritySubject, request: AccountRequest): Promise<AccountProfile | null>;
	settings(subject: SecuritySubject, request: AccountRequest): Promise<AccountSettings>;
	save(
		subject: SecuritySubject,
		settings: Readonly<AccountSettings>,
		request: AccountRequest
	): Promise<WriteResult<SettingsField>>;
	verifyRegistration?(
		operationId: string,
		request: AccountRequest
	): Promise<Verification<RegistrationField>>;
	verifySave?(
		subject: SecuritySubject,
		operationId: string,
		request: AccountRequest
	): Promise<Verification<SettingsField>>;
	/** Refresh the host's display projection only. Must not save again or mutate page drafts. */
	refreshDisplay?(subject: SecuritySubject, request: AccountRequest): Promise<void>;
}
export interface AccountHost {
	security: Pick<SecurityController, 'state' | 'check' | 'onInvalidate'>;
	services: AccountServices;
	/** Stable id for one mutation. Generate once, preserve through unknown/verification. */
	operationId(): string;
	/** Explicit host allowlist. safeReturnPath is always applied first. */
	canNavigate(path: string): boolean;
	navigate(path: string): void | Promise<void>;
	/** An escalation action, never an implicit retry. Receives no secrets or payload. */
	resolveUnknown(kind: 'register' | 'save', operationId: string): void;
	registration?: {
		accountLabel?: string;
		minimumPasswordLength?: number;
		requireConsent?: boolean;
		validate?(
			input: Readonly<Registration & { confirm: string }>
		): Partial<Record<RegistrationField, string>>;
	};
	languages?: readonly { value: string; label: string }[];
}
export interface AccountPageProps {
	host: AccountHost;
	brand?: string;
	accountLabel?: string;
	size?: AsamFlowSize;
	disabled?: boolean;
	readonly?: boolean;
	returnPath?: unknown;
}
export interface AccountPageEvents {
	page: [page: AccountPage];
	/** Register/save emit once per operation, on direct or verified success in the current page. */
	completed: [kind: 'login' | 'register' | 'save'];
}
export interface AccountPageExpose {
	clear(): void;
}
